items.title: Gobierno de Milei emite deuda en pesos para cancelar pagos pendientes de obra pública
items.author: Tomás Carrió
items.summary: La emisión de títulos apunta a cancelar deudas correspondientes a certificados de obra de 2022 a 2025. Al hacer frente a esos compromisos a través de títulos de deuda en lugar de pagarlas en efectivo, ...
items.body: Buenos Aires — Con el objetivo de no sumar presión al superávit fiscal, el gobierno de Javier Milei amplió la emisión de instrumentos de deuda en pesos en unos ARS$221.119 millones con intereses capitalizables para cancelar deudas del Estado con proveedores de obra pública. La decisión se oficializó este martes a través de la Resolución Conjunta 59/2026 de las Secretarías de Hacienda y Finanzas, publicada en el Boletín Oficial, y apunta a cancelar deudas correspondientes a certificados de obra de 2022 a 2025. Con la recaudación reflejando este año caídas en términos reales ante el menor dinamismo de la actividad, el equipo económico optó por hacer frente a esos compromisos a través de títulos de deuda en lugar de pagarlas en efectivo. Es que de hacerlo por esa vía, el Tesoro hubiera tenido que registrarlo como un gasto, lo que hubiera impactado en el superávit primario base caja. En cambio, al pagar esas deudas con títulos, quedan registrados ‘abajo de la línea’, lo que implica que no se contabiliza en el resultado fiscal base caja. VER MÁS: Bessent y Brasil dan aire al plan Caputo, que busca sumar competitividad sin devaluar “Todo por debajo de la línea, aguante el superávit fiscal”, señaló Nicolás Gadano, economista jefe de Empiria y gerente general del Banco Central (BCRA) entre 2018 y 2019, en redes sociales. En diálogo con Bloomberg Línea, explicó que, con la decisión, el Gobierno está apelando a “todas las malas prácticas” para proteger el superávit fiscal. “Suponer que la que la deuda en pesos no paga intereses es ridículo”, marcó. Por ese motivo, Gadano consideró en otro mensaje en redes sociales que “sería oportuno que, en el marco de la discusión del Presupuesto 2027, el Congreso le pida al Ejecutivo una medición alternativa y complementaria al base caja tradicional”, que refleje más adecuadamente el costo de la deuda, incluyendo todos los mecanismos (capitalización, cupón cero, etc) que hoy no impactan en el resultado fiscal financiero. “En este caso, además, los instrumentos de deuda utilizados no pagan cupones (capitalizan intereses), por lo q todo el impacto fiscal de esta operación no impactará nunca en el resultado financiero”, explicó. Otro analista consultado por este medio, que pidió reserva, añadió que no cree que esté mal que esta operación no impacte en el resultado fiscal de este año porque fueron gastos que se hicieron en otros períodos. Pero el problema, marcó, es que no se mostró como un gasto en dichos períodos. VER MÁS: Caputo sobre el riesgo electoral 2027: “El mundo pide que Argentina no vuelva al pasado” A mediados de septiembre, el Ministerio de Economía informó que en agosto el Sector Público Nacional registró un superávit primario de ARS$1.990.322 millones y un superávit financiero de ARS$635.529 millones. De esta manera, acumuló en los primeros ocho meses de 2026 un superávit primario de aproximadamente 1,1% del PIB y un superávit financiero de aproximadamente 0,2% del PIB. De esta manera, el gobierno de Milei se encamina a alcanzar la meta acordada con el FMI para este 2026 de un superávit primario de 1,4%, tras renegociar las condiciones iniciales, y luego de haber incumplido en el margen el target acordado para el primer semestre del año, período para el cual obtuvo un superávit primario de ARS$6,29 billones frente a una meta de ARS$6,86 billones.

items.title: US EIA hikes oil price forecasts again as Iran war drains global stockpile
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Energy Information Administration raised its oil price forecast for this year and next year on Tuesday, as global stockpiles fall rapidly and diesel markets remain tight due to the ongoing Iran war.
items.body:
The US Energy Information Administration raised its oil price forecast for this year and next year on Tuesday, as global stockpiles fall rapidly and diesel markets remain tight due to the ongoing Iran war.
Global benchmark Brent crude is now expected to average about $98 a barrel in 2026, up 8% from the EIA's previous forecast, the agency said in its Short-Term Energy Outlook.
Oil and fuel prices have risen dramatically due to the US-Israeli war on Iran, which in turn has disrupted oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz, which carried about 20% of global oil supplies before the war. Iran has also struck regional energy infrastructure in response to US military strikes.
Falling global inventories and tightening diesel supplies are expected to keep crude prices elevated. Brent is forecast to average about $105 a barrel in the fourth quarter, $14 above the EIA's previous estimate. US retail diesel prices, which hit [USN:L6N4580TA TEXT:"record highs"] last month, are expected to remain above $6 a gallon in October before gradually easing to an average of roughly $4.50 a gallon in 2027.
However, Middle East oil production and exports are expected to gradually recover as transit through the strait improves and producers shift to alternative export routes and ship-to-ship transfers. As flows recover and inventories rebuild, Brent is expected to average $84 a barrel in 2027, the EIA said, $10 above its prior forecast.
Flows have improved as Saudi Arabia restarted shipments through its East-West Pipeline to the Red Sea, which bypasses the Strait of Hormuz, while regional exporters have adapted to attacks on shipping and energy infrastructure by using so-called dark transits, in which tankers disable tracking systems before transferring cargoes at sea.
Those measures have helped restore Gulf oil flows, excluding Iran, to more than 81% [USN:L6N45Q03T TEXT:"of pre-war levels in September"].
As those workarounds expand, crude production shut-ins are expected to fall from 4.5 million barrels per day (bpd) in the fourth quarter of 2026 to 2.7 million bpd in the first quarter of 2027, the agency said.

items.title: EIA expects a mixed picture for US households winter fuel costs this year
items.author: Nicole Jao
items.creator: Nicole Jao
items.summary: US homes that primarily heat with natural gas or propane — about half of households — will spend less on energy this winter than last, the Energy Information Administration said in its winter fuels outlook report on Tuesday.
items.body:
US homes that primarily heat with natural gas or propane — about half of households — will spend less on energy this winter than last, the Energy Information Administration said in its winter fuels outlook report on Tuesday.
But households that use heating oil, about 3% of US homes mostly in the US Northeast, are expected to pay about 21% more than last winter, the EIA said.
The EIA is forecasting a 30% increase in heating oil prices, which would be offset by milder Northeast weather. It expects national winter temperatures to be about the same as last winter and the previous 10-winter average.
“Relatively high natural gas inventories entering the winter season provide a cushion for heating demand, while households that rely on heating oil face higher prices because distillate markets remain tight,” EIA Administrator Tristan Abbey said in a note.
The EIA expects natural gas inventories to enter the winter heating season 2% above the previous five-year average. Price increases should be limited due to robust production growth and relatively high inventories.
US East Coast distillate stockpiles were 32% below their five-year seasonal average in September and are forecast to remain between 20% and 30% below average through the winter, the EIA said.

items.title: India's biggest power producer plans more private coal buying, people say
items.author: Sethuraman R
items.creator: Sethuraman R
items.summary: India's biggest power producer, NTPC , plans to buy more coal from private mining companies to overcome fuel shortages and meet rising electricity demand, two people familiar with the matter said.
items.body:
India's biggest power producer, NTPC (NTPC.NS) , plans to buy more coal from private mining companies to overcome fuel shortages and meet rising electricity demand, two people familiar with the matter said.
India is relying on thermal power to meet rising demand triggered by an extended summer and weaker hydropower generation linked to an El Niño weather pattern, government data showed.
Its [USN:L4N45M0OS TEXT:"power deficit"] rose to more than a three-year high in September despite coal-fired plants operating at a higher rate.
NTPC, which did not respond to a Reuters request for comment, typically buys fuel from state-run Coal India (COAL.NS) , the world's largest coal producer.
The utility's coal reserves at its plants have dropped from 18 million metric tons in April to 5.5 million tons as higher power generation and weaker local supplies due to heavy rains in mining areas have constrained replenishment, the people said.
NTPC is in talks with private companies to buy up to 15 million tons of coal and plans to use about 50 million tons produced from its captive mine, they added.
If the coal supplies are not ramped up, NTPC anticipates a severe power shortage early next year, the people said.
NTPC's coal consumption is expected to rise in 2026/27 to nearly 300 million tons from an average of 270 million to 280 million tons as it increases operations to meet rising electricity demand.
Nearly 47% of India's power plants had critically low levels of coal stocks, with supplies sufficient to generate power for less than four days at those plants.
To overcome power shortages, the federal power ministry last week asked more than 100 captive coal-fired power plants to [USN:L4N45I01P TEXT:"operate"] at maximum capacity from October 1 through year-end.
India is considering mandatory imported coal blending at power plants due to local shortages, Reuters [USN:L4N45G0BY TEXT:"reported"] last month.
Meanwhile, India's federal coal ministry said on Monday that Coal India has ramped up supplies to Indian power plants after rains in mining areas.
Coal remains central to India's power system even as the country expands renewable energy to reduce its reliance on fossil fuels and curb carbon emissions .

items.title: Olympian cleared in vandalism case seeks watchdog probes of Trump's Reflecting Pool project
items.author: Andrew Goudsward
items.creator: Andrew Goudsward
items.summary: Lawyers for a former US Olympian accused and then cleared of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool demanded on Tuesday that two government watchdogs investigate the botched renovation of the Washington landmark by President Donald Trump's administration and the now-dismissed criminal case.
items.body:
Lawyers for a former US Olympian accused and then cleared of vandalizing the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool demanded on Tuesday that two government watchdogs investigate the botched renovation of the Washington landmark by President Donald Trump 's administration and the now-dismissed criminal case.
Attorneys for David Hearn, a three-time US Olympic canoeist, urged the US Interior Department's inspector general to examine the flawed installation of an "American flag blue" liner at the bottom of the Reflecting Pool beginning in May. They also asked the US Justice Department's inspector general to investigate the case accusing Hearn of destruction of property, which [USN:S0N3ZQ017 TEXT:"prosecutors dropped"] weeks after securing an indictment.
The prosecution of Hearn in July came as Trump [USN:L6N42W17H TEXT:"blamed"] alleged vandals for algae blooms and [USN:L1N42Q0X5 TEXT:"peeling liner"] in the Reflecting Pool despite evidence that mistakes by a government contractor hired by his administration caused the issues.
The troubled renovation of the pool, which stretches about 2,000 feet (610 meters) along a portion of Washington's National Mall, became a political flashpoint over Trump's efforts to remake Washington's landscape and his use of the criminal justice system against those he views as enemies.
Inspectors general act as independent oversight officials to look into potential abuse, waste and fraud within US government agencies.
In a letter to the watchdog offices submitted on Tuesday, lawyers for Hearn alleged "incompetence and wrongdoing" in both the Justice Department and Interior Department.
"Anything less than a full and fair review would be a betrayal of your mission," the lawyers wrote.
Representatives for the two departments did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Federal prosecutors have said in court documents that they became aware of more pervasive problems with the renovation project only after Hearn had been indicted.
Hearn was [USN:FWN4340GH TEXT:"charged"] on July 2 with allegedly destroying a piece of the pool liner. The case quickly unraveled after prosecutors said documents from the Interior Department showed the damage was likely caused by a flawed installation by the contractor.
US Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro moved to dismiss the case on July 31, drawing a [USN:L1N4400WS TEXT:"furious reaction"] from Trump, who appointed her to the post last year. A federal judge last week barred prosecutors from seeking new charges.
The letter from Hearn's lawyers alleges that prosecutors had evidence of the installation flaws at the time Hearn was charged, but went forward with the prosecution anyway. It further alleges that Pirro improperly sought to question a defense expert who was inspecting the pool during a July 17 site visit.
The lawyers urged the Justice Department's inspector general to examine political pressure from Pirro and Trump to bring vandalism cases.
Trump ordered a refurbishment of the Reflecting Pool in time for July's 250th anniversary celebration of US independence. The pool had to be [USN:L1N42U0Q7 TEXT:"drained again"] following July 4 celebrations to repair widespread damage to its liner.

items.title: Kalshi launches stock index perpetual future to expand product suite
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Prediction market startup Kalshi launched a stock index perpetual future on Tuesday, broadening the reach of the nascent derivatives instrument as it looks to challenge traditional exchange operators.
items.body:
Prediction market startup Kalshi launched a stock index perpetual future on Tuesday, broadening the reach of the nascent derivatives instrument as it looks to challenge traditional exchange operators.
Here are some more details:
The contract will track a Kalshi index, US 500, housing 500 of the largest companies in the US, the company said
Perpetual futures, or perps, are derivatives that lack a traditional expiration date, allowing traders to hold positions indefinitely without rolling over contracts
Funding rates will keep the contract's price in line with the index, Kalshi said
A funding rate is a periodic fee exchanged between traders holding long and short positions in perpetual future contracts
Kalshi, which allows people to wager on the outcome of events, including sports and elections, said the contract would let investors take leveraged long or short positions on the index
The company [USN:L4N44F0J8 TEXT:"had filed"] with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission for such a vehicle in August
"Stock market exposure is the next step towards Kalshi becoming a full-service financial exchange, and perps are the best way for our traders to get this exposure," CEO Tarek Mansour said in a statement
Kalshi is also preparing to file for a [USN:L4N44U13V TEXT:"perpetual West Texas Intermediate crude oil contract"] with US regulators, Reuters reported last month citing a source familiar with the matter, as the company works to expand beyond cryptocurrency and metals

items.title: Miles de instalaciones eólicas y solares europeas están expuestas en Internet: investigadores
items.author: Stephanie van den Berg, Toby Sterling
items.creator: Stephanie van den Berg, Toby Sterling
items.summary: Miles de sistemas administrativos de parques eólicos y solares en Europa están expuestos a Internet, lo que podría permitir a los atacantes acceder a interfaces capaces de detener las turbinas y aumentar el riesgo de sabotaje, advirtieron el martes unos investigadores neerlandeses.
items.body:
Miles de sistemas administrativos de parques eólicos y solares en Europa están expuestos a Internet, lo que podría permitir a los atacantes acceder a interfaces capaces de detener las turbinas y aumentar el riesgo de sabotaje, advirtieron el martes unos investigadores neerlandeses.
Entre los sistemas expuestos se encontraban interfaces administrativas y de inicio de sesión, así como interfaces operativas que mostraban datos y controles.
Sin embargo, uno de los investigadores, Soufian El Yadmani, de la empresa de análisis de Internet Modat, dijo a Reuters que los investigadores creían que habría sido posible obtener el control total en el caso de unas 181 instalaciones.
La página web de una turbina mostraba datos en tiempo real, botones de "Inicio, Parada y Reinicio" y la ubicación de la turbina, según el estudio. Algunos sistemas controlaban varias turbinas o todo un parque eólico.
"Lo que nosotros podemos mapear en unas horas, un atacante también puede mapearlo en unas horas", indicó el informe. Los investigadores instaron a los operadores a retirar de inmediato de Internet las interfaces de administración.
Estos hallazgos se producen en medio de la preocupación por las infraestructuras críticas de Europa, que se han enfrentado a presuntos sabotajes y ciberataques que los gobiernos occidentales atribuyen con frecuencia a Rusia desde su invasión de Ucrania en 2022. Moscú niega cualquier implicación.
El mes pasado, los servicios de inteligencia, la policía y la fiscalía neerlandeses advirtieron de que la inteligencia artificial estaba acelerando la amenaza. El Yadmani y Bouke van Laethem, del Centro Nacional de Ciberseguridad de Países Bajos, presentaron sus conclusiones el martes en la Conferencia ONE celebrada en La Haya.
Las turbinas o los parques eólicos estrechamente vinculados a las infraestructuras públicas son motivo de especial preocupación, según El Yadmani. "Si se puede cortar el suministro eléctrico en una ciudad o en un aeropuerto, imaginen lo que supondría a mayor escala", señaló.

items.title: (Car) show time
items.author: Nick Carey
items.creator: Nick Carey
items.summary: Many of us automotive reporters are getting ready to head to Paris this weekend for the city’s biannual car show.
items.body:
Many of us automotive reporters are getting ready to head to Paris this weekend for the city’s biannual car show.
Chinese brands have transformed Europe's surviving car shows, appearing in ever greater numbers as traditional events struggle for relevance.
This year will be no exception, with around 20 Chinese brands showing up. Some such as BYD and Chery are familiar names to Europeans, but there will be a cast of newcomers as well.
The next Auto File will come to you from Paris, but we’re sticking with the car show theme this week because an event in [USN:L6N45K0YK TEXT:"Buenos Aires"] underlines the speed of China's expansion into car markets around the world.
Before we go any further, don’t forget we’re interested in your perspective: Which issues are going to shape the future of the automotive industry? What questions are on your mind? Write to me at autofile@thomsonreuters.com and we’ll try to tackle these issues in upcoming editions.
Which brings us to today’s Auto File…
China and [USN:L6N45K0YK TEXT:"car shows"]
Ford: [USN:L6N45L16P TEXT:"watch out"] for China
Volvo’s [USN:L6N45O0BR TEXT:"step back"]
CHINESE CAR SHOWS There was a time, not so long ago, when auto shows were a big deal for legacy manufacturers. Car shows were where they showed up to make a big splash with new vehicles.
Sometimes, the showmanship strayed into the surreal. Back in 2008, [USN:N13355282 TEXT:"Chrysler"] used a herd of Texas longhorn cattle ambling down a city street at the Detroit auto show to launch the latest version of its Ram pickup truck.
The next year, of course, Chrysler underwent a government-led bankruptcy, then was sold to Fiat and is now part of Stellantis. The cattle went on to a movie career instead.
The financial crisis and the long recovery, followed later by the COVID pandemic hurt car shows.
Some manufacturers, including Toyota, have decided many industry extravaganzas are no longer worth the effort, preferring to launch vehicles at their own events.
As a result, many car shows have suffered. Detroit’s once iconic event even moved from January to September in the hope that escaping the winter slush would attract more visitors.
It has since returned to January, but is hardly in better shape.
It’s doing better than Geneva, though, where organizers said in 2024 they were cancelling the 2025 edition because of a lack of interest from automakers.
Had they held on a little longer, it's fair to wonder whether the Geneva show might have survived.
CHINESE REVIVAL While some traditional carmakers have largely given up on car shows, Chinese automakers have embraced them.
I remember some of the early visits to the Detroit show by Chinese automakers, often tucked away in the basement at Cobo Hall. They included the now-defunct Changfeng brand in 2007 with the Liebao CS7 SUV – described back then by the New York Times as looking “like a rejected Kia design circa 1995, rescued from a Seoul wastebasket and smuggled to Hunan.”
Since then, car shows in China have become a marvel of the modern automotive industry — vast exhibition halls with a dizzying array of brands competing with new tech-laden models in a highly competitive market.
If anyone was laughing in the West at Chinese cars 20 years ago, they’re not laughing now.
The Chinese have also started taking over and revitalizing car shows in places like Paris and Munich, while also forcing European carmakers to show up on their home turf.
They have even put obscure car shows on the map, like the one in Poznan, Poland, that in the last couple of years has had more exhibitors than Munich.
And now Argentina has opened up to Chinese brands, as Reuters colleague Leila Miller reports, they have hosted their very own car show in Buenos Aires.
You can read all about it [USN:L6N45K0YK TEXT:"here"].
About 20 Chinese brands turned up for the show, having grown their share of Argentina’s car market to 10% from 2% late last year.
Since launching in late 2025, BYD has become Argentina’s ninth-largest brand.
Chinese automakers are steadily expanding across Latin America, selling both gas guzzlers and EVs at a pace that has alarmed some local markets.
They are also spurring traditional automakers into action.
Just last week, Toyota said it will invest [USN:S0N43Y03X TEXT:"$1.34 billion"] in a new EV plant – in Argentina.
Recommended reading:
China’s vanishing [USN:L1N45O046 TEXT:"trade superweapon"]
Europe’s [USN:L8N45O0IP TEXT:"record EV sales"]
A [USN:L6N45L13J TEXT:"red-dyed diesel"] primer
FARLEY'S CHINA WARNING Ford CEO Jim Farley has been quite vocal about the Chinese, telling the automaker’s employees in the summer that Chinese rivals could enter the US market [USN:L6N43W14T TEXT:"within a decade"].
While the US Senate is trying to work out a way to “[USN:L1N45M10J TEXT:"permanently"]” ban Chinese automakers from America’s lucrative car market — though [USN:L1N45L0RQ TEXT:"not Mercedes"] which has nearly 20% passive ownership from Chinese entities — Farley is still talking as if it is inevitable that they will arrive some day.
As Reuters colleagues Kalea Hall and Mike Colias report, Farley says the US must carefully weigh how and whether Chinese automakers should enter the American market, pointing to Europe as a cautionary tale.
You can read about it [USN:L6N45L16P TEXT:"here"].
Speaking at an Automotive News conference, Farley said the US must “be extremely careful around how the Chinese OEMs come to our country,” and cited the pressure on Europe’s auto industry as Chinese imports quickly grab market share there.
For European countries, “it’s too late,” Farley said.
The US has one advantage the European Union lacks: a single federal government capable of setting trade policy.
The EU's 27 member states do not have the same flexibility. Whether shutting out Chinese competition is the right answer is a separate question, but Washington has the ability to make that choice.
VOLVO PULLS GUIDANCE Sweden’s Volvo Cars pulled its full-year sales volume and cash-flow guidance, citing “deteriorating market conditions in China and slower than expected recovery in the US.”
You can read all about it [USN:L6N45O0BR TEXT:"here"].
What stands out about Volvo’s warning was not that it was surprising — like other legacy brands it has struggled in China and its troubles in the US are not new — but that it came just two weeks after a big dog-and-pony show for investors where the company talked up its prospects.
Volvo told investors at that conference that it plans 13 new models by 2030 and to [USN:L6N4570Q1 TEXT:"more than double"] its pretax margin from 2025 levels.
But management must surely have known by then that a guidance cut was coming.
Gains of 2% in Volvo’s share price when it grandly outlined its 2030 plans were more than offset by a 3% decline for its guidance warning.
FAST LAPS Ford CEO Jim Farley said a supplier issue that recently affected [USN:L6N45M0Y4 TEXT:"F-150 pickup-truck"] output has been resolved, but the snag has impacted the company’s third-quarter wholesale numbers.
Honda aims to cut costs by as much as a fifth and halve development times under its [USN:L6N45N0JL TEXT:"new partnership in India"] with Tata Technologies, according to two people familiar with the matter.
General Motors remained the [USN:L4N45M1CQ TEXT:"top US auto seller"] during the third quarter despite a dip in sales, but Toyota continued chipping away at its lead as high gasoline prices pushed buyers toward hybrids.
Tesla is on course to end two straight years of falling sales after its [USN:L6N45O0R8 TEXT:"third-quarter deliveries"] beat Wall Street estimates, with a rebound in Europe giving the automaker a way back to growth without US tax incentives.
Renault will invest more than [USN:L8N45P03F TEXT:"$11 billion"] in France over the next five years in electric vehicles and more affordable cars, Chief Executive François Provost said.
US EV maker Rivian reported record [USN:L6N45O0MI TEXT:"third-quarter deliveries"], beating analysts' estimates after rolling out its cheaper R2 SUV targeted at a broader section of the mass EV market.

items.summary: China plans to put forward a late candidate to lead the World Health Organization, according to four diplomats and a source familiar with the matter, giving Beijing a chance to expand its influence after the US quit the WHO.
items.body:
China plans to put forward a late candidate to lead the World Health Organization, according to four diplomats and a source familiar with the matter, giving Beijing a chance to expand its influence after the US [USN:L6N3YM12Z TEXT:"quit the WHO"].
Beijing has long sought to take on more responsibility within UN agencies and other multilateral bodies, just as the United States under President Donald Trump winds down its engagement with the UN and some of its constituent organisations.
The WHO leads international efforts to combat disease and health crises such as the current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and the recent COVID-19 pandemic.
The sources said China plans to put forward Song Li, a senior public health official with 20 years' expertise in maternal and child health policy and international cooperation, to succeed the incumbent director general, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.
Song and the Chinese mission in Geneva did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.
A diplomatic source said the planned nomination was a clear sign that China wanted to fill a void where the US has stepped back.
The UN health agency has been forced into a sweeping restructuring by the loss of its largest donor, scaling back activities, cutting senior management roles and [USN:L6N3WU0WY TEXT:"eliminating thousands of jobs"].
Trump's administration repeatedly criticised the WHO's handling of the pandemic and accused it of bias toward China, the place where COVID-19 originated - something the WHO rejects.
China has announced [USN:L8N3RS0KX TEXT:"additional funding"] for the WHO but is far from filling the gap left by the United States.
The WHO will release the complete list of nominees after final regional committee meetings, expected in early November.
However, six candidates, representing Saudi Arabia, Belgium, Qatar, Botswana, Indonesia and Spain, have already chosen to make their identities public on the WHO's website.
Song could face scrutiny amid lingering tensions over the WHO's relationship with China during the pandemic.
In 2020, she was editor-in-chief of a paper giving guidance on COVID-19 prevention and control for women in China to set national standards for managing maternal and child health during the pandemic.
If chosen, she would be the second Chinese national to head the WHO after Margaret Chan.

items.title: La francesa Mistral lanza un modelo de IA que, dice, supera a algunos de sus rivales chinos
items.author: Elizabeth Howcroft, Leo Marchandon
items.creator: Elizabeth Howcroft, Leo Marchandon
items.summary: La empresa francesa Mistral presentó el martes un nuevo modelo de IA, poniendo fin a un paréntesis de unos cinco meses entre lanzamientos importantes, y afirmó que este supera en rendimiento a muchos modelos de pesos abiertos de la competencia.
items.body:
La empresa francesa Mistral presentó el martes un nuevo modelo de IA, poniendo fin a un paréntesis de unos cinco meses entre lanzamientos importantes, y afirmó que este supera en rendimiento a muchos modelos de pesos abiertos de la competencia.
La empresa, fundada hace tres años y considerada por muchos como el principal rival europeo de los competidores estadounidenses y chinos en el ámbito de la IA, no había lanzado ningún modelo nuevo desde mayo. En agosto, comenzó a ofrecer a sus clientes modelos de terceros, empezando por el GLM 5.3 de la empresa Z.ai, con sede en Pekín.
"El modelo que anunciamos hoy supera, de hecho, a los modelos chinos en ciertos aspectos, incluida la ciberseguridad. Por lo tanto, la idea de que Europa no puede competir es falsa", dijo el presidente ejecutivo, Artur Mensch, en un acto de presentación celebrado en Abu Dabi, sin especificar a qué modelos chinos o pruebas de rendimiento se refería.
Mistral ha anunciado que Le Chonk, cuyo nombre oficial es Mistral Large 4, estará disponible para el público el 27 de octubre.
Antes del lanzamiento, los expertos en ciberseguridad y las autoridades gubernamentales tendrán acceso a una versión con menos restricciones de seguridad para poner a prueba sus capacidades, informó la empresa.
Pierre Stock, vicepresidente científico de Mistral, dijo a Reuters que el modelo se encuentra entre los sistemas de peso abierto más potentes disponibles.
"De peso abierto" significa que los usuarios pueden descargar el modelo desde diversas plataformas y ejecutarlo en su propio hardware. Muchos modelos chinos son de peso abierto, mientras que los principales modelos estadounidenses suelen ser cerrados y solo accesibles a través de la infraestructura de sus desarrolladores.
RIESGOS DE SEGURIDAD CONTENIDOS Stock explicó a Reuters que el modelo había intentado salir de su entorno de pruebas, pero que esto era de esperar y la empresa había podido evitarlo.
OpenAI y Anthropic, cuyos modelos más avanzados han mostrado un comportamiento similar en las pruebas, han restringido el acceso a sus sistemas con mayor capacidad cibernética.
Después de que los directivos de las empresas estadounidenses de IA advirtieron el mes pasado de que la IA podría suponer una amenaza existencial para la humanidad, Mensch desestimó esos argumentos calificándolos de interesados.
Mistral, que recaudó 3.000 millones de euros (3.400 millones de dólares) en su última ronda de financiación, se ha posicionado como una alternativa europea más segura.
ACORTANDO LA DISTANCIA Mistral dijo que Large 4 está "cerrando la brecha con los modelos de vanguardia" en ámbitos como la programación, las finanzas, el análisis geoespacial, la fabricación y el diseño de productos.
La empresa entrenó el modelo en su propia infraestructura.
Stock señaló que el objetivo de Mistral era establecer una colaboración "muy estrecha" con socios como ASML y el nuevo inversor Samsung "a lo largo de toda la cadena de valor".
Afirmó que Large 4 es capaz de diseñar chips informáticos, pero se negó a comentar si Mistral está trabajando actualmente con Samsung en el desarrollo de chips.
(1 dólar = 0,8883 euros)

items.title: 仏、最新弾道ミサイル初試験発射　ロシアとの緊張で核抑止力向上
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
John Irish

［パリ　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
John Irish

［パリ　６日　ロイター］ - フランス国防省は６日、最新の潜水艦発射弾道ミサイル「Ｍ５１．３」の初めての発射試験を行ったと発表した。２０２５年１０月に配備され、射程は９０００キロ以上と推定されている。ロシアとの緊張が高まる中、核戦力を近代化することで抑止力を向上する戦略の一環となる。

マクロン大統領は「われわれがより強くなったというメッセージが明確に伝えられた」と、発射を見守る自身の動画と共にＸに投稿した。弾道ミサイルは、整備を終了した原子力潜水艦の能力を確認する作戦の一部としてブルターニュ沖から発射された。国防省は国際法を順守して実施したと説明している。

ロシアのプーチン大統領は先週、西側諸国に対し、ウクライナを巡る対立を深めないよう警告。ポーランドとリトアニアに挟まれたロシアの飛び地カリーニングラードを防衛するため、必要であれば核兵器を用いる意向を明らかにした。北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）は「いかなる活動も、ロシアの領土への脅威とはならない」と主張。プーチン氏も、欧州諸国を攻撃する計画はないとの意向を示している。

マクロン氏は今年３月、核搭載可能な兵器の欧州同盟国への配備や、共同演習を実施する構想を打ち出した。フランスは、世界第４位の核弾頭２９０発を維持するため、年約５６億ユーロ（約６０億４０００万ドル）を支出。ロシアと米国はそれぞれ５０００発超、英国は２２５発を保有している。

items.title: Flávio diz que buscará reduzir imposto sobre folha de pagamento e carga tributária
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O candidato à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) disse nesta terça-feira que, se eleito, pretende reduzir os impostos sobre a folha de pagamento e perseguir uma diminuição da carga tributária do país.
items.body:
O candidato à Presidência Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) disse nesta terça-feira que, se eleito, pretende reduzir os impostos sobre a folha de pagamento e perseguir uma diminuição da carga tributária do país.
Em entrevista à imprensa em Brasília, Flávio disse que está em conversas com parlamentares do Novo, assim como com dirigentes do Podemos, Republicanos, União Brasil e PP que, segundo o candidato, tratarão com suas bancadas parlamentares sobre um possível apoio a ele no segundo turno, no qual enfrentará o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
O senador viajará ainda nesta terça-feira a Goiânia para se reunir com Ronaldo Caiado, candidato à Presidência pelo PSD derrotado em primeiro turno.

items.title: Trump's remarks on Brazil election show Lula is isolated, says Bolsonaro
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro said on Tuesday that US President Donald Trump's remarks about the South American country's election underscored what he called President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's growing isolation on the world stage.
items.body:
Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro said on Tuesday that US President Donald Trump's [USN:L6N45R139 TEXT:"remarks"] about the South American country's election underscored what he called President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's growing isolation on the world stage.
"The world is eager for change in Brazil," Bolsonaro told reporters in Brasilia
Trump said on Monday that the result of Sunday's vote, which sent right-wing Bolsonaro to an October 25 runoff against leftist incumbent Lula, was "close, but a very, very big victory. Amazing, actually"
Bolsonaro said that, if elected president, he would seek to cut payroll taxes and reduce the overall tax burden

items.title: Kotak, IndusInd, Axis Bank shares jump on strong Q2 business updates
items.author: Subrata Panda
items.summary: Lenders report strong credit and deposit growth aided by FCNR(B) inflows, though analysts flag concerns over CASA momentum ...
items.body: Shares of Kotak Mahindra Bank, IndusInd Bank and Axis Bank rose sharply on Tuesday after the lenders reported robust growth in advances and deposits in their quarterly business updates. This growth was aided by healthy mobilisation of FCNR(B) deposits. Kotak Mahindra Bank’s shares jumped 3.59 per cent to close at ₹431.25 on the BSE, while IndusInd Bank gained 2.79 per cent to end at ₹906.95. Axis Bank’s shares rose 2.01 per cent to ₹1,248.50. However, RBL Bank’s shares closed 0.72 per cent lower at ₹414 on the BSE compared with the previous day’s close. On Monday, Kotak Mahindra Bank reported robust net advances (period-end) growth of 25 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) and 13 per cent quarter-on-quarter (Q-o-Q). Excluding advances linked to FCNR(B) deposits, loan growth remained firm at around 21 per cent Y-o-Y and 10 per cent Q-o-Q. Deposits grew 23 per cent Y-o-Y and 14 per cent Q-o-Q, aided by FCNR(B) inflows. Excluding these, deposit growth was more measured at 13 per cent Y-o-Y and 4 per cent Q-o-Q. Current account savings account (CASA) balances grew 11 per cent Y-o-Y and 8 per cent Q-o-Q. The bank mobilised $5.78 billion through FCNR(B) deposits during the quarter. Axis Bank, India’s third-largest private sector lender, said its deposits grew 5.8 per cent sequentially and 20.7 per cent Y-o-Y to ₹14.52 trillion as of September 30, while gross advances rose 8.8 per cent Q-o-Q and 22.7 per cent YoY to ₹13.85 trillion. The lender mobilised $10.62 billion (₹1.02 trillion) in FCNR(B) deposits under the Reserve Bank of India’s swap facility introduced earlier this year.   “While the outcome is good on the loan growth front, the question is sustainability plus core deposit growth around 12-13 per cent for Kotak (Mahindra Bank) and Axis (Bank) isn’t that great. That goes to show that eventually loan growth will have to come down from current levels. CASA growth is also 10 to 11 per cent similar to HDFC Bank showing the pressure that exists in CASA across the system. CASA ratios continue to decline even on core deposit growth basis”, said Suresh Ganapathy, MD&Head - Financial Services Research, Macquarie Capital.  Meanwhile, IndusInd Bank’s net advances grew 11.2 per cent Y-o-Y to ₹3.62 trillion as of September 30, 2026, outpacing the 10.1 per cent growth in deposits to ₹4.29 trillion. IndusInd Bank’s CASA ratio declined to 28 per cent from 30.7 per cent a year earlier and 29.4 per cent in June. The lender mobilised $3.51 billion in FCNR(B) deposits under the RBI’s deposit swap facility, with outstanding loans of about ₹16,564 crore extended from its GIFT City branch against these deposits as of September-end. And, RBL Bank’s total deposits rose 34 per cent Y-o-Y to around ₹1.56 trillion in the quarter ended September 30 (Q2FY27), while gross advances grew 40 per cent to around ₹1.43 trillion. (Disclosure: Entities controlled by the Kotak family have a significant holding in Business Standard Pvt Ltd)

items.title: Venture Global in talks to sell US LNG to Chinese buyers, Bloomberg News reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Venture Global is in talks to sell liquefied natural gas to additional Chinese buyers, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter, as the Iran war disrupts global shipments and spurs China to diversify its supply sources.
items.body:
Venture Global (VG.N) is in talks to sell liquefied natural gas to additional Chinese buyers, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter, as the Iran war disrupts global shipments and spurs China to diversify its supply sources.
The Virginia-based LNG supplier has been holding early-stage discussions on long-term contracts with at least three Chinese LNG importers, including PetroChina, to supply fuel from the American company's export facilities in Louisiana, Bloomberg reported.
China [USN:L1N45A0R6 TEXT:"imposed a 15% tariff"] on US LNG in February 2025 in retaliation for President Donald Trump's duties on Chinese goods. China stopped buying US LNG in March 2025 after Beijing's tariffs on US energy products took effect in mid-February.
In [USN:L4N456091 TEXT:"September"], China Gas Holdings (0384.HK) signed a 20-year deal to buy 0.5 million metric tons a year of US LNG from Venture Global starting in 2030.
The US and China had discussed a plan to reduce or eliminate Chinese tariffs on US LNG as part of a broader energy and agriculture package, people briefed on the talks [USN:L1N45A0R6 TEXT:"told Reuters last month"], ahead of Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington, but no such measures were announced.
For PetroChina, the supply would total more than 1 million tons per year, the report added.
Venture Global and PetroChina did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment.

items.title: U.S. stocks flirt with a record after oil prices ease
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: Asian shares were mostly higher on Tuesday and U.S. futures advanced after shares rose to near a record close on Wall Street.
items.body: NEW YORK — U.S. stocks are rising Tuesday and on track to hit an all-time high after oil prices gave back some of their big recent gains. The S&P 500 added 0.8 per cent and was on pace to finish the day above its record set in August. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 265 points, or 0.5 per cent, as of 11 a.m. Eastern time, and the Nasdaq composite was adding 0.8 per cent to its own all-time high set the day before. Stocks got a boost after the price of Brent crude oil, the international standard, dropped 2 per cent to US$98.30 per barrel. That’s down from nearly US$110 a few weeks ago, and the easing removes some pressure from the high inflation that’s squeezing people and businesses worldwide. It also helped relax some of the tension that’s built up in the bond market, and the yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 5.25 per cent from 5.31 per cent late Monday. Yields worldwide have recently been hitting their highest levels in years or even decades, which slows the economy by making it more expensive for everyone to borrow money and by making investors less willing to pay high prices for stocks. On Wall Street, Constellation Energy jumped to one of the market’s biggest gains after rising 13 per cent. It announced a long-term deal to supply Google with about as much electricity as a new nuclear reactor makes. The boom in data centers for artificial-intelligence technology has made not just electricity more in demand but also construction crews and materials throughout the economy. Option Care Health soared 32.7 per cent after CD&R and McKesson said they’re buying the provider of infusion services. The two are paying US$32.05 for each Option Care Health share, valuing it at roughly US$5.8 billion. CDR is a private investment firm. Shares of McKesson, the healthcare services company, added 0.2 per cent. One of the biggest reasons the U.S. stock market has been able to rally near records despite high inflation, expensive oil and worries in the bond market is that profits for companies have remained remarkably strong. Lamb Weston, which sells frozen fries and other potato products, said on Tuesday that its profit and revenue during its latest quarter topped its projections, for example. The results also beat analysts’ expectations, and its stock rallied 10.8 per cent. CEO Mike Smith said the company continues to deal with unexpected increases in freight and other expenses as inflation remains high. But the company nevertheless raised its forecast for an underlying measure of profit for its full fiscal year. Expectations are high for companies across industries, as they prepare to report how much profit they made from July through September. Delta Air Lines will report its third-quarter results on Friday, with several of the country’s biggest banks following up the next week. For companies in the S&P 500, analysts are forecasting a third straight quarter of growth above 25 per cent, according to FactSet. Along with how high interest rates are, how much profit companies are making are the big levers that help to set prices for stocks. In stock markets abroad, indexes ticked higher in Europe as yields continue to swing in their bond markets amid concerns about high government debts and tight budgets. In France, tens of thousands of demonstrators marched in support of protests by students demanding more funding for schools. In Asia, Japan’s Nikkei 225 jumped 1.1 per cent, and Hong Kong’s Hang Seng climbed 1 per cent, but South Korea’s Kospi dropped 0.9 per cent. ___ Stan Choe, The Associated Press AP Business Writers Chan Ho-him and Matt Ott contributed to this report.

items.title: Paramount conclui mega fusão com Warner Bros para criar a poderosa Skydance em Hollywood
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Paramount Skydance , nesta terça-feira, concluiu a aquisição bilionária de US$110 bilhões da Warner Bros Discovery , criando uma gigante de Hollywood chamada Skydance e entregando ao presidente-executivo David Ellison o controle de uma das maiores empresas de entretenimento do mundo.
items.body:
A Paramount Skydance , nesta terça-feira, concluiu a aquisição bilionária de US$110 bilhões da Warner Bros Discovery (WBD.O) , criando uma gigante de Hollywood chamada Skydance e entregando ao presidente-executivo David Ellison o controle de uma das maiores empresas de entretenimento do mundo.
O acordo reúne os estúdios por trás de "Missão: Impossível", "Harry Potter" e DC Studios, juntamente com grandes redes de televisão e streaming como CBS, CNN, Paramount+ e HBO Max — formando uma ampla empresa de entretenimento que abrange cinema, TV e notícias.
As ações da empresa resultante da fusão foram transferidas da Nasdaq para a Bolsa de Valores de Nova York na terça-feira, onde passarão a ser negociadas sob o código "SKYD".
Acordos com uma coalizão de estados norte-americanos e um sindicato de roteiristas de Hollywood removeram as principais barreiras legais para a fusão, uma das maiores da história da mídia. Isso ocorre em um momento em que Hollywood enfrenta a queda nas assinaturas de TV a cabo, o alto custo de competir por audiência no streaming e a pressão constante dos sindicatos por empregos e direitos dos trabalhadores criativos.
Ellison afirmou na semana passada que o nome Skydance foi escolhido para preservar as identidades individuais dos estúdios Paramount e Warner Bros, em vez de combiná-los sob uma nova marca.
Analistas, no entanto, afirmaram que o nome reforça a extensão do controle de Ellison, destacando como algumas das marcas mais icônicas de Hollywood agora respondem a ele e como ele tem uma plataforma para impor sua estratégia e cultura.
Em apenas 16 anos, a Skydance passou de um estúdio independente ao centro de uma das maiores disputas de poder de Hollywood. Fundada em 2010 pelo filho de Larry Ellison, cofundador da Oracle, a empresa construiu sua reputação como investidora e produtora do sucesso de bilheteria da Paramount, "Top Gun: Maverick".
Após a fusão com a Paramount no ano passado, a Skydance voltou suas atenções para a Warner Bros, entrando em uma acirrada disputa com a Netflix (NFLX.O) , ao mesmo tempo que despertava o interesse de outros potenciais compradores, incluindo a Comcast (CMCSA.O) .
APOSTA MAIS AMPLA DE HOLLYWOOD Ellison nomeou Ynon Kreiz, ex-presidente-executivo da Mattel, como co-CEO da Skydance para administrar as operações diárias e liderar a integração, enquanto Ellison supervisiona a direção criativa e a estratégia geral.
A dupla enfrenta a tarefa de combinar duas grandes empresas, ao mesmo tempo que implementa uma economia de custos planejada de US$6 bilhões, grande parte da qual, segundo a Paramount, virá de "fontes não relacionadas à mão de obra" — por meio da combinação das tecnologias de streaming e provedores de nuvem das duas empresas. No entanto, a magnitude dos cortes deverá afetar empregos em todo Hollywood.
A expectativa é que a empresa resultante da fusão tenha uma dívida de cerca de US$80 bilhões, o que pressionará Ellison a expandir o streaming, preservar o fluxo de caixa das redes de TV a cabo e melhorar o desempenho dos filmes nos cinemas.
O presidente da CNN, Mark Thompson, e a editora-chefe da CBS News, Bari Weiss, continuariam em seus respectivos cargos de liderança na Skydance.
(Por Anzar Mehraj e Harshita Mary Varghese)

items.title: UBS-Chef Ermotti: Standort Schweiz gut für Wirtschaft und Aktionäre
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: UBS-Chef Sergio Ermotti sieht die Schweiz weiterhin als guten Standort für seine die Bank. Nach Spekulationen und Forderungen von Investoren, UBS solle angesichts der geplanten Verschärfung der Kapitalvorschriften einen Wegzug aus der Schweiz prüfen, äußerte sich Ermotti in einem Interview mit dem US-Sender CNBC am Dienstag zurückhaltend. "Wir glauben, dass der Standort Schweiz gut für die Schweizer Wirtschaft sowie für unsere Kunden und Aktionäre ist", sagte Ermotti. Zugleich betonte er, die Bank müsse prüfen, welche Schritte künftig erforderlich seien, um die Interessen ihrer Anteilseigner und der Kundschaft zu wahren. Drei Monate braucht die Schweizer Großbank UBS laut Ermotti noch, um die Credit Suisse zu integrieren. 90 Prozent der angestrebten Synergien seien nun erreicht. UBS (UBSG.S) -Chef Sergio Ermotti sieht die Schweiz weiterhin als guten Standort für seine die Bank. Nach Spekulationen und Forderungen von Investoren, UBS solle angesichts der geplanten Verschärfung der Kapitalvorschriften einen Wegzug aus der Schweiz prüfen, äußerte sich Ermotti in einem Interview mit dem US-Sender CNBC am Dienstag zurückhaltend. "Wir glauben, dass der Standort Schweiz gut für die Schweizer Wirtschaft sowie für unsere Kunden und Aktionäre ist", sagte Ermotti. Zugleich betonte er, die Bank müsse prüfen, welche Schritte künftig erforderlich seien, um die Interessen ihrer Anteilseigner und der Kundschaft zu wahren. Drei Monate braucht die Schweizer Großbank UBS laut Ermotti noch, um die Credit Suisse zu integrieren. 90 Prozent der angestrebten Synergien seien nun erreicht. "Bis Ende 2026 werden wir endlich fertig sein, und dann blicken wir nach vorne", sagte Ermotti.
Der US-Finanzinvestor Artisan Partners hatte die Schweizer Großbank wegen einer drohenden Verschärfung der staatlichen Eigenkapitalvorschriften zu einem Wegzug aus der Schweiz aufgefordert. In einem Brief an den Verwaltungsrat erklärten die beiden Investmentteams Global Value und International Value, das Land sei für das Institut kein attraktiver Standort mehr. Die kleine Kammer (Ständerat) des Schweizer Parlaments hatte sich in der vorvergangenen Woche für einen Vorschlag ausgesprochen, nach dem die UBS ihre ausländischen Tochtergesellschaften mit 90 Prozent hartem Kernkapital (CET1) unterlegen müsse. Sollte die große Kammer des Parlaments (Nationalrat) dem Beschluss des Ständerats folgen, müsste das Institut 16 Milliarden Dollar mehr Kapital halten als bisher. Die UBS lehnt den höheren Kapitalpuffer entschieden ab.

items.title: Italy's electoral reform clears initial confidence vote hurdle
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Italy's lower house of parliament on Tuesday approved part of a fiercely contested electoral reform championed by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni which could be a factor in deciding an election due next year.
items.body:
Italy's lower house of parliament on Tuesday approved part of a fiercely contested electoral reform championed by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni which could be a factor in deciding an election due next year.
Parliament approved the first articles of the bill in two confidence votes in the lower house.
The second vote was passed with 227 votes in favour, 149 against and three abstentions. The first had passed by a similarly comfortable margin.
Final approval of the package is expected on Thursday in a secret ballot.
Meloni could resign if the bill is rejected.
It introduces a fully proportional electoral system, with a seat bonus guaranteeing a parliamentary majority to any alliance winning more than 42% of the vote.
Meloni's right-wing coalition faces an election by the end of next year.
Latest speculation points to a possible vote in May 2027 to coincide with local elections in major cities.

items.title: Shiffrin to switch focus away from slalom in 'exploration' season
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Three-times Olympic champion Mikaela Shiffrin intends to race less slalom next season, and concentrate more on giant slalom and super-G, with the American describing the new campaign as "an exploration".
items.body:
Three-times Olympic champion Mikaela Shiffrin intends to race less slalom next season, and concentrate more on giant slalom and super-G, with the American describing the new campaign as "an exploration".
Shiffrin won her second [USN:L8N3ZE0NS TEXT:"Olympic slalom gold"] medal at Milano Cortina this year and has dominated the discipline at World Cup level, winning the slalom crystal globe on nine occasions.
The 31-year-old holds the record for most World Cup race wins, with 73 of her 110 victories coming in slalom.
Shiffrin says that curiosity has been the driving force behind her motivation down through the years.
"Right now, I feel that curiosity with giant slalom and super-G. This season is an exploration." Shiffrin said on social media on Tuesday.
"I'm planning to race less slalom this season. Not necessarily no slalom."
Shiffrin, who won nine of the 10 slalom races last season, will skip the first two slalom events in the new season.
"Right now, the plan is Killington as my first slalom and potentially a few others throughout the season," Shiffrin said.
"I'll have the chance to recover, train differently, take care of my body differently, and build more intentional GS and super-G blocks."
INTENT TO CHANGE In February, Shiffrin signalled her intent to make a change when she [USN:L6N3ZF130 TEXT:"spoke to Reuters"] following her Olympic success.
"I feel that there's some kind of transition in my career coming closer," Shiffrin said.
"But I don't know what that looks like and I don't know how to say it."
After winning a record-equalling sixth World Cup overall crystal globe last season, the transition is also about putting off the day when she hangs up her skis.
"Ironically, the more predictable choice might be to race only slalom. From a purely results-oriented perspective, maybe that's the obvious move," Shiffrin said.
"But staying only where I've been most successful, rather than taking a risk and following my curiosity into something less known, feels like a faster path toward retirement."
Shiffrin has won the giant slalom globe twice, and her only super-G success came in 2019, in her best ever season when she also won the slalom, giant slalom overall titles.
The season begins with a giant slalom on October 24 in Solden, Austria.

THE HAGUE, Oct 6 : Thousands of administrative systems at wind and solar power parks in Europe are exposed to the internet, potentially giving attackers access to interfaces that can stop turbines and raising the risk of sabotage, Dutch researchers warned on Tuesday.
The exposed systems included administrative and login interfaces as well as operational interfaces showing data and controls.
However, one of the researchers, Soufian El Yadmani, from internet-scanning company Modat, told Reuters that researchers believed full control would have been possible in the case of around 181 sites.
One turbine's web page showed live data, "Start, Stop and Reset" buttons and the turbine's location, the research said. Some systems controlled several turbines or a whole farm.

"What we can map in hours, an attacker can map in hours too," the report said. The researchers urged operators to take admin interfaces off the internet immediately.
SPANISH SOLAR, GERMAN WIND MOST EXPOSED
The findings come amid concerns about Europe's critical infrastructure, which has faced suspected sabotage and cyberattacks frequently attributed by Western governments to Russia since its invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Russia denies any involvement. 
Last month, Dutch intelligence agencies, police and prosecutors warned that artificial intelligence was accelerating the threat.
El Yadmani and Bouke van Laethem of the Dutch National Cyber Security Centre presented their findings on Tuesday at the ONE Conference in The Hague.
Turbines or arrays closely linked to public infrastructure were a special concern, El Yadmani said. "If you can turn off the energy within the city or the airport, imagine that at a larger scale."
Using machine learning to sort and cluster data, the pair said they identified 8,547 internet-facing systems they could link to at specific solar parks (7,942) and wind farms (605) in 35 European countries, which should not have been exposed to the internet.
Most of the systems found were admin pages with login screens. 
Spain had the most exposed solar systems, with 2,766, followed by Greece with 1,860, they said. 
Germany has Europe's most installed solar capacity, and 672 exposed solar systems. However it had the most exposed wind systems with 212, with Italy close behind at 192. The researchers said the rankings partly reflected where they had been able to link systems to specific sites. 
The European Union Agency for Cybersecurity could not immediately comment. Authorities in Germany, Italy and Spain did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The report listed among its sources the Polish cybersecurity team CERT Polska's analysis of a December 2025 attack on 30 wind and solar sites in Poland, an example of the potential threat.

Source: Reuters

items.title: Ex-diretor do BC Renato Gomes assume comando da ABBC
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O economista Renato Gomes, ex-diretor de Organização do Sistema Financeiro e de Resolução do Banco Central, assumiu nesta terça-feira a presidência-executiva da Associação Brasileira de Bancos (ABBC), informou a entidade.
items.body:
O economista Renato Gomes, ex-diretor de Organização do Sistema Financeiro e de Resolução do Banco Central, assumiu nesta terça-feira a presidência-executiva da Associação Brasileira de Bancos (ABBC), informou a entidade.
Gomes sucede Leandro Vilain e terá a missão de dar continuidade às agendas de estabilidade, competitividade, segurança e inovação conduzidas pela associação no âmbito do Sistema Financeiro Nacional, disse a ABBC.
À frente da diretoria do BC entre 2022 e 2025, Gomes comandava a área que recomendou o veto à compra do Banco Master pelo BRB, em setembro de 2025.
Dois meses depois, o Master foi liquidado pelo BC em meio a uma grave crise de liquidez e por violações às normas do sistema financeiro, incluindo a venda de carteiras de crédito fraudulentas ao BRB. Na ocasião, a ABBC foi uma das entidades que [USN:L1N3XP0Q6 TEXT:"manifestaram"] apoio ao BC na condução da liquidação do banco, após ministro do Tribunal de Contas da União ter pedido explicações sobre o processo.
Desde o fim do mandato de Gomes no BC, em dezembro do ano passado, a cadeira permanece vaga e é ocupada interinamente pelo diretor de Regulação, Gilneu Vivan. O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ainda não indicou um substituto para o cargo, cuja nomeação depende também de aprovação posterior do Senado, onde o governo enfrenta obstáculos políticos.
Doutor em economia pela Northwestern University, nos Estados Unidos, Gomes atuou como professor da Toulouse School of Economics durante o período de quarentena após deixar o BC. Também foi pesquisador do Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique (CNRS) e do Centre for Economic Policy Research (CEPR) durante o período.
Atualmente, ele integra o comitê executivo do CGAP (Grupo Consultivo de Apoio aos Pobres, na sigla em inglês), centro de estudos do Banco Mundial voltado à inclusão financeira, e o Conselho Superior de Economia da Fiesp.

items.title: Trabajadores de mina chilena de cobre Centinela no llegan a acuerdo y podrían ir a huelga: gremios
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los trabajadores de mina chilena de cobre Centinela seguían el martes sin lograr un acuerdo contractual con Antofagasta Minerals en la última jornada de una mediación gubernamental y podrían activar la huelga, dijeron el martes los sindicatos.
items.body:
Los trabajadores de mina chilena de cobre Centinela seguían el martes sin lograr un acuerdo contractual con Antofagasta Minerals en la última jornada de una mediación gubernamental y podrían activar la huelga, dijeron el martes los sindicatos.
"Las asambleas han ratificado la decisión de hacer efectiva la huelga si la empresa no aborda un mecanismo que impida la discriminación durante la vigencia del contrato colectivo", dijeron en un comunicado.
El martes vencen los cinco días de la mediación que, sin embargo, se podrían extender por igual lapso con el acuerdo de ambas partes.

items.body:
[６日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権が中国と原子力施設の相互訪問の開始について協議しており、今後数カ月の対面会合で引き続きその実現を働きかけていく方針であることが分かった。協議は非公式かつ予備的な段階にある。ＣＮＮが６日、関係筋の話として報じた。

報道によると、相互訪問の構想は今年、米政府当局者との会合で中国側が最初に持ち出した。より大きな合意への道筋をつけ得る信頼醸成措置に、中国が前向きになる可能性を示唆する動きだとされる。関係筋によると、協議では米エネルギー省傘下の国立研究所と、中国側の同等施設への訪問が議論された。米国は核実験場への訪問についても議論する用意があるという。

原子力施設の相互訪問を認めるという構想は、戦略的安定性に関する問題で中国を関与させようとする米国の取り組みを前進させ、三国間協定の足掛かりとなる可能性があるが、中国は自国の核増強を制限しかねない協議には応じないとの姿勢を崩していないもよう。

items.title: With baby on way, Jon Rahm WDs from Spanish Open
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: World No. 15 Jon Rahm has withdrawn from the Spanish Open as he and his wife, Kelley, await the birth of the couple's fourth child.
items.body:
World No. 15 Jon Rahm has withdrawn from the Spanish Open as he and his wife, Kelley, await the birth of the couple's fourth child.
The Spaniard has won his national open on three occasions, matching the record set by his boyhood hero, Seve Ballesteros.
Rahm, 31, is coming off his third individual season LIV Golf title in as many years since joining the league. He signed a deal that reportedly has more than $100 million remaining on it, and he acknowledged in May that it has multiple years remaining.
However, he may have an option to get out of that contract with LIV Golf planning to significantly reduce prize purses should it be able to conduct a 2027 season.
Rahm won in Hong Kong and Mexico City this season on the LIV Golf circuit and finished runner-up four times.
He is expected to compete in the DP World Tour's season-ending events in Abu Dhabi and Dubai.
--Field Level Media

items.title: US seeks to keep law firm DEI probe records secret
items.author: Mike Scarcella
items.creator: Mike Scarcella
items.summary: President Donald Trump's administration has asked a US judge to allow the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission to withhold a “significant” amount of information related to its probe into the employment and diversity practices of major law firms.
items.body:
President Donald Trump's administration has asked a US judge to allow the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission to withhold a “significant” amount of information related to its probe into the employment and diversity practices of major law firms.
In a court filing on Monday in Washington, government lawyers said the EEOC could neither confirm nor deny whether any law firm that received the agency's [USN:L1N3Q010H TEXT:"requests for information"] last year was the subject of a formal employment discrimination charge.
The agency argued that federal law protects the confidentiality of whether or not an employer was subject to a charge.
The filing came in response to lawsuits by advocacy group Public Citizen and law professors Elise Bernlohr Maizel and Christopher Hampson seeking records related to the EEOC's request for information about diversity, equity and inclusion policies at 20 of the largest law firms in the US.
The EEOC and Justice Department did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Public Citizen, Maizel and Hampson also did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The filing marks a new flashpoint in the administration’s crackdown on law firm hiring practices and its bid to eliminate DEI programs, which the Republican president made an early focus in his second White House term.
In March 2025, acting EEOC Chair Andrea Lucas sought information from 20 large law firms about diversity-related employment programs and practices that she said could violate federal anti-discrimination law.
Four of the firms — Kirkland & Ellis, Latham & Watkins, Simpson Thacher and A&O Shearman — entered into agreements with the EEOC, the agency said in April 2025. The agency’s court filing did not disclose any settlement terms. The law firms did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
The four law firms are among nine that pledged nearly $1 billion in free legal work to causes supported by the White House to avoid Trump's executive orders against law firms last year.
The EEOC broadly argued that records of its communications with the law firms, including any confidential settlement discussions, are exempt from public disclosure. The agency also said it could not disclose any of the workforce information that the law firms provided. The firms submitted that information under an expectation of confidentiality, the EEOC said.
The EEOC invoked a legal shield called the presidential communications privilege to withhold relevant emails involving senior White House advisers. The agency also said it was withholding emails submitted through a tip line created last year to collect information about DEI practices at law firms.
“Revealing the emails would disclose the identity of the tipster given that the facts disclosed would be known by only a few individuals,” the filing said.
The cases are Public Citizen v. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, US District Court for the District of Columbia, No. 1:25-cv-04457-BAH, and Elise Maizel et al v. EEOC, same court, No. 1:26-cv-0494.
For Public Citizen: Michael Kirkpatrick and Adina Rosenbaum of Public Citizen Litigation Group
For Maizel: Mason Kortz of Harvard Law School
For US: Brian Levy of the Justice Department

items.title: South Africa central bank says second-round inflation risks rise
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: South Africa's central bank said on Tuesday that the risk of second-round inflation effects had become more pronounced as oil prices stayed higher for longer and El Nino clouded the outlook.
items.body:
South Africa's central bank said on Tuesday that the risk of second-round inflation effects had become more pronounced as oil prices stayed higher for longer and El Nino clouded the outlook.
The South African Reserve Bank (SARB) said it would act decisively to stop a temporary rise in inflation from becoming entrenched, as a persistent oil price shock and El Nino increasingly weigh on the outlook
South Africa is a net fuel importer, which leaves it particularly exposed to higher global oil prices
In its twice-yearly Monetary Policy Review, the SARB said it only expects inflation to fall back to its 3% target in the fourth quarter of 2027 while remaining well above its 1 percentage point tolerance band for the rest of the year
Headline [USN:L8N45F0GM TEXT:"inflation "]in Africa's largest economy was 4.4% in August, the latest data from its statistics agency showed
"... the risk of large second-round effects is increasing as the initial oil shock lasts longer and new shocks emerge," the SARB said
The bank's Monetary Policy Committee has raised rates by a cumulative 50 basis points between April and October this year, with the last hike in [USN:L8N45F0Z7 TEXT:"September"]. The bank said it now expects the real policy rate to remain restrictive before converging to neutral from the second half of 2028
An analysis by the SARB showed that the risk of second-round effects, meaning more generalised inflation with rising wages and prices, had increased as the shock persists.
"Policy must guard against the risk that persistent fuel, administered price and food shocks become embedded in expectations and wages, thereby undermining the credibility of the target," it said
The SARB's final rate-setting meeting is in mid-November

items.title: US Senator Warren presses federal housing director to cooperate with probe
items.author: Chris Prentice
items.creator: Chris Prentice
items.summary: Democratic US Senator Elizabeth Warren on Tuesday pressed Federal Housing Finance Agency Director Bill Pulte, an ally of President Donald Trump, to cooperate with a congressional watchdog's inquiry into his criminal referrals of alleged mortgage fraud.
items.body:
Democratic US Senator Elizabeth Warren on Tuesday pressed Federal Housing Finance Agency Director Bill Pulte, an ally of President Donald Trump , to cooperate with a congressional watchdog's inquiry into his criminal referrals of alleged mortgage fraud.
In a letter sent to Pulte and seen by Reuters, Warren said she believes the FHFA is obstructing inquiries from the Government Accountability Office, a nonpartisan government agency.
Critics say Pulte has politicized the historically low-profile FHFA since he took the helm in March 2025, including publicly referring to the Department of Justice allegations of mortgage fraud by several of Trump's perceived foes. Those accused have denied the allegations.
A spokesperson for the FHFA, which was created in response to the 2008 housing crisis to oversee mortgage giants Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, said in a statement that the agency always engages with GAO inquiries.
"The Agency has responded to every one of GAO's inquiries received this past fiscal year," the spokesperson said.
Pulte has previously defended the referrals as part of his efforts to root out misconduct and fraud in mortgage markets.
"GAO is working with the agency and Congress to obtain the information we need to conduct our work," a spokesperson said in a statement, declining to say more about the ongoing efforts.
Last year, Warren of Massachusetts and several other Democratic senators [USN:L6N3WT1IL TEXT:"pressed the GAO"] to investigate Pulte's conduct, concerned that the referrals were politically motivated and misused government resources.
Warren, the top Democrat on the Senate Banking Committee that oversees the FHFA, said in the letter that it is her understanding that the agency is not complying with the GAO's requests for information.
"Such obstruction is illegal and may generate unnecessary costs, inhibit GAO's ability to protect taxpayers, and hinder congressional oversight," Warren wrote.
Warren's letter follows the FHFA's move last week to slash funding to its Office of Inspector General, which it said would bring its budget in line with peers. The OIG's top official subsequently warned the cuts [USN:L1N45N0M4 TEXT:"will force it to slash staff"] and make it impossible to probe misconduct.
That move also sparked scrutiny from Warren and other fellow Democrats. Catherine Cortez Masto of Nevada and Jack Reed of Rhode Island, also members of the Senate Banking Committee, have asked to summon Pulte to testify at a hearing.
items.raw_description: Democratic US Senator Elizabeth Warren on Tuesday pressed Federal Housing Finance Agency Director Bill Pulte, an ally of President Donald Trump, to cooperate with a congressional watchdog's inquiry into his criminal referrals of alleged mortgage fraud.

items.title: Mayoría de monedas sube; activos brasileños se estabilizan tras dispararse en la víspera
items.author: Manuel Farías
items.creator: Manuel Farías
items.summary: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subían el martes por una baja global del dólar en medio del descenso de los rendimientos de los bonos y de los precios del crudo, que reducían los temores sobre la inflación, mientras que los activos brasileños se estabilizaban tras la fuerte alza de la víspera después de la primera vuelta presidencial.
items.body:
La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subían el martes por una baja global del dólar en medio del descenso de los rendimientos de los bonos y de los precios del crudo, que reducían los temores sobre la inflación, mientras que los activos brasileños se estabilizaban tras la fuerte alza de la víspera después de la primera vuelta presidencial.
* El índice dólar , que mide el desempeño del billete verde frente a una canasta de monedas pares, perdía un 0,26% y se encaminaba a su mayor baja diaria desde el 25 de septiembre, debido principalmente al avance del euro después de caer en la víspera a su mínimo de 17 meses. La moneda única avanzaba ante el descenso de los retornos de los bonos franceses, que aliviaban los temores sobre la deuda de la zona euro.
* La rentabilidad de la deuda de Estados Unidos también retrocedía. Por su parte, los precios del crudo caían con fuerza ante un aumento de los flujos procedentes de Oriente Medio y la liberación de reservas de diésel por parte del G7.
* El real brasileño ganaba un 0,3% a 4,9782 por dólar, al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) descendía un 0,67% a 205.529 puntos, tras avanzar más temprano hasta un 1% en medio de ajustes y con atención en las elecciones presidenciales.
* En la víspera, el real escaló más de un 4% en su mayor avance diario desde el 8 de junio de 2018, mientras que el Bovespa se disparó hasta máximos históricos después del resultado de la primera vuelta electoral del domingo, cuando el senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro llegó por sobre el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, en un desempeño que superó las proyecciones de las encuestas.
* Flávio y Lula dirimirán la contienda presidencial en un balotaje el 25 de octubre.
* El peso mexicano subía un 0,5%, a 17,982 unidades por dólar, marcando su tercer avance seguido; en tanto que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, ganaba un 0,5%, a 65.299,57 puntos, también en su tercera sesión consecutiva de alzas.
* El peso chileno , subía un 0,57%, a 968,30/968,60 unidades por dólar, en medio del retroceso del billete verde en los mercados globales. Asimismo, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , avanzaba un 0,32%, a 11.159,12 puntos.
* El peso colombiano se debilitaba un 0,56% a 3.218 unidades por dólar, tras dos sesiones al alza; mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) escalaba un 0,29% a 2.590,24 puntos.
* El peso mayorista argentino apenas subía un leve 0,03% a 1.520 por dólar, con la intervención cotidiana del banco central (BCRA) mediante la absorción de divisas para respaldar sus reservas internacionales. El índice accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires ganaba un 0,6%, ampliando el avance del 3,68% del lunes.
* La moneda peruana, el sol , operaba estable a 3,4350/3,4360 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) subía un leve 0,19% a 1.586,25 puntos.

items.title: Fed de Nueva York dice presiones en la cadena de suministro aumentaron el mes pasado respecto a agosto
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las presiones sobre la cadena de suministro se intensificaron ligeramente en septiembre, según un informe publicado el martes por el Banco de la Reserva Federal de Nueva York.
items.body:
Las presiones sobre la cadena de suministro se intensificaron ligeramente en septiembre, según un informe publicado el martes por el Banco de la Reserva Federal de Nueva York.
El banco informó de que su último Índice de Presión de la Cadena de Suministro Global subió a 1,28 en septiembre, frente al 1,20 —revisado al alza— registrado en agosto. El comunicado no especificó qué factores impulsaron la evolución reciente del índice, diseñado para medir el funcionamiento de las cadenas de suministro globales.
Aunque el índice de septiembre aumentó, las presiones sobre la cadena de suministro se han reducido con respecto a su máximo más reciente de 1,81 registrado en mayo, que, aunque elevado, estaba muy por debajo del valor de 4,43 alcanzado en diciembre de 2021, que reflejaba las perturbaciones generalizadas causadas por la pandemia de COVID-19.
Las elevadas presiones en la cadena de suministro pueden contribuir al aumento de las presiones inflacionarias. Los responsables de la Fed elevaron su objetivo de tasas de interés el mes pasado y previeron otra subida para finales de año, como parte de un intento por ayudar a que las elevadas presiones sobre los precios vuelvan al objetivo del 2%.

items.title: Texas AG Paxton probes Fruit of the Loom, Hanes over potential toxic chemicals in children's underwear
items.author: Jonathan Stempel
items.creator: Jonathan Stempel
items.summary: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton launched an investigation on Tuesday into whether Fruit of the Loom and Hanes use toxic chemicals in producing children's underwear.
items.body:
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton launched an investigation on Tuesday into whether Fruit of the Loom and Hanes use toxic chemicals in producing children's underwear.
Paxton said he sent civil investigative demands to Fruit of the Loom, which is owned by Berkshire Hathaway (BRKa.N) , and Hanes, which is owned by Gildan Activewear (GIL.TO) , citing the chemicals' potential effects on children's health. He did not accuse either company of wrongdoing.
Fruit of the Loom, Berkshire and Gildan did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Paxton said clothing manufacturers have turned increasingly to synthetic materials such as polyester, rayon and spandex to meet consumer demand for lower-priced products.
He said research shows that synthetic fabrics can shed microplastics, while chemicals including bisphenols, fluorine, parabens, phthalates and so-called "forever chemicals" used in textile manufacturing have been associated with cancer, hormone disruption, infertility and other health concerns.
"We must protect our children who cannot yet protect themselves," Paxton said in a statement. "This includes making sure that the necessities parents rely on are free from toxic chemicals and do not harm the health of kids."
The attorney general announced a [USN:L6N40W10V TEXT:"similar probe"] in April into whether Lululemon Athletica (LULU.O) activewear contained forever chemicals, which do not break down easily in nature. Forever chemicals are also known as PFAS, short for per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances.
Paxton, a Republican, is running for a US Senate seat against Democrat James Talarico and trailing in most polls. The race is among the country's most closely watched in the November 3 midterm elections.
