items.title: Líder separatista catalão Puigdemont deve retornar à Espanha após tribunal revogar mandado de prisão
items.author: Joan Faus, Emma Pinedo
items.creator: Joan Faus, Emma Pinedo
items.summary: Os dois principais tribunais da Espanha abriram caminho, nesta terça-feira, para que o líder separatista catalão Carles Puigdemont, autoexilado, possa retornar sem ser preso, justamente quando a Espanha se prepara para eleições nacionais antecipadas.
items.body:
Os dois principais tribunais da Espanha abriram caminho, nesta terça-feira, para que o líder separatista catalão Carles Puigdemont, autoexilado, possa retornar sem ser preso, justamente quando a Espanha se prepara para eleições nacionais antecipadas.
O Tribunal Constitucional decidiu que uma lei de anistia para separatistas catalães se aplica às acusações de peculato contra Puigdemont. Pouco depois, o Supremo Tribunal respondeu revogando o mandado de prisão contra Puigdemont.
O provável retorno do ex-chefe de governo catalão pode desestabilizar ainda mais um cenário político já volátil antes das eleições de 29 de novembro. Puigdemont fugiu para a Bélgica em 2017 após realizar um referendo de independência para sua região, que Madri havia declarado ilegal.
“É uma grande vitória para o presidente Puigdemont e os outros dois líderes exilados” na Bélgica, disse Jordi Turull, secretário-geral do partido Junts, de Puigdemont, aos repórteres. “Eles se mantiveram firmes, resistiram, prevaleceram na Europa e hoje prevaleceram contra o Estado espanhol.”
Ele se recusou a dizer quando Puigdemont poderia retornar, mas descartou a possibilidade de ele concorrer nas próximas eleições.
O primeiro-ministro da Espanha, Pedro Sánchez, havia promulgado a anistia no âmbito de um acordo de 2023 entre seu Partido Socialista e dois partidos catalães, incluindo o Junts, de Puigdemont, em troca do apoio deles para que ele permanecesse como primeiro-ministro. A medida provocou intensa oposição social e política por parte dos críticos do governo na época.
O Supremo Tribunal havia inicialmente decidido que a anistia não se aplicava ao crime de peculato, o que significava que Puigdemont e outros ainda poderiam ser presos sob a acusação de desviar os recursos gastos no referendo.
Mas o Tribunal Constitucional, que conta com uma maioria de tendência progressista, decidiu, em recurso, que negar a anistia para o crime de desvio de verbas não relacionado ao enriquecimento pessoal violaria o objetivo da lei de anistia.
“A decisão está em linha com as expectativas, pois sempre defendemos que a lei de anistia era constitucional e também compatível com a legislação da União Europeia”, disse o advogado de Puigdemont, Gonzalo Boye, à Reuters.
Há um ano, o Junts retirou seu apoio ao governo central minoritário da Espanha. Incapaz de aprovar leis, Sánchez convocou eleições antecipadas na segunda-feira. Sánchez disse aos repórteres nesta terça-feira que não se arrependeu de ter lançado a anistia e acolheu com satisfação a decisão do tribunal.
“Acredito que a mensagem importante seja a da coexistência entre os catalães”, disse ele.
Embora o separatismo tenha perdido força e o Junts esteja atrás nas pesquisas de opinião, o retorno de Puigdemont pode desencadear um novo drama político.
O Partido Popular, de direita, lidera as pesquisas de opinião antes das eleições e pode precisar buscar o apoio do Junts e de outros partidos de centro-direita para governar.
A Catalunha declarou unilateralmente a independência da Espanha em 2017, após o referendo. Embora cerca de 90% dos eleitores tenham apoiado a independência, os catalães que queriam permanecer como parte da Espanha boicotaram em grande parte a votação, e muitas seções eleitorais foram fechadas.
Puigdemont fugiu do país, enquanto vários de seus ex-ministros, incluindo Turull, permaneceram no país e foram presos, sendo posteriormente perdoados por Sánchez.
(Reportagem de Joan Faus e Emma Pinedo)

New Delhi: OpenAI will start adding an invisible watermark to text generated by ChatGPT and Codex for users in the European Union (EU), the company announced on Monday. The step is aimed at complying with the EU Artificial Intelligence (AI) Act, which requires AI companies to make generated content identifiable by machines.

According to OpenAI, the watermark will be rolled out to eligible ChatGPT and Codex users across all plans in the EU “over the coming weeks”. Developers using OpenAI’s API anywhere in the world, including India, can turn on watermarking for select models from Monday, though the feature will remain off by default. Access to the tool that detects the watermark will, for now, be restricted to approved researchers and expert organisations.

ChatGPT users outside the EU will not see any change. “We are not making text watermarking a global default at launch,” the company said in a blog post, adding that the regional rollout would allow it to learn from real-world use and feedback.

Show Full Article

What EU law says
Article 50 of the EU AI Act, which came into effect on 2 August, requires providers of generative AI systems to mark text, images, audio and video in a machine-readable format so that they can be detected as AI-generated. Violations of the Act’s transparency obligations can attract fines of up to €15 million or 3 per cent of a company’s global annual turnover, whichever is higher.

In June, the European Commission published a voluntary Code of Practice laying down how companies can meet these requirements. Signatories are presumed to be in compliance with the law. Anthropic has said that around 190 organisations have signed the code. The rules also require deepfakes and AI-generated text published on matters of public interest to be labelled, and users to be informed when they are interacting with a chatbot.

OpenAI said access to its detector would be granted on a case-by-case basis “in accordance with the Code of Practice”.

Also Read: ‘I am Giorgia’: Ahead of polls, Italy PM Meloni wants voice trademarked before AI puts words in her mouth

How the watermark works
OpenAI’s system, called textGrain, works by embedding a statistical pattern in the words a model chooses while writing a response. Language models generate text one word at a time, and at many points, more than one word fits the sentence equally well. Normally, the choice between them is random. A watermark replaces this randomness with a pattern linked to a secret key, which a detector can later look for.

The company said the watermark does not add any visible marks or special characters to the text. It also does not identify the user, organisation, account, prompt or conversation.

In its post, OpenAI framed the purpose narrowly, saying the watermark helps answer a single question: “Was this likely generated by an OpenAI model?”

Where it falls short
OpenAI also published data on the system’s limitations. At a target false positive rate of 1 per cent, its detector identified the watermark in about 80 per cent of 200-token passages and about 95 per cent of 400-token passages on psychology-related content. Detection rates were lower for mathematics, where the model has fewer options in word choice.

Editing the text weakened the signal. In 400-token passages, replacing 10 per cent of the words with synonyms brought detection down from about 92 per cent to 66 per cent. When 25 per cent of the words were replaced, it fell to 17 per cent.

“Rewriting or translating text can completely remove the watermark,” the company said.

OpenAI claimed textGrain “matched or exceeded” the other methods it tested, including Google’s SynthID for text, but cautioned that results under test conditions may not hold in everyday use. On output quality, the company said watermarking did not affect the performance of Astra, its latest frontier model. On the GPQA Diamond benchmark, Astra scored 94.44 per cent without the watermark and 93.94 per cent with it. On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, the scores were 49.57 and 49.76 points respectively.

OpenAI also listed what a detection result cannot establish. It does not indicate how much a human edited the text, who owns it, who is responsible for it, or whether it is accurate. Equally, the absence of a watermark does not prove a human wrote the text, since it may be too short, edited, translated, produced by an older model or generated by another company’s tool.

Also Read: What is Griffin AI? World’s first ‘human interaction model’ passes Turing Test

Anthropic’s approach
Anthropic took a different route. In a post published on 14 August, the company said all Claude models released after 2 August embed a watermark in the text they generate, and that the change applies worldwide with no option for users to switch it off. This means Claude users in India are already receiving watermarked text from newer models.

Anthropic said it applied the watermark globally because it does “not yet have a durable way to scope it by region”, and that it would continue to evaluate other approaches.

Its method is based on SynthID-Text, a technique Google DeepMind described in a paper published in Nature in 2024. Anthropic said the watermark does not affect the quality of Claude’s responses, does not add hidden characters, does not use extra tokens and carries no information that could be traced to a user or a conversation.

The company acknowledged similar limitations. The watermark is weaker in code, factual passages and light proofreading, where most of the words belong to the user, and a complete rewrite removes it. Translations done by Claude, however, carry the watermark since every word is chosen by the model.

Anthropic has made a detection tool available in private preview to regulators, law enforcement agencies, media organisations, fact-checkers, researchers, educational institutions and EU civil society groups. Image files generated by Claude now carry a signed credential in their metadata under the C2PA industry standard. The company said older Claude models will get the watermark over the coming months.

Google DeepMind added SynthID-Text to Gemini in 2024 and released the code as open source for developers. According to Anthropic, Google tested the watermark on a section of Gemini users and found no difference in how they rated the responses.

A shift for OpenAI
The announcement marks a change in OpenAI’s position. In 2024, the company said it had developed a text watermarking method but was not releasing it, citing concerns that it could be bypassed through translation or rewording, and that it could unfairly affect non-native English speakers who use AI tools to improve their writing.

On Monday, OpenAI said its approach “must reflect the practical limits of current technology”. The company said it will extend watermarking to its models offered through cloud partners in the coming weeks, publish more technical details on textGrain and eventually release it as open source.

“We expect to revisit each part of this approach as the technology, standards, and evidence evolve,” OpenAI said.

items.title: Sebi says Jane Street’s appeal for more details a delaying ploy
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: Sebi has called Jane Street’s demand for additional documents a “dilatory” tactic as the Wall Street trading firm challenges the regulator’s market manipulation allegations. The dispute centres on Jane Street’s trading in Nifty Bank derivatives. The outcome could influence how global trading firms assess regulatory risks in India’s derivatives market, with the hearing set to continue Wednesday.
items.body: India’s markets regulator called Jane Street Group LLC’s demand for additional documents a “dilatory” tactic, a day after the Wall Street trading giant pressed for more information about the origins of the investigation against it.Gaurav Joshi, a lawyer representing the Securities and Exchange Board of India, opened Tuesday’s arguments with a Hindi proverb that roughly translated to “the thief reprimanding the police,” suggesting that Jane Street was trying to turn the accusations against the regulator. The hearing will continue on Wednesday.The firm is seeking to question SEBI’s conduct instead of explaining its trading strategy and responding to the interim order, Joshi told a local court. The regulator was only required to provide documents it relied on to pass its order, and furnishing additional information could harm the ongoing probe, he argued.The outcome of the case could shape global trading firms’ perceptions of the risks associated with operating in one of the world’s largest derivatives markets. Central to the controversy is SEBI’s allegation that Jane Street affected the pricing of stocks in the NSE Nifty Bank Index, a closely watched benchmark that serves as the foundation for heavily traded options contracts.Read More: Jane Street Denies Manipulation Charges in India Appeal Case (1)SEBI’s July 3, 2025 interim order temporarily banned the firm from trading in Indian securities and ordered the seizure of 48.4 billion rupees ($503 million) of alleged unlawful gains. Jane Street deposited the amount in an escrow account but hasn’t resumed trading in the country.The SEBI lawyer said that it was for Jane Street to explain why its strategy does not amount to market manipulation, adding that the Wall Street trader has “succeeded in delaying” the matter for a year and a half. Jane Street has been seeking additional documents and internal emails from the regulator to mount its defense against the interim order. On Monday, it questioned the origins of the investigation after SEBI’s surveillance department and the National Stock Exchange cleared it of any manipulation. Joshi told the tribunal that the NSE report was “preliminary”, while an earlier review by the regulator was a “pre-investigative” finding. He also cited NSE’s caution letter to the trading firm and accused Jane Street of disregarding it.

items.title: ロシアのペスト研究所職員死亡、接触者に感染確認されず＝衛生当局
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [モスクワ／シェレホフ（ロシア）　６日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ／シェレホフ（ロシア）　６日　ロイター] - ロシアの衛生監視機関である消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁（ロスポトレブナゾール）は６日、２日に死亡したシベリアのペスト研究所職員と接触した人の間で、ペストの発症例は確認されていないと発表した。

ロシアでは、東シベリアのイルクーツク近郊にあるシベリア・極東ペスト対策研究所に勤めていた２８歳の女性研究員が原因不明の肺炎で死亡。この件を巡っては、トランプ米大統領を含む国際社会から懸念の声が上がっている。

ロスポトレブナゾールは声明で、同研究所の職員の間で過去１０日間に感染症の報告はなく、詳しい検査でも死亡した女性の体内から業務に関連する微生物は見つからなかったと発表。公衆衛生関連法に基づき包括的な防疫措置を直ちに実施し、患者と接触した可能性のある人を病院での医学観察下で検査を毎日実施した結果、接触者の中に感染症に関連する健康状態の変化がみられた者はいなかったと明らかにした。

イルクーツク近郊シェレホフ地区のソフィナ副地区長も、危険な感染症は確認されなかったと述べた。同地区では地元の病院が隔離措置の対象となっているが、隔離された人の約６０％はすでに解除されたという。

LONDON, Oct 6 : US start-up Type One Energy has raised $200 million from investors including the venture unit of Germany's Siemens Energy, as it vies to build the world's first commercial fusion reactor, its chief executive told Reuters.
The Series-B round, which takes total funding to-date to more than $400 million, is the third-biggest sector Series B raise over the last five years, data from industry tracker PitchBook showed. The company did not disclose its valuation.
Fusion energy has been researched for decades. A wave of firms has launched in recent years as advances in magnets, computing and materials have fuelled hopes fusion technology could one day provide abundant clean power across the globe.
Type One is backed by Bill Gates' Breakthrough Energy Ventures and Clutterbuck Capital. It is developing a stellarator, a type of fusion reactor that uses complex magnetic fields to contain superheated plasma, partnering with engineering, construction and other companies to speed up delivery and reduce costs.

Chief Executive Christofer Mowry said the funds would help further develop its technology, including the deployment of an engineering prototype machine, Infinity One.
"It's not an experimental science project... the only thing that we want to learn is that our design for the fusion machine in the power plant works as advertised."
Project Infinity is based at Bull Run in Tennessee and Type One hopes to launch the commercial plant, Infinity Two, within a decade. It aims to work towards a manufacturing partnership with Siemens.
Enrique Gonzalez Zanetich, partner at Siemens Energy Ventures, said in a statement that the deal strengthened his company's position in fusion "as we continue to explore the technologies and collaborations that can help advance commercialization".
New investors alongside Siemens included Lowercarbon Capital, co-founded by early Uber backer Chris Sacca, and SiteGround Capital.

items.title: ¿Cuánta deuda pública le corresponde a cada persona? Estos son los países con mayor deuda per cápita en Latinoamérica
items.author: Daniel Salazar Castellanos
items.summary: Estados Unidos y Japón encabezan el listado de deuda pública per cápita, con más de US$110.000 por habitante. Así les va a los países latinoamericanos.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — La deuda pública supera los US$110.000 por habitante en Estados Unidos y Japón, los dos países con mayor nivel de endeudamiento per cápita entre 39 economías analizadas en el mundo, según una revisión de Visual Capitalist. “Estados Unidos y Japón sostienen deudas que serían inmanejables en América Latina porque el dólar es la moneda de reserva y Japón financia a su Estado con ahorro interno, y por eso en ambos el riesgo aparece primero en las tasas largas y en la moneda, mucho antes que en una dificultad de pago”, dijo a Bloomberg Línea Jonathan Fortun, economista del Instituto Internacional de Finanzas (IIF). Estados Unidos registra una deuda pér capita de US$113.348 y Japón de US$110.667. Italia ocupa el tercer lugar, con US$94.002 por persona, casi el doble que la de Alemania, según datos de la Organización para la Cooperación y el Desarrollo Económicos (OCDE) para 2025 ajustados por paridad de poder adquisitivo. Por Latinoamérica, Argentina (US$11.146), Brasil (US$10.106), Chile (US$8.506) y México (US$8.577) figuran con las deudas más altas por habitante entre las mayores economías. Sin embargo, una postal más amplia del IIF en la región muestra que Panamá (US$14.338) y Costa Rica (US$13.105) les superan. Ver más: Los países más endeudados de América Latina, luego de que la deuda global rompiera otro récord Visual Capitalist indica que el nivel de deuda por habitante no determina por sí solo la capacidad de un país para cumplir con sus obligaciones. También influyen el tamaño de su economía, el costo del financiamiento, su capacidad para generar ingresos fiscales y el apetito de los inversores por su deuda. “La deuda pública per cápita permite comparar cuánto endeudamiento público existe por habitante entre los países, evitando que las diferencias de población dominen la comparación”, explica a Bloomberg Líne a Felipe Oyarzún, analista de mercados de la ‘app’ de inversiones XTB. “Eso ayuda a poner en una misma escala economías muy distintas, pero no necesariamente permite concluir cuál tiene una situación fiscal más débil, porque una cifra elevada también puede responder a un mayor nivel de ingreso y producción por persona”, anotó. Por ejemplo, según Oyarzún, aunque Chile y México aparecen con niveles muy similares de deuda pública por habitante, eso no significa que enfrenten una carga fiscal equivalente. La cercanía entre ambas cifras se explica, en parte, porque Chile tiene una deuda total bastante menor, pero también una población mucho más pequeña, de modo que al dividir el stock de deuda por habitante los resultados terminan acercándose, indicó el analista. La diferencia aparece con mucha más claridad cuando se compara esa deuda con el tamaño de cada economía, porque esa deuda pesa más sobre el tamaño de la economía mexicana que sobre la chilena. “Chile es más rico y debe 42% del PIB, y su riesgo está en la velocidad, porque multiplicó su deuda casi por once desde 2007, aunque hoy reduce el déficit y se financia a 10 años por debajo de su crecimiento nominal”, expuso Fortun. México debe 55% del PIB, crece poco y se financia a 9,6% a 10 años, unos cinco puntos sobre su crecimiento nominal, con Pemex como riesgo latente y S&P en perspectiva negativa, añadió el economista del IIF. “Para el tamaño de sus economías ninguno de los dos niveles me parece alto, y la señal a seguir está en la tendencia chilena y en el costo mexicano”. Ver más: Cepal revela la lista de países que más crecerán y se contraerán en 2026 y 2027 en Latinoamérica Esa misma lógica ayuda a entender por qué Estados Unidos y Japón pueden superar los US$110.000 de deuda pública por habitante sin que esa cifra signifique, por sí sola, que estén cerca de una crisis fiscal. “En ambos casos se trata de economías grandes, con altos niveles de ingreso y una capacidad de financiamiento mucho mayor que la de un país emergente”, indicó Oyarzún. “Estados Unidos cuenta además con el mercado de bonos soberanos más profundo del mundo y con la ventaja de emitir deuda en dólares, la principal moneda de reserva global”. Por su parte, Japón financia su deuda en yenes, tiene una base amplia de inversionistas domésticos y vencimientos largos, lo que reduce parte del riesgo de refinanciamiento. “Eso les permite sostener niveles de deuda mucho más altos, aunque no significa que esa deuda deje de ser un problema”. En Estados Unidos, los déficits elevados y el mayor costo de intereses siguen empujando la deuda al alza, mientras que en Japón el envejecimiento de la población y el aumento gradual de las tasas mantienen presión sobre las cuentas públicas, por lo que la capacidad de sostener la deuda depende finalmente de que el crecimiento, los ingresos fiscales y el costo de financiamiento evolucionen de forma compatible con esos niveles de endeudamiento. “De los dos, el que más me preocupa hoy es Estados Unidos, porque su deuda sube por un déficit primario cercano a 4% del PIB que no muestra señales de corregirse, con intereses netos que ya equivalen a 13% de los ingresos públicos y un bono a 10 años en 5,3%”, según Fortun. De acuerdo con Visual Capitalist, estos son los países con mayor nivel de endeudamiento per cápita: Jonathan Fortun, economista del IIF, expone que la deuda por habitante refleja sobre todo “cuán rico es un país y dónde está su moneda, porque sube con el ingreso y con el tipo de cambio, así que como medida de riesgo fiscal sirve poco”. “Lo que define la sostenibilidad es cuánto cuesta financiar esa deuda frente a lo que crece la economía y qué saldo primario puede sostener cada gobierno, y con esa vara Brasil y Colombia están hoy en una posición más frágil que Japón, que debe el doble de su PIB”, señaló. En Brasil y Colombia la deuda se financia a tasas que superan con holgura el crecimiento nominal y el ajuste fiscal sigue pendiente. Brasil ya tiene una deuda bruta del Gobierno general equivalente al 83% del PIB y paga intereses cercanos al 9% del PIB. Como una parte importante de la deuda está vinculada a la tasa Selic y a la inflación, el saldo puede seguir aumentando incluso con un déficit primario reducido. Por eso, la segunda vuelta de las elecciones a la Presidencia del 25 de octubre será relevante, sobre todo por las decisiones que tome el próximo gobierno sobre el gasto público. En Colombia, la deuda es menor y equivale al 65% del PIB del Gobierno central. Sin embargo, el nuevo gobierno elevó la proyección de déficit al 7,2% del PIB para este año y al 9,4% para 2027, mientras el rendimiento del bono local a 10 años supera el 13%. Otro ejemplo es el de Argentina, en donde se registra un superávit fiscal y se proyecta que la deuda del Gobierno central baje del 78% del PIB en 2025 al 65% en 2027. Esto siempre que la inflación continúe reduciendo el peso de la deuda en moneda local y el peso se mantenga estable, dado que una parte importante de las obligaciones está denominada en dólares. “En Bolivia la cifra por habitante engaña más que en cualquier otro país de la región. Con el tipo de cambio de hoy, la deuda pública ronda los US$3.700 por persona, una de las más bajas de la región, y aun así esta supera el 100% del PIB”, indicó Fortun. El endeudamiento global aumentó en más de US$10 billones durante los primeros seis meses del año y superó los US$365 billones, según el Global Debt Monitor del Institute of International Finance (IIF). El aumento fue menor que los US$21 billones registrados en igual periodo de 2025. El IIF atribuyó la moderación de este año a las tasas al alza, mayores costos del servicio de deuda, el encarecimiento de la energía y el impacto del conflicto con Irán. La relación entre deuda y PIB ronda el 310%, unos 25 puntos porcentuales por debajo del máximo de comienzos de 2021. Sin embargo, el IIF advierte que esa reducción responde principalmente al efecto de la inflación sobre el crecimiento nominal. Para el IIF, el resultado es una “imagen engañosamente benigna que oculta un aumento mucho más pronunciado de los costos del servicio de la deuda”, a medida que las obligaciones se refinancian a tasas más altas. Las diferencias también son amplias dentro de América Latina y el Caribe. Brasil encabeza la muestra del IIF por deuda gubernamental como porcentaje del PIB al segundo trimestre de 2026, seguido por El Salvador y Trinidad y Tobago. items.title: Wahl von AfD-Landtagspräsidenten in Magdeburg löst Koalitionsdebatte aus
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: In Deutschland gibt es erstmals einen Parlamentspräsidenten aus den Reihen der in Teilen als rechtsextrem eingestuften AfD. Der Landtag in Sachsen-Anhalt wählte in seiner konstituierenden Sitzung am Dienstag den AfD-Abgeordneten Tobias Rausch zu seinem Präsidenten. Weil er bei der geheimen Wahl 48 der 82 abgegebenen Stimmen bekam, löste dies eine parteipolitische Debatte auch auf Bundesebene aus. Denn die AfD und das sie unterstützende BSW verfügen zusammen nur über 44 Stimmen. Die SPD forderte von der CDU Aufklärung, ob deren Abgeordnete für Rausch gestimmt hatten. Dies werde auch Thema im Koalitionsausschuss der schwarz-roten Regierung am Mittwoch in Berlin werden, kündigte SPD-Fraktionschef Matthias Miersch an.
items.body:
In Deutschland gibt es erstmals einen Parlamentspräsidenten aus den Reihen der in Teilen als rechtsextrem eingestuften AfD. Der Landtag in Sachsen-Anhalt wählte in seiner konstituierenden Sitzung am Dienstag den AfD-Abgeordneten Tobias Rausch zu seinem Präsidenten. Weil er bei der geheimen Wahl 48 der 82 abgegebenen Stimmen bekam, löste dies eine parteipolitische Debatte auch auf Bundesebene aus. Denn die AfD und das sie unterstützende BSW verfügen zusammen nur über 44 Stimmen. Die SPD forderte von der CDU Aufklärung, ob deren Abgeordnete für Rausch gestimmt hatten. Dies werde auch Thema im Koalitionsausschuss der schwarz-roten Regierung am Mittwoch in Berlin werden, kündigte SPD-Fraktionschef Matthias Miersch an.
CDU/CSU-Fraktionschef Thorsten Frei sagte, er sehe die Wahl in Magdeburg "mit allergrößter Besorgnis". Das gelte auch dafür, dass Rausch vier Stimmen mehr als erwartet bekommen habe. Zugleich wies er es als "reine Spekulation" zurück, dass CDU-Abgeordnete für diese vier Stimmen verantwortlich seien. Aber die Wahl an sich sei "in höchstem Maße bedenklich und besorgniserregend".
Am Nachmittag wurde zudem der AfD-Politiker Hans-Thomas Tillschneider zu einem der Landtags-Vizepräsidenten gewählt. Bei 82 abgegebenen Stimmen erhielt er 44 Ja-Stimmen. Es gab 38 Nein-Stimmen und keine Enthaltungen. Rausch hatte 48-Ja-Stimmen bekommen, bei 29 Nein-Stimmen und 5 Enthaltungen.
AfD-Wahlsieger Ulrich Siegmund hat angekündigt, sich im Dezember im Landtag als Kandidat für das Amt des Ministerpräsidenten zur Wahl stellen zu wollen. Ihm fehlt eine Mehrheit, weil die anderen Parteien keine Koalition mit der AfD eingehen wollen. Auch das BSW lehnt eine formelle Zusammenarbeit mit der AfD ab, hat aber angekündigt, sich in einem dritten Wahlgang enthalten zu wollen. Dann würde für die Wahl Siegmunds eine einfache Mehrheit ausreichen - dann müsste der AfD-Politiker aber mit einer Minderheitsregierung regieren, was er bisher abgelehnt hat. Bis zu einer erfolgreichen Wahl eines neuen Regierungschefs ist Ministerpräsident Sven Schulze (CDU) geschäftsführend weiter im Amt.
CSU-Landesgruppenchef Hoffmann warf der AfD vor, "demokratiefeindlich" zu sein. Das sehe man daran, dass die AfD in Sachsen-Anhalt nur 100 Prozent AfD und keinen Kompromiss eingehen wolle. Es gehe der AfD nur darum, das demokratische System zu zersetzen. Er glaube, dass die AfD durch das Verhalten Siegmunds "ein Stück weit entzaubert" werde, auch für ihre Wähler. Denn offensichtlich wolle sie die Zusage nicht einhalten, etwas zu ändern.

items.title: London stocks gain on softer oil, easing gilt yields; Defence shares fall
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The UK's FTSE 100 advanced on Tuesday as a retreat in bond yields and softer oil prices calmed investors following last week's bond-market volatility, while losses in defence stocks capped gains.
items.body:
The UK's FTSE 100 advanced on Tuesday as a retreat in bond yields and softer oil prices calmed investors following last week's bond-market volatility, while losses in defence stocks capped gains.
The blue-chip FTSE 100 index (.FTSE) rose 0.4% to 24,215.33 points, while the midcap FTSE 250 (.FTMC) also climbed 0.4%.
Brent crude oil declined 2% as resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns, although continued security risks in the Middle East limited further losses.
Government borrowing costs also eased after 10- and 30-year gilt yields , surged to multi-decade highs last week, as investors weighed persistent inflation and debt concerns.
Bank of England policymaker Catherine Mann [USN:L8N45S0KH TEXT:"warned"] that inflation has become embedded in the UK economy and could become further entrenched as wage negotiations pick up early next year
Markets see about a 90% probability of a 25-basis-point or larger BoE rate hike in November, according to LSEG data.
Defence stocks fell, with BAE Systems (BAES.L) , Babcock International (BAB.L) and Rolls-Royce (RR.L) down between 2% and 4%.
A Times report said the government was considering delaying plans to set out a path towards [USN:L8N45S0CO TEXT:"lifting defence spending to 3% of GDP"].
Informa (INF.L) was among top FTSE 100 gainers, rising 3%. The exhibitions group said it would [USN:L4N45S0CT TEXT:"buy events organiser Clarion"] for £2.24 billion ($2.98 billion) and spin off its Taylor & Francis academic publishing division
"While separating off the academic publishing business means there is little else to support the business if live events struggle, it at least recognises where the real growth in the business will continue to be," said Chris Beauchamp, chief market analyst at IG.
On the FTSE 250, shipping services provider Clarkson (CKN.L) rose 2.2% after forecasting annual underlying [USN:L6N45S0BI TEXT:"pretax profit above market expectations"].
ASOS (ASOS.L) dropped 9.6% after [USN:L6N45S0OD TEXT:"media reports"] said customers of the online fashion retailer had received push notifications saying it had been hacked and threatening to leak information. The firm said basic personal information might have been accessed but that it did not believe payment-card information or account passwords had been affected.
($1 = 0.7528 pounds)

items.title: Emera bulks up for power demand boom with $10 billion Canadian Utilities deal
items.author: Katha Kalia
items.creator: Katha Kalia
items.summary: Emera said on Tuesday it would buy peer Canadian Utilities for C$14.3 billion ($10.02 billion) in stock, strengthening its financial muscle as power companies ramp up investments to tap into booming demand.
items.body:
Emera (EMA.TO) said on Tuesday it would buy peer Canadian Utilities (CU.TO) for C$14.3 billion ($10.02 billion) in stock, strengthening its financial muscle as power companies ramp up investments to tap into booming demand.
The deal, which will create one of Canada's top power providers with an enterprise value of about C$72 billion, comes when utilities across North America move ahead with costly upgrades of aging grid and transmission infrastructure.
"As demand rises from electrification trends and major infrastructure development, the combined company will be better positioned to help meet growing energy needs," Emera CEO Scott Balfour, who will lead the combined company, said in a statement.
US power firms NextEra Energy (NEE.N) and Dominion Energy (D.N) in May [USN:L4N41V0YN TEXT:"agreed to merge"] in a $66.8 billion deal amid soaring electricity demand fueled by the rapid expansion of data centers supporting the adoption of AI.
Emera said the deal would support a planned C$32 billion capital program through 2030, with an expected annual rate-base growth of 7% to 8%.
The combined company will have about 6 million customers and a presence in high-growth markets through a portfolio of 12 regulated utilities.
"Florida and Alberta will become the company's two largest jurisdictions, representing approximately 45% and 34% respectively," Balfour said in a conference call.
DEAL CLOSING IN 2027 Under the offer, Class A shareholders of Canadian Utilities, excluding ATCO (ACOx.TO) , will receive 0.755 Emera shares and Class B shareholders will get 0.819 for each share held.
The deal values Canadian Utilities' Class A shares at about C$51.57 each, a premium of roughly 0.7% to the stock's close on Monday, according to LSEG data.
Meanwhile, ATCO, which holds nearly 37% of the outstanding non-voting shares and all outstanding voting shares of Canadian Utilities, will separate into a publicly traded industrial services company.
Emera shares were down 1.2%, Canadian Utilities rose 1.4% and ATCO jumped 12.8% in morning trading.
The deal is expected to close in the third or fourth quarter of 2027 and add to earnings per share in the first full year following the completion.
The new company will operate as Emera and maintain its public company headquarters in Halifax.
($1 = 1.4270 Canadian dollars)

items.title: Becton Dickinson pledges $19 billion US investment in deal with government
items.author: Siddhi Mahatole
items.creator: Siddhi Mahatole
items.summary: Becton Dickinson became the first major US medical device company to strike a deal with the government to expand its domestic manufacturing, pledging $19 billion over several years in return for shelter from future tariffs.
items.body:
Becton Dickinson (BDX.N) became the first major US medical device company to strike a deal with the government to expand its domestic manufacturing, pledging $19 billion over several years in return for shelter from future tariffs.
Under the agreement, the company on Tuesday said it plans to make capital, operational and supply chain investments in the US, with $3 billion earmarked for strategic manufacturing sites across the country.
Shares of the medical device maker were up 2.4% in morning trading.
The deal follows the Trump administration's [USN:L4N3TZ1L7 TEXT:"push"] to use tariff threats to spur domestic healthcare manufacturing, with [USN:L4N4470VR TEXT:"major drugmakers already pledging billions"] for new and expanded US production and research facilities.
The agreement ties BD's US manufacturing commitments to relief from future tariffs on covered products and inputs under Section 232, subject to the final scope of the measures and the company meeting agreed milestones.
"We think tariff clarity or the potential for levies to be 'less bad' than feared could be a clearing event for MedTech," said Jefferies analyst Mathew Taylor, adding "we wonder if there are more MedTech announcements in the works."
The company plans to expand US production by about 5 billion essential medical consumables annually, raising the share it supplies domestically to roughly 80%.
It also plans to manufacture all needles used in the US domestically using American-made steel.
Becton Dickinson said it was not currently quantifying the financial impact of the agreement because the final tariff rates, product scope and timing have not yet been determined.
The announcement builds on President Donald Trump's [USN:L1N45S036 TEXT:"statement on Monday"] that the company had agreed to invest $3 billion to bring manufacturing of essential medical products to the United States, with more than $1 billion going to Nebraska.
In January, Becton announced a $110 million investment in Columbus, Nebraska, to expand prefillable syringe and cannula production, adding about 120 jobs, with syringe production expected to begin supplying customers in mid-2026.

items.title: El astrofísico Francis Halzen gana Nobel de Física por el descubrimiento de neutrinos de alta energía
items.author: Charles Daly
items.summary: Halzen recibirá un premio de 12 millones de coronas suecas (US$1,2 millones), según informó la Real Academia Sueca de Ciencias en Estocolmo en un comunicado el martes.
items.body: Bloomberg — Francis Halzen, astrofísico nacido en Bélgica, fue galardonado con el Premio Nobel de Física por sus “contribuciones decisivas al Observatorio de Neutrinos IceCube y el descubrimiento de neutrinos de alta energía de origen astrofísico”. Ver más: ¿Quién puede ser nominado al Premio Nobel y quién puede presentar candidatos? Halzen recibirá un premio de 12 millones de coronas suecas (US$1,2 millones), según informó la Real Academia Sueca de Ciencias en Estocolmo en un comunicado el martes. Según el comité, sentó las bases de un nuevo tipo de astronomía con la idea de utilizar el hielo glaciar del Polo Sur para capturar las partículas secretas llamadas neutrinos. El resultado fue un observatorio capaz de rastrear neutrinos que se originan en el cosmos distante. Los premios Nobel se otorgan anualmente por logros en física, química, medicina, literatura y paz. Los cinco galardones fueron establecidos en el testamento de Alfred Nobel, el inventor sueco de la dinamita, quien falleció en 1896. El banco central de Suecia añadió un premio en ciencias económicas en 1968. Este año, con motivo del 125 aniversario de los premios, la dotación económica se incrementó en 1 millón de coronas suecas por categoría. Cuando se entregaron los primeros Premios Nobel en 1901, la cantidad era de 150.782 coronas suecas cada uno. Ver más: Tres científicos ganan el Nobel de Medicina por avances que permiten mapear el cerebro con luz El año pasado, tres científicos compartieron el premio de física por su descubrimiento del efecto túnel cuántico macroscópico y la “cuantización” de la energía en un circuito eléctrico. Este avance contribuyó al desarrollo de la computación cuántica y los sensores. Los galardonados se anuncian hasta el 12 de octubre en Estocolmo, con la excepción del Premio Nobel de la Paz, cuyos premiados son dados a conocer el viernes por el Comité Nobel Noruego en Oslo. El lunes, el Premio Nobel de Fisiología o Medicina fue otorgado a científicos de Estados Unidos y Alemania por sentar las bases de una nueva era en la neurociencia que busca desentrañar algunos de los misterios del cerebro. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Google enters massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy
items.author: Laila Kearney
items.creator: Laila Kearney
items.summary: Google has contracted for 3,590 megawatts of power from Constellation Energy in the largest US power grid, with new nuclear energy accounting for about a quarter of that supply, the companies said on Tuesday.
items.body:
Google (GOOGL.O) has contracted for 3,590 megawatts of power from Constellation Energy (CEG.O) in the largest US power grid, with new nuclear energy accounting for about a quarter of that supply, the companies said on Tuesday.
Constellation will make more than $4.3 billion of new investments in its fleet as part of the agreement, which involves adding capacity at several of the power company's nuclear reactors in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, the companies said.
Major tech companies are racing to secure massive amounts of electricity supplies to power data centers across the US by striking unprecedented power deals and reviving the country's nuclear industry.
Over the last two years, Constellation unveiled an agreement to restart its [USN:L1N3LU103 TEXT:"Three Mile Island reactor "]in Pennsylvania to serve Microsoft (MSFT.O) data centers, while Google contracted [USN:L4N3W81GR TEXT:"to restart "]NextEra Energy's (NEE.N) nuclear power plant in Iowa.
In the latest arrangement, Google entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 megawatts of electricity from multiple Constellation-owned nuclear power plants, which would be upgraded to produce more electricity from existing reactors.
Electricity from the first of the upgraded plants is expected to be delivered in 2028, the companies said.
Google also entered into a 15-year supply agreement for an additional 2,700 megawatts of power from Constellation in the PJM power grid. That power is not tied to a specific generation source and serves as long-term revenue certainty for Constellation's operating plants, Google said.
Shares of Constellation were up by more than 13% on Tuesday to $304.04 by mid-morning.
Maryland-based Constellation is the largest US nuclear power plant operator and owns a major fleet of natural-gas-fired power plants as well as geothermal energy following its [USN:L4N3O60SW TEXT:"acquisition of electricity producer"] Calpine Corp earlier this year.
"We’re committed to meeting our growth responsibly by actively investing in clean, reliable power that brings new capacity to our nation's grids," said Amanda Peterson Corio, Google's global head of energy and power, in a statement.
The 11 nuclear units expected to be upgraded as part of the arrangement with Google are in Illinois, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey, within the footprint of the largest US electric grid -- PJM Interconnection.
Rising electricity demand driven largely by the data center expansion has contributed to a more than 11-fold increase in PJM capacity prices since 2024 and left the grid with a power shortfall.
In response, PJM management has proposed requiring data center customers connected to the 13-state grid to either bring their own power or face being shut off from grid power remotely in times of peak demand.
The deal between Google and Constellation is in response to PJM's "bring your own power" proposal. It also creates a "practical model for how major power consumers can expand new supply alongside growing operational requirements, without state or federal mandates," the companies said.
Google and Constellation also agreed on a strategic framework that can be replicated to develop power generation, battery storage, and a flexible power use model known as "demand response" in other parts of the US, the companies said.
Joe Dominguez, chairman, president and CEO of Constellation, said the arrangement with Google is a "model for how technology companies and the energy industry can work together to responsibly develop the digital economy and invest in our nation’s energy infrastructure in a way that delivers grid-wide benefits for all, funded by private entities."

Google enters massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 6 : Google has contracted for 3,590 megawatts of power from Constellation Energy in the largest US power grid, with new nuclear energy accounting for about a quarter of that supply, the companies said on Tuesday.
Constellation will make more than $4.3 billion of new investments in its fleet as part of the agreement, which involves adding capacity at several of the power company's nuclear reactors in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, the companies said.
Major tech companies are racing to secure massive amounts of electricity supplies to power data centers across the US by striking unprecedented power deals and reviving the country's nuclear industry.
Over the last two years, Constellation unveiled an agreement to restart its Three Mile Island reactor in Pennsylvania to serve Microsoft data centers, while Google contracted to restart NextEra Energy's nuclear power plant in Iowa.

In the latest arrangement, Google entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 megawatts of electricity from multiple Constellation-owned nuclear power plants, which would be upgraded to produce more electricity from existing reactors.
Electricity from the first of the upgraded plants is expected to be delivered in 2028, the companies said.
Google also entered into a 15-year supply agreement for an additional 2,700 megawatts of power from Constellation in the PJM power grid. That power is not tied to a specific generation source and serves as long-term revenue certainty for Constellation's operating plants, Google said.
Shares of Constellation were up by more than 13 per cent on Tuesday to $304.04 by mid-morning.
Maryland-based Constellation is the largest US nuclear power plant operator and owns a major fleet of natural-gas-fired power plants as well as geothermal energy following its acquisition of electricity producer Calpine Corp earlier this year.
"We’re committed to meeting our growth responsibly by actively investing in clean, reliable power that brings new capacity to our nation's grids," said Amanda Peterson Corio, Google's global head of energy and power, in a statement. 
The 11 nuclear units expected to be upgraded as part of the arrangement with Google are in Illinois, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey, within the footprint of the largest US electric grid - PJM Interconnection. 
Rising electricity demand driven largely by the data center expansion has contributed to a more than 11-fold increase in PJM capacity prices since 2024 and left the grid with a power shortfall.
In response, PJM management has proposed requiring data center customers connected to the 13-state grid to either bring their own power or face being shut off from grid power remotely in times of peak demand.
The deal between Google and Constellation is in response to PJM's "bring your own power" proposal. It also creates a "practical model for how major power consumers can expand new supply alongside growing operational requirements, without state or federal mandates," the companies said. 
Google and Constellation also agreed on a strategic framework that can be replicated to develop power generation, battery storage, and a flexible power use model known as "demand response" in other parts of the US, the companies said.
Joe Dominguez, chairman, president and CEO of Constellation, said the arrangement with Google is a "model for how technology companies and the energy industry can work together to responsibly develop the digital economy and invest in our nation’s energy infrastructure in a way that delivers grid-wide benefits for all, funded by private entities."

サウジとイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派との戦闘が続く中、同パイプラインで最近、送油が中断したとの報道があったが、関係筋は５日、ロイターに対し中断はしていないと述べた。

items.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq hit record highs as Treasury yields stall, oil slips
items.author: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Shashwat Chauhan
items.creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Shashwat Chauhan
items.summary: The benchmark S&P 500 and the Nasdaq hit record highs on Tuesday as Treasury yields eased from multi-year highs and oil prices fell, while investors looked ahead to the upcoming quarterly earnings season.
items.body:
The benchmark S&P 500 and the Nasdaq hit record highs on Tuesday as Treasury yields eased from multi-year highs and oil prices fell, while investors looked ahead to the upcoming quarterly earnings season.
Most of the 'Magnificent Seven' stocks ticked higher, with Meta (META.O) , Tesla (TSLA.O) , Amazon.com (AMZN.O) and Microsoft (MSFT.O) all up between 0.5% and 1.7%.
Chip designer Nvidia (NVDA.O) climbed 1.1%, pushing the market valuation of the world's most valuable company close to the $6 trillion mark.
Optimism surrounding the AI trade and hopes of strong corporate earnings lifted US equities lately, further boosting the bull market that began in October 2022 despite higher energy prices and a volatile summer for bond markets that fueled concerns about tighter monetary policy.
"The economy continues to be more resilient than many expected, and corporate earnings remain strong, but the big change is rising interest rates," said David Miller, chief investment officer at Catalyst Funds.
"Investors are now dealing with meaningfully higher long-term rates ... I am still bullish on equities, but the hurdle has gone up significantly."
Government bond yields eased across the curve, including a 5.3-basis-point decline for the benchmark 10-year bond .
A soft payrolls report last week reduced chances of an interest rate hike in October, with traders now seeing a near 79% chance of a hold, though a December rate hike remains largely priced in, according to the CME Group's FedWatch tool.
On Tuesday, at least four Fed officials, including New York Fed President John Williams, are slated to deliver public remarks.
All 11 S&P 500 sectors were trading higher, with utilities (.SPLRCU) and real estate (.SPLRCR) leading the gains.
At 11:33 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 359.08 points, or 0.70%, to 51,626.98, the S&P 500 (.SPX) gained 66.16 points, or 0.86%, to 7,840.66 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) gained 228.58 points, or 0.83%, to 27,705.89.
Oil prices, meanwhile, fell around 2% as resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns.
The third-quarter earnings season will kick off next week. Analysts on average expect S&P 500 earnings to jump over 30% year over year in the quarter, thanks largely to AI-related stocks, according to LSEG data.
Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) climbed 6.5% after the [USN:L6N45S0Y5 TEXT:"chip designer"] raised its 2028 revenue forecast to about $20 billion on Tuesday, citing strong demand for its chips used in data centers.
Chipmaker AMD (AMD.O) gained 3.6% after CEO Lisa Su said [USN:L6N45S09C TEXT:"the company planned"] to substantially increase chip supply in 2027 to meet booming AI demand.
Constellation Energy (CEG.O) was the top gainer on the S&P 500, up 13.9% after Alphabet's Google (GOOGL.O) entered into a 3,590-megawatt power [USN:L6N45S04O TEXT:"deal"] with the company.
Option Care Health (OPCH.O) jumped 32.7% after drug distributor McKesson (MCK.N) and private equity firm Clayton Dubilier & Rice [USN:L4N45S0SZ TEXT:"agreed to buy"] the infusion therapy provider in a deal worth about $5.8 billion, including debt.
Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 2.93-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by a 1.72-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq.
The S&P 500 posted 21 new 52-week highs and one new low, while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 48 new highs and 123 new lows.

items.title: 米中、核施設相互視察を協議　中国が提案とＣＮＮ報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［６日　ロイター］ - 米ＣＮＮは６日、米国が中国との間で核施設相互視察の開始について協議しており、今後数カ月の間に予定されている対面会談でも、その実現に向けて引き続き働きかけていく方針だと報じた。

ＣＮＮが関係筋の話として伝えたところによると、相互訪問の構想は今年行われた米中当局者の協議で中国側が提起し、米エネルギー省傘下の国立研究所や中国の同等施設への訪問が検討された。米中当局者協議は主に、国連安全保障理事会常任理事国の会合の合間に行われてきたという。

トランプ米大統領は先月、中国の習近平国家主席と会談した際、米中ロ３カ国による軍備管理交渉を呼びかけた。中国はかねて、自国の核戦力はロシアや米国に比べてはるかに小さく、そうした協議への参加は不要だとの立場を示している。

ＣＮＮは、米政府当局者の話として、両首脳が会談で核施設訪問の可能性について協議しなかったと伝えた。その上で、両首脳が再会談するまでに、核施設訪問の可能性を巡る実務レベルの協議がさらに行われる見通しだとした。

トランプ氏と習近平国家主席の年内の再会談は公算が大きいと広く見られており、１１月に中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議、または１２月に米国で開かれる２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）会合の機会に行われる可能性がある。

items.title: Catalan separatist Puigdemont set to return home after court lifts arrest warrant
items.author: Joan Faus, Emma Pinedo
items.creator: Joan Faus, Emma Pinedo
items.summary: Spain's two top courts cleared the way on Tuesday for self-exiled Catalan separatist leader Carles Puigdemont to return without being arrested, just as Spain is gearing up for an early national election.
items.body:
Spain's two top courts cleared the way on Tuesday for self-exiled Catalan separatist leader Carles Puigdemont to return without being arrested, just as Spain is gearing up for an [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"early national election"].
The Constitutional Court ruled that an amnesty law for Catalan separatists applies to embezzlement charges against Puigdemont. Shortly afterwards, the Supreme Court responded by lifting a warrant for Puigdemont's arrest.
The likely homecoming of the former Catalan head of government could further unsettle an already volatile political landscape ahead of the November 29 election. Puigdemont fled to Belgium in 2017 after holding an independence referendum for his region that Madrid had declared illegal.
"It's a great victory for President Puigdemont and the two other exiled" leaders in Belgium, Jordi Turull, secretary general of Puigdemont's party Junts, told reporters. "They held firm, they resisted, they prevailed in Europe and today they have prevailed against the Spanish state."
He declined to say when Puigdemont might return, but ruled out his running in the upcoming election.
Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez had enacted the amnesty under a 2023 agreement between his Socialist Party and two Catalan parties, including Puigdemont's Junts, in exchange for their support for him to remain prime minister. The move triggered intense social and political opposition from the government's critics at the time.
The Supreme Court had initially ruled that the amnesty did not apply to the crime of embezzlement, which meant Puigdemont and others could still be arrested on charges of embezzling the funds that were spent on the referendum.
But the Constitutional Court, which has a progressive-leaning majority, ruled in an appeal that disallowing the amnesty for embezzlement unconnected with private enrichment would violate the purpose of the amnesty law.
"The ruling is in line with expectations, as we had always maintained that the amnesty law was constitutional and also consistent with European Union law," Puigdemont's lawyer, Gonzalo Boye, told Reuters.
A year ago, Junts withdrew its support for the minority central government. Unable to pass laws, Sanchez [USN:L8N45R0N4 TEXT:"called"] the snap election on Monday. Sanchez told reporters on Tuesday he did not regret launching the amnesty, and welcomed the court ruling.
"I believe the important message is that of coexistence among Catalans," he said.
FRESH DRAMA Although separatism has [USN:L8N4590Z7 TEXT:"lost ground"] and Junts is trailing in opinion polls, Puigdemont's return could spark fresh political drama.
Spain's conservative People's Party is leading in opinion polls ahead of the election and may need to seek the support of Junts and other centre-right parties to govern.
Catalonia unilaterally [USN:KBN1CB272 TEXT:"declared independence"] from Spain in 2017 after the referendum. Although some 90% of voters backed independence, Catalans who wanted to remain part of Spain mostly boycotted the ballot and many polling stations were shut.
Puigdemont then fled the country, while several of his former ministers, including Turull, stayed and were jailed until later being pardoned by Sanchez.

items.title: Canada's TSX edges up as bond yields retreat, utility shares advance
items.author: Avinash P
items.creator: Avinash P
items.summary: Canada's benchmark stock index inched higher on Tuesday, with utilities leading gains, as a pullback in global bond yields and easing oil prices supported sentiment, although weakness in energy and mining shares capped advances.
items.body:
Canada's benchmark stock index inched higher on Tuesday, with utilities leading gains, as a pullback in global bond yields and easing oil prices supported sentiment, although weakness in energy and mining shares capped advances.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) rose 0.19% to 35,587.45 points by 10:08 a.m. ET and was on track for its third straight day of gains.
Utilities (.GSPTTUT) rose 1%, leading gains, as global bond yields retreated
Emera (EMA.TO) said it would acquire Canadian Utilities (CU.TO) in an [USN:L4N45S0P5 TEXT:"all-stock deal worth C$14.3 billion"] ($10.02 billion), creating one of Canada's largest utilities
Emera fell 2%, while Canadian Utilities inched higher marginally. ATCO (ACOx.TO) jumped 12.8% after saying it would spin off into a standalone publicly traded industrial services company called New ATCO
Oil fell by more than $2 as rising Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns, with Brent Crude dipping below $100 a barrel
The energy sector (.SPTTEN) fell 1.4%, while the materials sector (.GSPTTMT) dropped 0.7%, limiting broader market gains
The yield on the US benchmark 10-year Treasury note dipped after hitting a 24-year high on Monday, while the yield on the Canadian 10-year government bond also edged lower, offering some respite to markets
"I'd be focused more on interest rates, the 10-year yield in the United States, than I would be on energy prices, although they're related," said Matt Skipp, president at SW8 Asset Management
"A moderating oil price seems to have the potential to lower yields, as investors worry less about inflation," Skipp added
Concerns over persistent inflation and rising government debt, however, continue to keep bond and equity markets on edge
Markets are pricing in at least one more quarter-point rate hike from the US Federal Reserve and a 25-basis-point increase from the Bank of Canada before year-end, according to LSEG compiled data

items.title: 日本の対米投資は中国依存度を低下、日中対話進展は期待＝米上院議員
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 来日中のデービッド・マコーミック米上院議員は６日、都内で記者団の取材に応じ、日米両国が合意した５５００億ドル（約８７兆円）の対米投融資について、米国の製造業再生や日本の米市場へのアクセス獲得に加え、サプライチェーン（供給網）を中国から切り替えることで日米両国の対中依存度を低下させる効果があると述べた。

一方、マコーミック氏は中国が経済、軍事的に世界のリーダーの座を争う「敵対国」だとする一方、「共通点を探る努力は必要だ」と指摘。日本について「（世界有数の経済大国で）非常に重要な国だ。そして中国と同じ地域にあり、両国が対話を続けるのは理にかなったことだ」と話した。トランプ大統領と習近平国家主席の最近の会談に触れ、トランプ氏と高市早苗首相は「極めて緊密な関係にある」として米国の後押しで日中対話が進むことに期待を示した。

マコーミック氏は、日本製鉄が買収した米鉄鋼大手ＵＳスチールの本社があるペンシルベニア州選出。「ペンシルベニアにとっても米国にとっても、日本にとっても素晴らしい案件だと確信し、ホワイトハウスに行き、大統領執務室で大統領と会ってこの案件を支持するよう働きかけた」と振り返った。

items.summary:
Nora Buli　Gwladys Fouche

items.body:
Nora Buli　Gwladys Fouche

[オスロ ６日 ロイター] - ノルウェー・ノーベル委員会(ノーベル平和賞委員会)のクリスティアン・ベルグ・ハルプビケン事務局長は、激動の中にある世界秩序の再編と、同賞の目的に沿った新たな協力の在り方を推進する人々を注視していると述べた。

同委員会は５人のメンバーで構成される。事務局長は候補に関する資料をまとめ、審議に参加するが、投票権はない。今年の受賞者発表は９日に行われる。

ハルプビケン氏は５日のインタビューで、世界が激動しているからといって、候補が不足しているわけでも、平和賞がその意義を失っているわけでもないと指摘。「賞そのものについては心配していないが、世界がどこへ向かっているのかについては懸念している」と付け加えた。

items.title: 「ニュートリノマン」にノーベル物理学賞、南極での国際研究事業主導
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ストックホルム　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ストックホルム　６日　ロイター］ - スウェーデン王立科学アカデミーは６日、２０２６年のノーベル物理学賞を、ベルギー出身の素粒子物理学者フランシス・ハルツェン氏（米ウィスコンシン大学マディソン校教授）に授与すると発表した。授賞理由は「アイスキューブ・ニュートリノ観測所への決定的な貢献と、天体起源の高エネルギーニュートリノの発見」。

ハルツェン氏は、南極に設置した観測施設「アイスキューブ」での国際研究プロジェクトを主導した。

王立科学アカデミーのエバ・オルソン氏は記者会見で「（ニュートリノという）メッセンジャーは宇宙から情報を運んでくる」と述べ、「遠くの銀河への扉を開き、星が爆発する過程を教えてくれる」と語った。

ノーベル物理学委員会のマーク・ピアース委員長は声明で「ハルツェン氏は国際的な研究者・技術者チームを率い、素晴らしい観測装置をもたらしてくれた」とし、「その粘り強さと科学的な先見性が、新しい種類の天文学への道を開いた」とも語った。

ハルツェン氏は電話で記者会見に参加し、「自分がいかに幸運だったかを強調したい。このプロジェクトを始めた時、良いアイデアかもしれないとは誰もが思っていたが、うまくいくと考えた人はほとんどいなかった。私自身もそうだった」と語った。

ベルギーのデウェーフェル首相は、「宇宙の最も小さな現れを通じて、宇宙の最大の謎の解明にささげた人生」が認められたと称えた。 

ニュートリノは地球や人体を跡形もなく通り抜け、物質とはごくまれにしか反応しないため、「幽霊粒子」と呼ばれることもある。ハルツェン氏は、南極点の氷を使えばニュートリノを追跡できることに気付いた。１９８８年、南極点でニュートリノの痕跡を捉えるという構想を初めて発表したが、プロジェクトの完成は２０１１年までかかった。 

アイスキューブは、アムンゼン・スコット南極点基地の近くの地下深くにあり、５０００個を超えるセンサーが設置されている。

高エネルギーニュートリノは質量がほぼゼロで、他の粒子と違ってエネルギーを失ったり方向を変えたりしない。アイスキューブはその信号を待ち受け、経路をさかのぼって発生源を突き止めることを目指している。

ハルツェン氏は６日の会見で、自身の研究で宇宙について具体的に何が分かるかを語るのは尚早とし、「本当にわくわくするのは、その質問にまだ答えられないことだ。これは科学の入り口にすぎず、天文学としての成果はこれからだ」と語った。

米スミソニアン誌は１４年にハルツェン氏に「独創性賞」を贈った。その際、同氏を「ニュートリノマン」と呼び、「天文学の新時代の幕開けを告げる驚くべき実験」と称え、ハルツェン氏の半生を描いた漫画「一人の物理学者の宇宙探求はいかにして南極で飛躍したか（How OnePhysicist’s Pursuit of the Cosmos Took Off in Antarctica）」を掲載した。

items.title: 米国民、税金使う選挙広告に不信感＝ロイター／イプソス世論調査
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Jason Lange

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Jason Lange

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - ロイター／イプソスが実施した世論調査によると、１１月の中間選挙を前にトランプ大統領が出演するテレビＣＭが放映される中、圧倒的多数の米国民が選挙の頃に大統領を起用したテレビＣＭに税金を使うのは不適切だと回答した。

５日に終了した６日間の世論調査によると、米国民の８６％、そして共和党員の５人に４人が、大統領や閣僚を起用した選挙関連のテレビ広告に税金を使うのは不適切だと考えていることが分かった。

倫理専門家や両党の議員は、中間選挙の数週間前に放映された「アメリカの黄金時代」を称える３つの全国放送広告を批判。議員らは公金がトランプ氏の政治的宣伝に使われているのではないかと疑問を呈しており、他の批判者らはこれらの広告が政府の宣伝活動や政治活動に関する規制に違反する可能性があると指摘している。

トランプ氏と側近らは、これらの広告は教育的かつ愛国的なものであり、特定の政治家候補を後押しする意図はないと述べている。

トランプ氏は５日夜、広告費は自ら支払うか、政治活動委員会（ＰＡＣ）の「ＭＡＧＡ」が集めた資金で賄うと表明した。 

各広告の最後には、米国政府が費用を負担した旨が記載されている。

民主党議員らは独立した調査を求め、ホワイトハウスが広告放映のために国土安全保障省の資金２０００万ドルを流用したと主張している。

また、世論調査によると、回答者の約７１％が米首都ワシントンの総合文化施設ケネディ・センターの名称をトランプ氏の名前を含むものに変更することに反対している。共和党員でこの案を支持しているのはわずか４分の１だった。

さらに、共和党支持者の間では、一部の記者をホワイトハウスから締め出すことに賛成する人が多く、５７％が賛成。一方、民主党支持者と無党派層は圧倒的に反対した。全体として、回答者の６８％がこうしたやり方は不適切だと答えた。

調査はオンラインで全米規模で実施され、米国の成人４５０６人から回答を得た。

items.title: Chevron advierte sobre alza de precios si EE.UU. prohíbe exportaciones de diésel
items.author: Charles Gorrivan, Mitchell Ferman, Grant Smith
items.summary: El CEO de Chevron, Mike Wirth, advirtió que una eventual restricción afectaría los precios en algunas zonas de EE.UU. y enviaría una señal negativa a los países aliados que dependen de sus suministros ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Una prohibición estadounidense de las exportaciones de diésel podría provocar un aumento de los precios en algunas zonas del país, además de causar problemas con otros países que dependen de los suministros estadounidenses, afirmó este martes Mike Wirth, CEO de Chevron Corp ( CVX ). “Podría observarse cierta presión al alza sobre los precios en algunas zonas del país”, señaló Wirth en el Energy Intelligence Forum celebrado en Londres. “Y creo que, especialmente para nuestros aliados, esto enviaría una señal muy negativa, ya que EE.UU. ha sido un proveedor fiable en momentos de necesidad”. Ver más: Trump firma decreto que flexibiliza el uso de diésel sin impuestos para reducir costos A finales de la semana pasada, el presidente Donald Trump afirmó que no prohibiría las exportaciones de diésel de EE.UU., después de que los países del Grupo de los Siete y sus socios acordaran liberar parte de sus reservas de combustible de emergencia con el fin de frenar la escalada de los precios. La decisión del presidente supuso un retroceso respecto a su anterior intención de imponer posibles restricciones a las exportaciones de gasóleo. Wirth también señaló a la audiencia que la demanda de petróleo y gas seguirá creciendo tras el fin de la guerra del Golfo Pérsico, y que su empresa podría unirse a un consorcio para la construcción de un oleoducto desde Irak hasta el Mediterráneo. En medio de los avances tecnológicos, Chevron está perforando más pozos con menos plataformas que nunca, afirmó Wirth. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

NEW YORK/BOSTON, October 6 : Dario Amodei made $18 million last year as CEO of Claude AI developer Anthropic, the company's IPO filing shows, putting him in the middle ranks of top executives at major technology firms in terms of compensation.
Anthropic is preparing for an IPO as early as this fall that could value it at more than $2 trillion, according to its IPO prospectus seen by Reuters. Amodei's pay last year puts him above CEOs at Alphabet and Amazon, but behind those at Oracle and Nvidia. 
Amodei's pay leans heavily towards stock and other sorts of compensation, suggesting that like many other tech founders, his yearly salary will account for just a fraction of his wealth.
Dario Amodei and his sister, Anthropic President Daniela Amodei, each had their annual salaries doubled this past July to $1.4 million. Stock and options awards made up the bulk of their packages in 2025, with Daniela Amodei receiving a total of $16.4 million last year.

Anthropic's board this year granted the pair the promise of further equity in the form of restricted stock units, which promise a future payout if certain conditions are met. Some of that is tied to their remaining at the company, and some of it is tied to the IPO.
Chief Financial Officer Krishna Rao earned $720,250 last year. He was granted options to buy 1.4 million shares when he was hired in 2024, and exercised options worth $385,285 in 2025.
An Anthropic spokesperson declined to comment on the figures.
MIDDLE OF THE PACK
The rise in US CEO pay in recent years has far outpaced the gains for the average worker, a dynamic critics worry could be exacerbated by AI's widespread adoption.
S&P 500 CEO average annual compensation rose 21 per cent to $22.8 million last year, and that does not include the extraordinary case of Tesla's Elon Musk and his $158 billion restricted stock plan, according to the AFL-CIO.
Courtney Yu, director of research for executive compensation data firm Equilar, said Amodei's $18 million haul "seems on the lower end for a company valued at $2 trillion, but it will be interesting to see how that changes once the company goes public" and his full ownership stake is shown. With six other co-founders, Amodei may wind up getting a lesser share of the wealth created by the IPO compared with other major tech CEOs, Yu added.
Top executives at AI-focused tech firms earned amounts that varied widely in 2025, based on SEC filings. At the high end, Oracle co-CEO Clayton Magouyrk earned $627.5 million, while the lowest was the $54,080 paid to Musk as CEO of SpaceX, before it went public. SpaceX has also promised super-voting restricted shares to Musk, already the world's richest person, if the company's market value grows to $7.5 trillion and the firm puts 1 million people on Mars.
Other giant companies pay less on a year-by-year basis, with executives benefiting from enormous stock ownership while having only salary and security costs reflected in annual filings. 
For instance, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai made $10.9 million in 2025, including $8.8 million for personal security "due to Sundar's significant public profile." By "compensation actually paid," Pichai earned $213.9 million last year, which among other things reflects the change in value of his unvested shares. 
Amazon CEO Andrew Jassy made $2.1 million in 2025, a disclosure said, mainly reflecting travel and security. On an "actually paid" basis, Jassy received $13.2 million. 
LIVING OFF THE STOCK
Equilar's Yu said the disclosures show how these executives don't need to worry about year-by-year pay.
"Founder CEOs typically own enough equity that when the company does well and the stock prices increases they can just live off the wealth of the equity they already own, and typically don't take in a lot in annual compensation," Yu said.
Anthropic said in the filing it offered a mix of salary, equity awards and other benefits. The S-1 statement seen by Reuters does not describe the founders' share of ownership in the company, which could be worth billions of dollars, depending on the final terms and valuation of the IPO.
The Amodei siblings and their fellow co-founders pledged in the IPO filing to dedicate 80 per cent of their personal Anthropic equity to charitable causes.
Asked about the 80 per cent figure Monday, an Anthropic spokesperson noted an essay Dario Amodei posted earlier this year, where he wrote that wealthy individuals have an obligation to help address problems stemming from AI adoption, and decried that many wealthy people, particularly in the tech industry, "have recently adopted a cynical and nihilistic attitude that philanthropy is inevitably fraudulent or useless."

items.summary: アンソロピックＣＥＯ、25年報酬1800万ドル 業界中位    Reuters

items.title: アンソロピックＣＥＯ、25年報酬1800万ドル　業界中位
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Echo Wang　Ross Kerber　Isla Binnie

[ニューヨーク／ボストン ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Echo Wang　Ross Kerber　Isla Binnie

[ニューヨーク／ボストン ６日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）「クロード」を開発するアンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の２０２５年の報酬は１８００万ドルだった。同社の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類で明らかになった。大手テクノロジー企業の経営トップの中では中位に位置する。

ロイターが確認したＩＰＯ目論見書によると、アンソロピックは早ければ今秋の上場を準備しており、企業価値は２兆ドルを超える可能性がある。アモデイ氏の２５年の報酬は、アルファベットやアマゾン・ドット・コムのＣＥＯを上回る一方、オラクルやエヌビディアのＣＥＯには及ばなかった。 

アモデイ氏の報酬は株式などに大きく偏っており、他の多くのテクノロジー企業創業者と同様、年間給与が資産に占める割合はごく一部にとどまるとみられる。

アモデイ氏と妹のダニエラ・アモデイ社長の年間給与は、７月にそれぞれ２倍の１４０万ドルに引き上げられた。２５年の報酬は両氏とも株式とストックオプション（自社株購入権）が大半を占め、ダニエラ氏の報酬総額は１６４０万ドルだった。

アンソロピックの取締役会は今年、両氏に対し譲渡制限付き株式ユニット（ＲＳＵ）の形で追加の株式を付与することを約束した。ＲＳＵは一定の条件を満たした場合に将来支払われる仕組みで、一部は在籍継続、一部はＩＰＯに連動している。

アンソロピックの広報担当者は、これらの数字についてコメントを控えた。

＜大手テクノロジー企業の中では中位＞

米労働総同盟産別会議（ＡＦＬ─ＣＩＯ）によると、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種指数構成企業のＣＥＯの平均年間報酬は２５年に２１％増の２２８０万ドルとなった。この数字には、テスラのイーロン・マスクＣＥＯに対する１５８０億ドルの譲渡制限付き株式報酬という例外的な事例は含まれていない。

役員報酬データ会社エクイラーの調査責任者コートニー・ユー氏は、アモデイ氏の１８００万ドルという報酬について「企業価値が２兆ドルの会社としては低い方に見える」とした上で、上場して同氏の保有株式の全容が明らかになった後、どう変わるかは興味深いと述べた。他に６人の共同創業者がいるため、アモデイ氏がＩＰＯによって生み出される富から得る取り分は、他の大手テクノロジー企業のＣＥＯより小さくなる可能性があるとした。

米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）への提出書類によると、ＡＩに注力するテクノロジー企業の経営トップの２５年報酬には大きな開きがあった。高額な例ではオラクルのクレイトン・マグワイク共同ＣＥＯが６億２７５０万ドルを受け取った。一方、最低だったのは、上場前のスペースＸのＣＥＯとしてマスク氏に支払われた５万４０８０ドルだった。スペースＸは、同社の時価総額が７兆５０００億ドルに達し、火星に１００万人を送り込んだ場合、マスク氏に対し、強力な議決権を持つ譲渡制限付き株式を付与することも約束している。

他の巨大企業では、経営幹部が巨額の保有株式から恩恵を受ける一方、年次開示には給与や警備費用のみが計上されるため、年間の報酬額は比較的少ない。

例えば、アルファベットのスンダー・ピチャイＣＥＯの２５年の報酬は１０９０万ドルだった。このうち８８０万ドルは「スンダー氏の社会的な知名度の高さを踏まえた」身辺警護費用だった。一方、未確定の株式報酬の価値変動などを反映する「実際に支払われた報酬」という開示上の指標では、２億１３９０万ドルだった。

＜大手テクノロジー企業の中では中位＞

米労働総同盟産別会議（ＡＦＬ─ＣＩＯ）によると、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種指数構成企業のＣＥＯの平均年間報酬は２５年に２１％増の２２８０万ドルとなった。この数字には、テスラのイーロン・マスクＣＥＯに対する１５８０億ドルの譲渡制限付き株式報酬という例外的な事例は含まれていない。

役員報酬データ会社エクイラーの調査責任者コートニー・ユー氏は、アモデイ氏の１８００万ドルという報酬について「企業価値が２兆ドルの会社としては低い方に見える」とした上で、上場して同氏の保有株式の全容が明らかになった後、どう変わるかは興味深いと述べた。他に６人の共同創業者がいるため、アモデイ氏がＩＰＯによって生み出される富から得る取り分は、他の大手テクノロジー企業のＣＥＯより小さくなる可能性があるとした。

米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）への提出書類によると、ＡＩに注力するテクノロジー企業の経営トップの２５年報酬には大きな開きがあった。高額な例ではオラクルのクレイトン・マグワイク共同ＣＥＯが６億２７５０万ドルを受け取った。一方、最低だったのは、上場前のスペースＸのＣＥＯとしてマスク氏に支払われた５万４０８０ドルだった。スペースＸは、同社の時価総額が７兆５０００億ドルに達し、火星に１００万人を送り込んだ場合、マスク氏に対し、強力な議決権を持つ譲渡制限付き株式を付与することも約束している。

他の巨大企業では、経営幹部が巨額の保有株式から恩恵を受ける一方、年次開示には給与や警備費用のみが計上されるため、年間の報酬額は比較的少ない。

例えば、アルファベットのスンダー・ピチャイＣＥＯの２５年の報酬は１０９０万ドルだった。このうち８８０万ドルは「スンダー氏の社会的な知名度の高さを踏まえた」身辺警護費用だった。一方、未確定の株式報酬の価値変動などを反映する「実際に支払われた報酬」という開示上の指標では、２億１３９０万ドルだった。

Francis Halzen wins Nobel physics prize for Antarctic 'ghost particle' hunt

STOCKHOLM: The Belgian-American Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for his work creating an Antarctic observatory of ice to detect high-energy neutrinos, elusive subatomic particles that can reveal otherwise inaccessible information about the cosmos.
Halzen, 82, realised that pristine ice at the South Pole could be used to track such neutrinos, sometimes known as "ghost particles" for the way they pass through the Earth without a trace, only interacting with matter extremely rarely.
"The messengers bring information from the cosmos," Eva Olsson, of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, told a press conference. "They open the door to distant galaxies and tell us about the processes of exploding stars."
HALZEN HAILED FOR DETECTING "MESSENGERS FROM THE COSMOS" The interactions registered by the IceCube observatory provide information about how high-energy neutrinos are created and may even reveal previously unknown phenomena, the Academy said.

In 2014, the US-based Smithsonian magazine dubbed Halzen "Neutrino Man" when giving him one of its Ingenuity Awards, acclaiming him for an "amazing experiment (that) heralds the beginning of a new era in astronomy".
It even published a comic illustrating his life: "How One Physicist’s Pursuit of the Cosmos Took Off in Antarctica".
The observatory - in effect a telescope that shows neutrinos instead of light - is set in a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice, which extends to a depth of 2,500 metres below the surface near the Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station.
More than 5,000 sensors await blips from the nearly massless high-energy neutrinos, which unlike other particles do not lose energy or change direction, in the hope of tracing their paths back to exploding stars, gamma-ray bursts, and cataclysmic phenomena involving black holes and neutron stars. They can expect to register about one per day.
Halzen, a professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison in the United States, first presented his idea in 1988 for capturing neutrino traces at the South Pole, but the project was not completed until 2011.
"I have to emphasise how lucky I was because, when we started this project, everybody realised this was maybe a good idea, but very few thought it would work, including myself," Halzen told the press conference by telephone.
Neutrinos are electrically neutral, undisturbed by any magnetic field, which means that, in contrast to electromagnetic waves such as visible light, the direction from which they arrive points directly back to their source.

Related:

Medicine Nobel goes to US-German trio for pioneering light-based control of cells

FRUITS OF HALZEN'S RESEARCH YET TO COME The observatory has determined that high-energy neutrinos originate within but also far outside our own Milky Way galaxy, setting in motion an interstellar quest to find the objects and processes that create them.
Through the long winter at the South Pole, when bringing anything in or out is difficult as temperatures below minus 50°C (minus 58 Fahrenheit) preclude even aircraft landing, a skeleton crew of "winterovers" has to maintain the observatory.
The station, home to many other activities, can house as many as 150 people and has an industrial kitchen, dining room, gym and even a greenhouse. Last week it celebrated the sun's return above the horizon after six months of night with a six-hole ice-golf tournament.
An extension, IceCube-Gen2, encompassing 8 cubic kilometres of ice, is planned to become operational in 2033 and will be able to detect 10 times as many neutrinos, including much weaker ones.
Halzen said the main fruits of his work were yet to be seen and that it was too early to say exactly what it could reveal about the universe.
"The real excitement is that I cannot answer that question yet," he said. "This is just an introduction to the science, the astronomy is still to come."
WINNERS FROM EINSTEIN TO BOHR AND THE CURIES Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever congratulated Halzen on the recognition of "a life dedicated to unraveling the greatest secrets of the cosmos through its most minuscule manifestations".
The physics laureate receives an award of 12 million Swedish crowns (US$1.2 million). Past winners include several other neutrino research pioneers, for instance Japan's Takaaki Kajita and Arthur McDonald from Canada in 2015.
The Nobel Prizes were established under the will of Swedish inventor and entrepreneur Alfred Nobel, whose fortune was built in part on the invention of dynamite.
Physics was prominent in Nobel's will and the prize remains one of the discipline's highest distinctions. Over the decades, it has recognised discoveries that have fundamentally reshaped humanity's understanding of the universe.
Among past laureates are some of the most celebrated figures in science, including Albert Einstein, Marie and Pierre Curie, Max Planck and Niels Bohr, whose work helped establish the foundations of modern physics.
The prize is presented in Stockholm on Dec 10, the anniversary of Nobel's death.

Source: Reuters/fh

Shares in ASOS dropped more than 11 per cent on Tuesday (Oct 6) after media reports said customers of the British online fashion retailer received push notifications saying the company was hacked.
Reuters could not immediately verify the reports. An ASOS spokesperson said it was aware of the reports but did not confirm or comment further.  
The notification - addressed to ASOS' data protection officer and IT department - read, "we have fully compromised the Snowflake instance. Engage with us, or we will leak it," according to the reports.
"Snowflake is a massive cloud database where retailers typically store sensitive customer information, a real worry if cyber criminals have indeed accessed it as they claim," said Dray Agha, senior manager of security operations at cybersecurity platform Huntress.
British companies and institutions have been increasingly hit by aggressive and regular cyber and ransomware attacks in recent years. The British Library, a blood testing service, the London Underground, Marks & Spencer, the Co-op and Jaguar Land Rover are some of the companies that have suffered months of disruption due to such breaches.
"The push notification suggests attackers have breached the systems controlling the ASOS mobile app also," Agha said. "Sending a ransom demand directly to consumer devices is an aggressive extortion tactic designed to force the business into a quick negotiation."
ASOS shares were up more than 60 per cent so far this year. The company has been divesting assets and last month provided an upbeat profit forecast for fiscal 2026.
