items.title: Californians blast Trump remark that Iran could 'take out' Los Angeles, San Diego
items.author: Steve Gorman, Bo Erickson
items.creator: Steve Gorman, Bo Erickson
items.summary: President Donald Trump suggested to a crowd of his supporters in Nebraska that Iran could "take out" a major US city like Los Angeles or San Diego, drawing a swift rebuke from California's Democratic leaders and some fellow Republicans.
items.body:
President Donald Trump suggested to a crowd of his supporters in Nebraska that Iran could "take out" a major US city like Los Angeles or San Diego, drawing a swift rebuke from California's Democratic leaders and some fellow Republicans.
Trump, speaking at a [USN:L1N45R0ZC TEXT:"political rally"] in the state's farm belt on Monday, discussed American wartime economic sacrifices and said he was determined to "see a tremendous victory, because it verifies all the things we did."
"And again, remember, with the war, it's just artificial, it's a little bit high, it's a small price to pay," he told the crowd in Grand Island, Nebraska, apparently referring to rising prices of fuel, fertilizer and other products attributed to energy market disruptions from the war.
"It's a small price to pay for keeping the world safe, for keeping our country safe. They could take out a city. Let 'em take out Los Angeles, let 'em take out San Diego. This is a very small price to pay, and it's going to be over with very soon," he said.
"It's essentially almost over with," Trump went on. "But it's going to end very soon, and it's going to end one way or the other."
On Tuesday, the White House dismissed criticism of the remark. "The media freakout over President Trump’s comments is not rooted in reality. He was clearly stating U.S. cities would have been threatened if a nuclear Iran hadn't been stopped," White House Director of Communications Steven Cheung said in a social media post. "America is safer because of the President. Iran has no nuclear, no navy, no air force, and no money."
Trump has shrugged off cost-of-living concerns stemming from the Iran conflict before, and he previously downplayed his concerns about the potential for Iran or its allies to launch an attack on US soil.
EARLY VOTING UNDERWAY IN CALIFORNIA The comment in rural Nebraska, a state Trump won with more than 55% of the vote in the 2024 presidential election, targeted Democratic-run cities in California, a solidly Democratic state the president often criticizes.
Monday's comments prompted a backlash from California officials.
California Governor Gavin Newsom, a Democrat, denounced the Republican president as "deranged and dangerous."
"After sending the National Guard and Marines to occupy California, Donald Trump is now saying our foreign enemies should 'take out' Los Angeles and San Diego," he wrote on X.
Newsom, who has positioned himself as a major political foil to Trump and is seen as a potential 2028 presidential candidate, juxtaposed a video clip of Trump in Nebraska with mention of the president's previous rhetoric to justify deploying US military troops to Los Angeles and other cities to fight crime and enforce immigration.
California's early voting for the November midterm elections started on Monday. The president's Republican Party has hoped to win more races in the state in recent years, including this year's gubernatorial election.
Newsom championed the redrawing of California's [USN:S0N3WN09U TEXT:"congressional map"] last year to favor Democrats in this year's election after Trump pushed for conservative-led Texas to [USN:L1N3TX13Y TEXT:"redraw its map"] to boost Republicans.
One of the Republicans running in a competitive race in a redrawn California district near San Diego, Jim Desmond, distanced himself from Trump's remarks.
"I vehemently disagree with President Trump’s comments. America must stand up to Iran and defend our interests, but the first responsibility of our Commander in Chief is to protect the American people and our homeland," he wrote on X. "No American city is expendable, and no American family should ever be treated as collateral damage."
Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass, a Democrat and former member of Congress, likewise chided Trump for his comments.
"The president of the United States suggested that a foreign government attack Los Angeles. His statements against our city are dangerous and could potentially compromise our safety," Bass said in a statement.
Los Angeles and San Diego rank as the largest and second-largest cities in California by population.
More than 115,000 activity-duty service members are also stationed in San Diego, including Naval Base San Diego, the largest on the United States' west coast.
"My constituents — including many active duty service members, veterans, and their families — are not acceptable collateral damage in Trump’s stupid war," US Representative Sara Jacobs, a Democrat, said in a social media post.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ロンドン ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は６日、２％の目標を上回るインフレが英国経済に定着してしまったようだと述べた。

経済助言会社ＴＳロンバードが主催した会議で「私がこの職に就いて以来、インフレ率は一貫して目標を大幅に上回ってきた。インフレは定着してしまった」と語った。

また、賃金交渉が活発化する年末年始ごろにインフレ率が４％に達する見通しであることに特に懸念を示した。

マン氏は、英国の経済需要は力強いとは思えないものの、ポジティブとの見解を示した。

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は６日、２％の目標を上回るインフレが英国経済に定着してしまったようだと述べた。

また、賃金交渉が活発化する年末年始ごろにインフレ率が４％に達する見通しであることに特に懸念を示した。

マン氏は、英国の経済需要は力強いとは思えないものの、ポジティブとの見解を示した。

‘I am Giorgia’: Ahead of polls, Italy PM Meloni wants voice trademarked before AI puts words in her mouth

Italian PM Giorgia Meloni has filed an EU trademark application for her voice, as concerns grow over AI-generated political deepfakes ahead of next year’s election.

Jeyasri AT

06 October, 2026 03:18 pm IST

Facebook

Prime Minister Narendra Modi in a conversation with Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni in Rome in May | DPR PMO/ANI

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-
A+

-->

New Delhi: A four-second recording could become Georgia Meloni’s defence against AI. Italy’s Prime Minister, Georgia Meloni, wants to legally protect her voice, a big part of her public image, as artificial intelligence makes it easier than ever to fake audio. 

Meloni filed a sound trademark application with the European Union Intellectual Property Office this Monday (5 October). It is a four-second clip where she says “Io sono Giorgia Meloni” (“I am Giorgia Meloni”) twice. Right now, the application is still under review, so EU trademark protection isn’t official yet, as reported by the Financial Times .

The recorded phrase echoes Meloni’s famous declaration at a 2019 political rally: “I am Giorgia, I am a woman, I am a mother, I am Italian, I am Christian.” The slogan became widely known in Italy and inspired a viral dance remix. “Io sono Giorgia” was also the title of her 2021 autobiography.

Show Full Article

According to Reuters , Italian media has reported that even if approved, it would not by itself prevent the use of her voice in AI-generated deepfakes, though it could create additional legal obstacles for those seeking to replicate it.

If the trademark goes through, she’ll be the first major politician to get this kind of protection for her voice. Singers and other celebrities have done it before, but politicians haven’t till now.

Celebrities like Matthew McConaughey and Taylor Swift have filed legal trademark and registration protections for their voices with intellectual property authorities to guard against unauthorised AI voice cloning and deepfakes.

This isn’t Meloni’s first time in legal battles over deepfakes. In 2024, she filed a civil lawsuit against a man accused of creating and distributing pornographic deepfake images using her face. The case remains pending before an Italian court.

What Meloni is trying to protect
The trademark doesn’t cover every possible use of her voice. The European Union Intellectual Property Office ( EUIPO) recognises sound as a category of EU trademark. The rules say the sound itself must be clearly represented, usually in an audio file, and any protection sticks only to specific goods and services named in the application.

So, registering the sound won’t stop AI clones altogether. But it does give Meloni a stronger intellectual property argument to challenge unauthorised uses, if they fall under her registration.

Why now? 
Italy expects its next general election in 2027, and everyone’s struggling to tell real political content from AI-generated fakes. 

This move comes as generative AI now allows people to clone voices and create entirely new speech.

For politicians, that means someone can create a speech or endorsement from scratch, spread it online, and the damage is done before anyone realises it is fake. Today, the technology doesn’t only recreate politician’s faces, it can fake their voices and put words in their mouths. Meloni’s application marks a new attempt to use existing laws to bear against AI-generated impersonation.

(Edited by Viny Mishra)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ジュネーブ　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ジュネーブ　６日　ロイター］ - 世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）は６日、ロシアのイルクーツクにあるペスト研究所で女性職員が死亡した事案について、ロシア当局が同日、当地でペストの症例は確認されていないとＷＨＯに報告したと明らかにした。

ＷＨＯのリンドマイヤー報道官が、ＷＨＯの照会に対するロシア側の公式回答を発表した。公式回答は「イルクーツク市において、この危険な疾患の症例は記録されていない」と表明。死亡した職員と接触した人々を特定し、危険な感染性病原体の検査結果は陰性だったとした。

検査結果について、死亡した職員に対しても検査を実施したのか、また職員についてペストの可能性を排除できたのか、ロイターは今のところ確認できていない。ジュネーブの国連ロシア代表部はコメント要請に応じていない。

items.body:
香港株式市場は海外市場に追随して堅調。製薬株やハイテク株が上昇した。    ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１％近く上昇した。    ハンセン・バイオテック指数は３．２%上昇し、ハンセン・テック指数は０．９%上昇した。    HSBC Qianhaiの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者リンダ・シュー氏はリポートで「２０２６年には主要な製薬企業のほとんどが堅調な成長を遂げると予想している」と記した。    半面、主要な不動産開発会社の株価は下落し、新鴻基地産（サンフンカイ・プロパティーズ）は０．６％安、長江実業集団（ＣＫアセット・ホールディングス）は０．３％安となった。    ＵＯＢケイヒアンは「（住宅）価格は２０２６年を通じてもみ合いが続くと予想している」と指摘した。    新世界発展（ニューワールド・デベロップメント）３．５％安。２７年および２８年に満期を迎える一部社債について、３２年に満期を迎える新たな担保付社債とスワップする債務交換オファーを発表した。    中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で７日まで休場。取引は８日に再開する。

休場明けのソウル株式市場は下落。今週発表されるサムスン電子の決算を控え、半導体株が売られた。

未来アセット証券のアナリスト、ソ・サンヨン氏は「メモリー半導体価格の継続的な上昇を背景にサムスン電子の決算は良好な内容になるとみられるが、債券利回りの高止まりが相場全般の重しとなっている」と指摘した。    

半導体のサムスン電子は１．４５％安、同業のＳＫハイニックスは３．６９％下落した。

電池メーカーのＬＧエネルギーソリューションが５．１２％上昇。現代自動車は０．４３％高、傘下の起亜は０．２７％安だった。

売買された９１８銘柄のうち、値上がりは４２５、値下がりは４６１。    

外国人投資家は差し引き１兆８０００億ウォン（１３億４０００万ドル）の売り越し。

シドニー株式市場は３営業日続伸して取引を終えた。銅価格の上昇を背景に主力鉱山株が買われたほか、原油安でインフレ懸念が和らいだ。

金融株指数は０．７％上昇し、３営業日続伸。４大銀行は全て上昇し、上昇率は０．６─０．８％だった。不動産株指数は１．１％上昇し、４営業日ぶりに反発した。センター・グループは２．７％、ＧＰＴグループは２．３％それぞれ上昇した。

鉱業株指数は銅価格の上昇を受けて０．９％上昇した。業界大手のＢＨＰグループは１．６％高となり、約１カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。ハイテク株指数は３％近く下落し、１カ月余りで最大の下落率を記録した。ワイズテック・グローバルは２．５％下落し、下げを主導した。

items.body:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（16日）
10/6 18:34 配信

香港株式市場は海外市場に追随して堅調。製薬株やハイテク株が上昇した。    ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１％近く上昇した。    ハンセン・バイオテック指数は３．２%上昇し、ハンセン・テック指数は０．９%上昇した。    HSBC Qianhaiの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者リンダ・シュー氏はリポートで「２０２６年には主要な製薬企業のほとんどが堅調な成長を遂げると予想している」と記した。    半面、主要な不動産開発会社の株価は下落し、新鴻基地産（サンフンカイ・プロパティーズ）は０．６％安、長江実業集団（ＣＫアセット・ホールディングス）は０．３％安となった。    ＵＯＢケイヒアンは「（住宅）価格は２０２６年を通じてもみ合いが続くと予想している」と指摘した。    新世界発展（ニューワールド・デベロップメント）３．５％安。２７年および２８年に満期を迎える一部社債について、３２年に満期を迎える新たな担保付社債とスワップする債務交換オファーを発表した。    中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で７日まで休場。取引は８日に再開する。

休場明けのソウル株式市場は下落。今週発表されるサムスン電子の決算を控え、半導体株が売られた。

未来アセット証券のアナリスト、ソ・サンヨン氏は「メモリー半導体価格の継続的な上昇を背景にサムスン電子の決算は良好な内容になるとみられるが、債券利回りの高止まりが相場全般の重しとなっている」と指摘した。    

半導体のサムスン電子は１．４５％安、同業のＳＫハイニックスは３．６９％下落した。

電池メーカーのＬＧエネルギーソリューションが５．１２％上昇。現代自動車は０．４３％高、傘下の起亜は０．２７％安だった。

売買された９１８銘柄のうち、値上がりは４２５、値下がりは４６１。    

外国人投資家は差し引き１兆８０００億ウォン（１３億４０００万ドル）の売り越し。

シドニー株式市場は３営業日続伸して取引を終えた。銅価格の上昇を背景に主力鉱山株が買われたほか、原油安でインフレ懸念が和らいだ。

金融株指数は０．７％上昇し、３営業日続伸。４大銀行は全て上昇し、上昇率は０．６─０．８％だった。不動産株指数は１．１％上昇し、４営業日ぶりに反発した。センター・グループは２．７％、ＧＰＴグループは２．３％それぞれ上昇した。

鉱業株指数は銅価格の上昇を受けて０．９％上昇した。業界大手のＢＨＰグループは１．６％高となり、約１カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。ハイテク株指数は３％近く下落し、１カ月余りで最大の下落率を記録した。ワイズテック・グローバルは２．５％下落し、下げを主導した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
David Milliken

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
David Milliken

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが６日発表した英国の９月の建設業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は４６．１だった。８月の４４．３から改善したものの、好不況の分かれ目である５０を引き続き下回った。ただ落ち込みは１月以降で最も穏やかだった。

英建設業ＰＭＩは２０２５年１月から５０を下回っている。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスの経済ディレクター、ティム・ムーア氏は「９月の新規受注は相対的に低迷した。建設企業は営業から受注までの期間が長期化しており、顧客が大型プロジェクトの意思決定を先送りにしていると指摘した」と述べた。

・新規受注指数は４５．９で、前月の４７．７から低下し３カ月ぶりの低水準。

・投入価格の上昇率は２月のイラン戦争勃発以来、最も緩やかなペースとなった。ただしムーア氏は、エネルギーコストの上昇を踏まえると、この傾向が続く可能性は低いと述べた。

・今後の活動見通しは５月以来で最も弱かった。

・部門別では住宅建設が引き続き最も低調で、土木工事がこれに続いた。一方、商業施設は小幅な低下にとどまった。

・サービス、製造業、建設業のＰＭＩデータを含む全セクターＰＭＩは５１．５で前月の５１．８から低下し、３カ月ぶりの低水準。

items.title: Audi’s $89,000 Q9 Shows Chinese Competition Is Hitting the US
items.author: Liam Denning
items.creator: Liam Denning
items.summary: America’s automakers enjoy the refuge of an anti-Chinese wall. But so do foreign, non-Chinese automakers who also sell vehicles in America, especially if they manufacture here. This means Chinese competition is exerting pressure on US dealer lots already; indirectly, yes, but it’s likely to intensify. Detroit’s defensive moat is less impenetrable than it might seem.

items.title: Sterling slips from three-month high against euro as traders watch French bonds
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The pound eased against the euro on Tuesday as French bonds rallied from the previous session's fall that helped propel sterling to an almost three-month high.
items.body:
The pound eased against the euro on Tuesday as French bonds rallied from the previous session's fall that helped propel sterling to an almost three-month high.
The euro [USN:L6N45S0D2 TEXT:"fell sharply"] on Monday as investors worried that a dramatic fall in French bonds due to concerns about public debt and a looming election was spreading to other markets such as Italy.
Yet French bonds rose on Tuesday, pushing yields lower and helping currency markets stabilise.
The euro was last up 0.1% at 84.88 pence after hitting an almost three-month low of 84.61 pence on Monday following seven straight sessions of declines.
Sterling was around 0.1% higher against the dollar at $1.322.
Aside from euro zone bond markets, the focus for UK traders is likely to be on Bank of England officials this week.
Catherine Mann, who voted to raise rates in July and September, [USN:S8N42Q0DO TEXT:"said on Tuesday"] that inflation has become embedded in the UK.
Governor Andrew Bailey is among a handful of BoE policymakers speaking on Thursday.
The central bank has so far held rates during the Iran war-driven spike in energy costs but traders currently price in around an 80% chance of a rate hike in November and around 100 basis points of total monetary tightening by the end of next year.
Later this month, the British budget could cause swings in sterling and domestic bond markets.
[USN:L6N45S0EX TEXT:"Morgan Stanley"] on Tuesday said the pound appears to be pricing in too little fiscal risk ahead of the budget on October 28 and recommended betting on sterling to fall, saying it was targeting a drop to $1.285.
"With so many medium-term decisions yet to be made, a challenging tax-hiking arithmetic and relatively benign expectations from market participants around this Budget — at least per our conversations — we see more pronounced downside than upside risks," the bank's strategists wrote in a research note.

items.title: 東エルサレムの英領事館、閉鎖ならイスラエル外交官追放も＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Alexander Cornwell

[テルアビブ ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Alexander Cornwell

[テルアビブ ６日 ロイター] - イスラエル入植地を対象とした制裁を巡る対立で、イスラエルが今週、東エルサレムにある英国領事館の閉鎖命令を実行した場合、英国は対抗措置としてイスラエルの外交官を追放する可能性が高い。関係筋４人が明らかにした。

パレスチナ自治区ヨルダン川西岸の入植地で生産された製品の輸入を禁止する方針を英国が発表したことを受け、イスラエルは先月、同領事館を３０日以内に閉鎖し、外交官を同市から退去させるよう命じた。

関係筋によると、８日が領事館閉鎖の期限となる。同領事館に勤務する約３０人の英国人外交官とその家族が影響を受ける。

関係筋は領事館が閉鎖されれば、英国は対抗措置として、駐英イスラエル大使館から同程度の人数を追放する可能性が高いと述べた。

領事館は東エルサレムのシェイクジャラ地区にあり、エルサレム市内やヨルダン川西岸、ガザ地区のパレスチナ人との関係窓口を務めるほか、パレスチナ人向けの領事業務も行っている。

別の関係筋２人によると、イスラエル政府に決定を撤回させるため、英国は欧州各国に対し、この問題をイスラエル側に提起するよう求めた。

HSBC Qianhaiの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者リンダ・シュー氏はリポートで「２０２６年には主要な製薬企業のほとんどが堅調な成長を遂げると予想している」と記した。

半面、主要な不動産開発会社の株価は下落し、新鴻基地産（サンフンカイ・プロパティーズ）は０．６％安、長江実業集団（ＣＫアセット・ホールディングス）は０．３％安となった。

ＵＯＢケイヒアンは「（住宅）価格は２０２６年を通じてもみ合いが続くと予想している」と指摘した。

新世界発展（ニューワールド・デベロップメント）３．５％安。２７年および２８年に満期を迎える一部社債について、３２年に満期を迎える新たな担保付社債とスワップする債務交換オファーを発表した。

中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で７日まで休場。取引は８日に再開する。

ROME, Oct 6 : Italy's antitrust authority said on Tuesday it had opened an investigation into AI music startup Suno, saying some clauses in its terms of service may be unfair to consumers.
• Suno was not immediately available for comment
• Suno's terms could create a significant imbalance in the rights and obligations of users, the watchdog said
• They give Suno "broad discretion" to unilaterally modify its contract, service and subscription prices without having to provide any justification, it added in a statement

• It added it would launch a consultation in the coming weeks in which interested business groups, chambers of commerce and consumer associations could participate

Miho Uranaka　Yantoultra Ngui

[東京 ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Miho Uranaka　Yantoultra Ngui

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 米投資会社ベインキャピタルとシンガポール政府系ファンドのＧＩＣが、人事管理システムを手がけるＷＨＩホールディングス（東京都港区）について、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）または第三者への売却を検討しており、５０００億円超の企業価値を目指していることが分かった。事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。

関係者によると、両社は、このプロセスの一環として、アドバイザーや潜在的な買い手、投資家への打診を始めている。選択肢の一つとして日本市場への上場が検討されているほか、事業会社や他のファンドなどへの売却も検討しているという。

協議は初期段階にあり、最終的な決定は下されていない。ベインとＧＩＣは最終的に保有を継続する可能性もあるという。

ベインとＧＩＣはコメントを控えた。ＷＨＩのコメントは現時点で得られていない。

ベインは２０１９年、ワークスアプリケーションズ（同千代田区）から人事ソフト事業を取得し、ＷＨＩを発足させた。取得額は公表されていない。２０２３年３月にはＧＩＣがＷＨＩに共同出資し、両社は共同支配株主となった。

ＷＨＩ傘下の中核事業会社ワークスヒューマンインテリジェンスは、人事管理、給与計算、勤怠管理、タレントマネジメントなどの機能を備えた大企業向け人事システム「ＣＯＭＰＡＮＹ」の開発・販売・サポートを手掛ける。ＷＨＩホールディングスのホームページによると、国内大手法人約１２００グループで利用されている。

items.title: ルペン氏、歳出削減目標1400億ユーロ　仏大統領選にらみ財政構想
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [パリ ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[パリ ６日 ロイター] - フランスの極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」のマリーヌ・ルペン氏は６日、来年の大統領選挙を見据えて、財政運営方針を示した。同国の債務が雪だるま式に膨らむ危機に瀕していると指摘し、歳出削減規模を従来方針から拡大した。

＜就任後１８カ月以内に基礎的財政収支均衡＞

ルペン氏は、大統領に就任した場合、就任後１８カ月以内に基礎的財政収支を均衡させると述べた。

財政赤字の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比率を２０３０年までに３％未満にし、任期最終年の３２年までに２．５％未満に引き下げるとした。

公的債務は２７年のＧＤＰ比約１２１％から３２年までに１１２％に下げる。

歳出は、３２年までに、少なくとも３００億ユーロの減税分を差し引いて１４００億ユーロ（１５７０億ドル）削減する。任期終了までに公的支出をＧＤＰ比５０％未満に下げるとした。

財政の混乱は選挙戦の最大の争点になっている。

ルペン氏は、現在ＧＤＰ比１１９％の公的債務が６０％に下がるまで、財政赤字を毎年少なくとも０．５ポイント減らすことを義務付ける「黄金律」を国民投票にかけ、財政規律を憲法に明記したいと述べた。

また欧州連合（ＥＵ）の予算協議でフランスの純拠出額を５０億ユーロ（５６億１０００万ドル）に減らすよう求める考えを示した。

さらに、数週間以内にフランスの年金制度に関する提案を行うと表明した。節税スキームを利用して納税額を圧縮している多国籍企業への対策として、売上高に占めるフランス国内での売上高の割合に基づいて課税する方針を示した。

＜金利上昇巡りＥＣＢと協議＞

同氏は、フランスが財政を再び管理できるようになった段階で、借り入れコストを引き下げるための介入について欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と協議すべきだと述べた。

ＥＣＢには、市場の圧力に直面したユーロ加盟国の国債を、健全な経済政策の維持を条件に買い入れる伝達保護措置（ＴＰＩ）という制度がある。レスキュール経済・財務相は６日、同国の国債市場の混乱について、資金調達環境の安定に向けてＴＰＩの活用を検討する段階には至っていないとの認識を示した。

［６日　ロイター］ - 英情報通信庁は６日、米メタ・プラットフォームズの写真共有アプリ「インスタグラム」の新機能「インスタンツ（Instants）」を巡り調査を開始したと発表した。導入前にリスクを適切に評価しておらず、同国のオンライン安全関連法に違反した疑いがあるとした。

インスタンツは、利用者が共有したコンテンツが閲覧後に消去される機能で５月に導入された。

情報通信庁は、メタが新機能を導入する前に違法コンテンツのリスクや児童への潜在的リスクについて「適切かつ十分な」評価を実施したかどうかを確認する方針。

オフコムの執行責任者ジョージ・ラスティ氏は「われわれのオンライン安全法は明確だ。プラットフォームの重大な変更は立ち上げ前にリスク評価を受けなければならない」と述べた。

安全性は設計段階から組み込む必要があり、後付けするものではないと指摘。「本日の調査開始は、提供事業者がコンプライアンス違反の懸念がある場合、われわれが行動することを示している」とした。

メタは、オンライン安全法に基づく規制上の義務を真剣に受け止めているとし、調査に協力すると述べた。

同社の広報担当者は「リスク分析を実施した上で、導入前に何度もＯｆｃｏｍに同機能について説明した」と述べた。

「インスタンツには保護機能が組み込まれている。スクリーンショットや再共有、転送はできず、公開フィードもない。『ティーンアカウント』の保護機能も自動で有効になる」とした。

items.title: Crew goes missing after ship sinks in Black Sea Zone of Bulgaria following drone strike, says PM
items.author: Swati Gandhi
items.summary: Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev on Tuesday (local time) said that the crew of a ship that sunk following a drone strike in the country's Black Sea Zone is missing, Reuters reported.
items.body:
Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev on Tuesday (local time) said that the crew of a ship that sank following a drone strike in the country's Black Sea zone is missing, AFP reported.Speaking to reporters, Radev condemned the drone attack on two commercial ships, calling it "a flagrant violation of maritime law". He added, "Such an attack within the Bulgarian exclusive economic zone is absolutely unacceptable." Here's what we knowHis remarks came shortly after local media reported that drones struck two commercial vessels in the Black Sea off the coast of Bulgaria, sinking one of them. After convening an emergency meeting on Tuesday, Radev stated that the ships were attacked by several drones roughly 80 miles (128km) off Bulgaria's coast.Rumen Nikolov, head of local rescue operations in Varna, was quoted as saying that sailors from the sunken ship were missing, while those aboard the second vessel were rescued, AFP reported.Rescue teams were searching for the missing sailors about 150 kilometres (90 miles) east of the coastal city of Byala. At least 18 crew members from the other vessel were evacuated by a Bulgarian ferry following the strikes. Of the evacuated members, two suffered severe injuries and were flown to a hospital in the port city of Varna, Radev stated.Radev said the Togo-flagged vessel Alfa Watan sustained severe structural damage in the strike and sank at the site, while the status of its crew remained unclear.British maritime security and risk consultancy Vanguard said two cargo ships were targeted by drones on Tuesday while operating within Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone, according to Reuters.The vessels involved were the Togo-flagged general cargo ship ALFA WATAN and the Palau-flagged ABLE. According to Vanguard, both ships sent distress alerts after the attacks, while Bulgarian sources told Reuters that drones had struck the vessels.The latest incident comes a day after Romanian authorities reported that two people were killed in a fire aboard a ship in the Black Sea, outside Romania’s territorial waters.Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy attributed that incident to Russian drone attacks. Russia had not immediately commented on the allegation.
The Black Sea has faced growing security risks since Russia launched its invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Several European nations have since reported incidents involving Russian drones entering their airspace, while sea mines have also been detected in the Black Sea, affecting key trade and energy routes.
Last month, Turkey's Chamber of Maritime Commerce (IMEAK) said that 226 civilian and commercial ships had come under attack in the Black Sea since the war began, with most of the incidents recorded this year.

items.title: 仏高校デモが一部暴徒化、警察が催涙ガスで応戦　逮捕6100人に
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Inti Landauro

［ストラスブール／リヨン／パリ　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Inti Landauro

［ストラスブール／リヨン／パリ　６日　ロイター］ - フランスでは６日、教員不足や校舎の老朽化への対策を求める全国の高校生らが校舎を封鎖した。今回の抗議活動で最大規模のデモが行われ、生徒や教員、保護者が街頭に繰り出した。警察は高校を封鎖する抗議参加者に催涙ガスを発射した。 

マルセイユやナントでは、参加者が「国が教育を壊した」などと書かれたプラカードを掲げ、デモはおおむね平穏に行われた。トゥールーズでは、保護者が腕を組んで市内を行進するデモ隊の先頭に立った。

一方、ストラスブール、リヨン、レンヌではデモが時折、暴力的な衝突に発展。抗議参加者が路上で火を付けたりする事態となり、警察が催涙ガスを発射して鎮圧に乗り出した。

抗議活動は２週間前にパリ郊外の貧困地区で始まり、全国に広がった。学校前では、１０代の生徒らがごみ箱で築いたバリケードの上に立った。パリでは「催涙ガスではなく、私たちの声に耳を傾けて」「私たちの未来を後回しにするな」と書いた横断幕が掲げられた。

高校生団体によると、国内の高校の半数超が封鎖されるか、この日は休校となる見通し。一部の地方教育当局は授業のオンライン移行を試みている。 

＜逮捕者は数千人に＞

政府は、抗議活動が都市部での暴力行為に変質したとして、機動隊を投入した。

内務省によると、抗議活動の開始以来６１００人が逮捕され、圧倒的多数が未成年だった。未成年１４８３人を含む１８００人超が訴追されているが、司法省は罪名は明らかにしていない。首相府によると、衝突で少なくとも警察官７１５人と１０代の若者２１５人が負傷した。 

人権団体や生徒、保護者団体は、当局が未成年者に対して過剰な実力行使をしていると非難。一方、政府は、抗議活動が部外者に乗っ取られ、都市部での暴力行為に変質したと主張している。 

大統領選を６カ月後に控え、政府と極右政党・国民連合は、急進左派「不服従のフランス」（ＬＦＩ）の議員や市長らが抗議活動をあおっていると非難している。ＬＦＩはこうした非難を否定している。

items.title: ユーロ圏金利上昇、エネ価格の波及を抑制＝フィンランド中銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、ユーロ圏全体で急速に進んでいるエネルギー価格の上昇はまだ他の財やサービスには波及しておらず、最近の債券利回りの上昇は成長を圧迫することで物価上昇圧力を和らげる可能性が高いと述べた。

多くの政策当局者がインフレリスクは予想よりも高めに傾いていると指摘する中、レーン氏は、経済には相反する力が働いているため、他にも考慮すべき点があると指摘。「長期金利の上昇は成長の鈍化につながるだけでなく、エネルギー価格が他の物価や賃金に波及する度合いを弱めている」と語った。

また、人工知能（ＡＩ）への力強い投資などにより、経済が並外れた強靭性を示しているとも指摘した。

一部の政策当局者はこうした強靭性について、これまで考えられていたよりも強い物価上昇圧力を示唆していると指摘している。

items.title: Kenya confirms first Ebola case imported from Congo after man dies in Nairobi
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on Tuesday after a Kenyan citizen who had travelled from Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi.
items.body:
Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on Tuesday after a Kenyan citizen who had travelled from Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi.
Kenya is the fourth country to record a case linked to the Ebola epidemic in eastern Congo, the [USN:L1N45O094 TEXT:"second largest on record"] with more than 8,000 cases.
Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths earlier in the year but was declared Ebola-free in August. A doctor who [USN:L8N42W0OV TEXT:"returned to France"] in June from Congo tested positive but there was no further spread of the virus.
The Kenyan patient, who had lived in Congo for seven years, had been ill for about a month before travelling by road from Congo to Uganda's capital, Kampala, and then flying to Nairobi on Saturday, Kenya's Health Minister Aden Duale told a news conference.
After arriving at Nairobi's international airport, he passed through health screening and was later taken by a relative to Nairobi Hospital. He was admitted with fever, chills and bleeding beneath the skin and was quickly placed in isolation, Duale said.
He died late on Monday.
The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention said in a statement that it was immediately sending a high-level team to Kenya to provide support, adding that the case "underscores the importance of sustained preparedness across the region".
World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said on X that WHO was supporting the Kenyan and Ugandan governments and recommended against any travel restrictions on countries affected by the outbreak.
PATIENT TO BE BURIED ON TUESDAY The patient was due to be buried later on Tuesday under protocols designed to prevent further spread of the virus, Duale said.
Health authorities have identified 28 people he came into contact with in Kenya, including relatives and healthcare workers. They are trying to trace another 23 passengers and four crew members who were on his Jambojet flight, Duale said.
Duale said Kenya had trained nearly 5,000 health workers across the country on prevention and management and the UN's senior Ebola coordinator, Julien Harneis, told Reuters he expected a "solid health response" from Kenya to manage the disease.
Nevertheless, the incident raised questions about measures meant to prevent the spread of the virus across borders.
Kenya's health ministry director general, Patrick Amoth, said the patient may have passed through airport screening because medication had masked his symptoms.
It was also not clear how he had crossed from Congo into Uganda, given that the border has been closed since May. Africa CDC said he spent a night in Uganda before boarding the flight to Kenya.
Asked about this, Ugandan government spokesperson Alan Kasujja said he had no idea what the man's condition was while in Uganda.
"Leave Uganda out of this conversation," he said in a text message. "We don't have Ebola here."
KENYA HOSTS US EBOLA QUARANTINE FACILITY After the outbreak was declared in Congo, the United States built a 50-bed Ebola quarantine camp for US citizens on an air force base in central Kenya.
The facility is currently empty and has only housed seven people. Kenyan officials have said it could receive Kenyans and other nationalities, but the US government has not confirmed that.
Ebola spreads through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people, whether living or dead. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding.
The outbreak in Congo was declared in mid-May but may have started months earlier. Caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, it has been blamed for more than 4,000 deaths .

items.title: Former German spy chief arrested for attempted treason, obtaining state secrets
items.author: Friederike Heine
items.creator: Friederike Heine
items.summary: Former German spy chief August Hanning was detained on Tuesday on suspicion of attempted treason in a case that ranks among Germany's biggest intelligence scandals since the Cold War.
items.body:
Former German spy chief August Hanning was detained on Tuesday on suspicion of attempted treason in a case that ranks among Germany's biggest intelligence scandals since the Cold War.
Prosecutors accused him of paying for secret documents and using them in an analysis for a foreign spy service. They did not identify the intelligence service and it was not immediately clear whether the analysis reached its intended recipient.
The arrest of a former head of Germany's foreign intelligence is unprecedented and could damage the country's intelligence relationships with allied nations, according to a senior security lawmaker.
"Hanning is strongly suspected of treasonous espionage, obtaining state secrets, attempted treason and espionage," the prosecutor's office said in a statement.
Hanning did not respond to a request for comment from Reuters. The chancellery declined to comment.
Five years after his seven-year tenure as head of the BND foreign intelligence service ended in 2005, Hanning agreed with a former BND office manager to receive confidential intelligence information in exchange for payment, according to prosecutors.
The office manager, identified as Manfred D. in line with privacy rules, was also arrested on Tuesday, and both were due to appear before a judge at the Federal Court of Justice.
Manfred D. served as office manager to successive BND presidents until March 2026, potentially giving him access to some of Germany's most current intelligence at the time that prosecutors say documents were being siphoned from the service.
'NO COMPROMISES' Prosecutors said D. is suspected of having supplied around 2,000 documents over the years, including classified material intended solely for internal use within the BND and senior-level intelligence briefings at the chancellery.
Those included documents relating to the Iranian nuclear programme and the Russian military, as well as highly sensitive material classified as secret by allied intelligence agencies in other countries, Sueddeutsche Zeitung (SZ) newspaper reported.
Prosecutors said Hanning had used classified information supplied by D. to prepare an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service and for years shared political information with a representative of the spy agency.
The case does not involve Russia, according to information obtained by Sueddeutsche Zeitung.
Conservative security expert Roderich Kiesewetter told the Handelsblatt newspaper on Tuesday that the case could strain relations with Germany's intelligence allies, saying espionage cases of this kind were "particularly burdensome for trust and particularly damaging for Germany".
BND President Martin Jaeger said the agency had launched extensive internal investigations as soon as suspicions emerged, adding, "There can be no compromises on internal security."
PAST SPY SCANDALS Hanning's arrest is the latest in a series of notorious espionage scandals in Germany.
West German Chancellor Willy Brandt was forced to resign in 1974 after it was revealed that an East German spy had worked as his close aide for nearly two years. In 1990, senior West German counter-intelligence official Klaus Kuron was exposed as a Stasi spy and later convicted of treason.
More recently, former domestic intelligence chief Hans-Georg Maassen said in 2024 he was now being monitored by the security agency he once ran over alleged right-wing political extremism, which he denied.

items.title: France's Mistral launches AI model it says outperforms some Chinese rivals
items.author: Elizabeth Howcroft, Leo Marchandon
items.creator: Elizabeth Howcroft, Leo Marchandon
items.summary: French AI startup Mistral unveiled a new AI model on Tuesday, ending a gap of about five months between major releases, and said it outperforms many rival open-weight models.
items.body:
French AI startup Mistral unveiled a new AI model on Tuesday, ending a gap of about five months between major releases, and said it outperforms many rival open-weight models.
The three-year-old company, widely viewed as Europe's strongest AI challenger to US and [USN:L8N43M04P TEXT:"Chinese competitors"], has not released a new model since May. In August, it began offering third-party models to customers, starting with Beijing-based Z.ai's GLM 5.3.
"The model we're actually announcing today is actually above the Chinese models on certain aspects, including cyber. So the narrative that Europe cannot compete is something that is not true," CEO Artur Mensch said at a launch event in Abu Dhabi, without specifying which Chinese models or benchmarks he was referring to.
Mistral said Le Chonk, officially named Mistral Large 4, will be made publicly available on October 27.
Before the release, cybersecurity experts and government authorities will be given access to a version with fewer safety restrictions to test its capabilities, the company said.
Pierre Stock, Mistral's vice president of science, told Reuters that the model ranks among the strongest open-weight, systems available.
Open-weight means users can download the model from platforms and run it on their own hardware. Many Chinese models are open-weight, while top US models tend to be closed and accessible only through their developers' infrastructure.
SAFETY RISKS CONTAINED Stock told Reuters the model had tried to go beyond its testing environment, but that this was expected and the company was able to prevent it.
OpenAI and Anthropic, whose most advanced models have demonstrated [USN:L6N43X166 TEXT:"similar behaviour"] in testing, have restricted access to their most cyber-capable systems.
After executives at US AI companies warned last month that AI could pose an existential threat to humanity, Mensch [USN:L6N4580UO TEXT:"dismissed"] such arguments as self-serving.
Mistral, which raised €3 billion ($3.4 billion) [USN:L6N44Z0PP TEXT:"in its latest funding round"], has positioned itself as a safer, European alternative.
'CLOSING THE GAP' Mistral said Large 4 is "closing the gap with frontier models" in areas including coding, finance, geospatial analysis, manufacturing and product design.
The company trained the model on its own infrastructure.
Stock said Mistral's goal was to partner "very deeply" with backers including [USN:L2N3UW06X TEXT:"ASML"] and new-investor [USN:L6N44Z0PP TEXT:"Samsung"] "across the entire value chain".
He said Large 4 is capable of designing computer chips, but declined to comment on whether Mistral is currently working with Samsung on chip development.
($1 = 0.8883 euros)
items.raw_description: French AI startup Mistral unveiled a new AI model on Tuesday, ending a gap of about five months between major releases, and said it outperforms many rival open-weight models.

items.body:
(本文３段落目の「２５年度」を「２００５年度」に訂正します)

Makiko Yamazaki　Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - 自民党の中西健治議員は６日、国債発行全体に占める個人向け販売を「桁違い」に拡大する必要があると述べた。税優遇を含む商品設計の見直しを通じ、国債消化の柱のひとつに据える考えを強調した。ロイターとのインタビューで語った。

財務省が６日発表した１０月発行分の個人向け国債（１０年変動、５年固定、３年固定）は１兆０２５１億円だった。

年度ベースでは累計６兆１６４１億円となり、当初計画（５兆９０００億円）をすでに上回った。過去最大だった２００５年度（訂正、７兆２７１２億円）を上回るペースにある。

ただ、中西氏は「もっと買ってもらえる余地はある」と強調。「そのための後押しは必要」との考えを述べた。

日銀が国債買い入れを減らす中、２０００兆円を超える家計の金融資産をどう取り込むかは、今後の財政運営を占う試金石となる。金利上昇に伴う個人向け国債の売れ行きは好調だが、保有比率は依然として低い。

中西氏はインタビューで、税優遇を含む商品設計の見直しにも言及。利回り曲線が傾斜化し、超長期債利回りが「魅力的な水準になってきている。（１０年を超える）長いものも、あったらいい」としている。

FAST

LONDON, Oct 6 : Britain's communications regulator opened its first formal investigation into Meta under the Online Safety Act on Tuesday, questioning whether it properly assessed risks posed by its Instagram Instants feature before launching it in May.
Instants allows content shared by users on Instagram to disappear after being viewed.
Ofcom said its investigation would establish whether Meta carried out a "suitable and sufficient" assessment of the risks of illegal content on the feature and any risks posed to children before its launch.
George Lusty, director of enforcement at Ofcom, said: "Our online safety laws are clear — significant changes to platforms must be risk assessed before they're launched."

Safety by design had to be built in and not bolted on, he said. "Today's investigation shows we'll take action where we have concerns that providers are failing to comply," he said.
Meta said it took its regulatory obligations under the Online Safety Act seriously.
"We conducted a risk analysis and briefed Ofcom about this feature on a number of occasions before launching it," a spokesperson said.
"Instants has in-built protections, including blocking screenshots, reshares and forwarding, no public feed, and Teen Account protections on automatically."
"We will of course co-operate with Ofcom during this investigation," the spokesperson said.
Ofcom's first investigation under the Online Safety Act was into an online suicide discussion forum last year, followed by probes into pornography sites, file-sharing services used to distribute child sexual abuse material, and platforms such as 4chan.
Britain's online safety regime sets obligations for social media platforms, search engines and adult content providers to tackle illegal content and to protect children's safety.
Ofcom requires companies to conduct risk assessments and implement safety measures, such as age verification.
If a company fails to comply, Ofcom can impose fines of up to £18 million or 10 per cent of qualifying worldwide revenue, whichever is greater.
Meta has launched legal challenges against Ofcom over its implementation of the act, including the scale and scope of information it has to provide to the regulator and the level of fees Ofcom charges.
In January, Ofcom launched an investigation into Meta over the provision of information about its WhatsApp Business product under a separate Communications Act.

items.body:
Former German Intelligence Chief August Hanning arrested on alleged treason and espionage charges In an official statement, the Federal Prosecutor’s Office announced that the two German nationals were taken into custody on Tuesday, in Bad Tölz-Wolfratshausen County, Bavaria, and Steinfurt County, North Rhine-Westphalia, pursuant to warrants issued by the Investigating Judge at the Federal Court of Justice. Law enforcement officers simultaneously searched properties in both locations as well as in Berlin.
ANI | Updated: 06-10-2026 20:29 IST | Created: 06-10-2026 20:29 IST

Former General Federal Intelligence Service (BND) President August Hanning (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Germany's Federal Criminal Police Office agents have arrested former Federal Intelligence Service (BND) President August Hanning and his former chief of staff, Manfred D, on serious charges including treasonous espionage, spying on state secrets, attempted treason, and espionage, Euro News reported. In an official statement, the Federal Prosecutor’s Office announced that the two German nationals were taken into custody on Tuesday, in Bad Tölz-Wolfratshausen County, Bavaria, and Steinfurt County, North Rhine-Westphalia, pursuant to warrants issued by the Investigating Judge at the Federal Court of Justice. Law enforcement officers simultaneously searched properties in both locations as well as in Berlin.
Hanning, who served as President of the BND from December 1998 to November 2005 and later as State Secretary at the Federal Ministry of the Interior between December 2005 and November 2009, is "strongly suspected of treasonous espionage, spying out state secrets, attempted treason, and espionage." Manfred D, who served as Hanning's chief of staff at the BND and parliamentary assistant at the Interior Ministry before resuming duties as chief of staff for several subsequent BND presidents from March 2012 to March 2026, is charged with "aiding and abetting attempted treason and treasonous espionage."
According to federal prosecutors, the two suspects agreed in the spring of 2010 that Manfred D would systematically leak confidential intelligence files to Hanning in exchange for payment. Over the years, Manfred D allegedly provided Hanning with approximately 2,000 documents, many containing restricted intelligence intended strictly for internal agency use and executive briefings involving senior officials from federal ministries and German security agencies at the Federal Chancellery. Investigators revealed that Hanning utilised the classified material to enhance his private consultancy services. Prosecutors stated that on one occasion, Hanning "used classified intelligence provided by Manfred D. to draft an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service," though it remains undetermined if the report reached its destination. Furthermore, Hanning was "in close contact with a representative of another foreign intelligence service, to whom he passed on political information, partially based on material provided by Manfred D., for several years."
The wide-ranging probe originated after a search of Hanning's property by Hamburg prosecutors in September 2025 during an investigation involving German businesswoman Christina Block and alleged leaks from the Chancellery. Euronews, citing reports by the German newspaper Süddeutsche Zeitung, along with public broadcasters WDR and NDR, previously pointed to evidence uncovered during those proceedings regarding the unauthorised handling of sensitive state documents.
The Federal Prosecutor's Office officially took over the investigation in early May 2026, conducting the probe alongside the BND and the Federal Criminal Police Office. Both suspects were brought before the Investigating Judge at the Federal Court of Justice to review the charges and determine pre-trial detention. (ANI)

items.title: サイバー攻撃による情報流出続発、「大変深刻に受け止め」＝官房長官
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 木原稔官房長官は６日午後の会見で、企業や団体に対してサイバー攻撃が行われ情報が流出する事案が続発していることについて、「大変深刻に受け止めている」と述べた。

現在、政府として被害の全体像の把握に努めており、「流出した個人情報が悪用されると二次被害につながることから、パスワードの使い回しをやめ多要素認証を利用すること、また不審なメールに注意することなどを呼びかけている」とした。

また海外のサイバーセキュリティ関係機関・捜査当局との連携による情報収集も行っているとしたうえで、「サイバー攻撃の被害を受けた場合、早期に所管省庁や警察等の関係機関への通報、相談をお願いしたい」と呼びかけた。

items.title: 中国ディープシーク、少なくとも120億ドル調達へ＝通信社
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[６日 ロイター] - 中国の新興人工知能（ＡＩ）企業ディープシークは、最新の資金調達ラウンドで少なくとも８００億元（１１９億３０００万ドル）を確保する見通しとなった。ブルームバーグ・ニュースが６日、関係者の話として報じた。

報道によると、中国の電池大手、寧徳時代新能源科技（ＣＡＴＬ）と騰訊控股（テンセント）が最大規模の出資を約束している。

ディープシークは当初、約５００億元の調達を目指していたが、最新ＡＩモデルの投入が成功し、投資家の需要が予想を上回ったという。最終的な調達額は１０００億元に迫る可能性があるとした。

ディープシークは９月、最新モデル「Ｖ４．１－Ｆｌａｓｈ」を公開した。機能の向上、推論の高速化、処理能力の拡大、より大規模なモデルへの拡張を目指して設計したと説明した。

ロイターは先月、ディープシークが上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）準備に向けて中信証券を起用したと報じた。ただ、上場時期や企業評価額、調達規模は未定とされている。

items.title: 南アジア経済堅調、今年度の印成長率見通し7.1％に上げ＝世銀
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Shubham Batra

[ニューデリー ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Shubham Batra

[ニューデリー ６日 ロイター] - 世界銀行は、エネルギーショックにもかかわらず消費者需要が堅調であることを理由に南アジアの成長見通しを引き上げた。ただ、原油価格の高止まり、深刻な気象ショック、世界的な市場の調整が地域の見通しを脅かす可能性があると警告した。

同地域の２０２６年の成長率を６．９％と予測。これは前回予測より６０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）高く、１年前の予測を１０ｂｐ上回っている。

世銀のアジア担当チーフエコノミスト、フランツィスカ・オーンソルゲ氏は５日、ロイターとのインタビューで「消費者を保護するための政府の措置、堅調な送金、そして底堅い内需が、その（エネルギー価格上昇の）影響を和らげる一助となったためだ」と述べた。

地域最大の経済大国であるインドの２６／２７年度の成長率は７．１％と予測。６月時点の６．６％から上方修正されたものの、前年度に記録された８．６％よりは大幅に低い水準となる。

オーンソルゲ氏は「インフレ率は２７年にかけて高止まりが続くと予想される」と述べ、インフレ率の上昇が成長に影響を及ぼすまでには時間がかかる可能性があると付け加えた。「新興国市場において、こうしたショックと経済活動への影響との間に生じる通常のタイムラグは約１８カ月だ」と語った。

強いエルニーニョ現象が、特に農業が農村部の需要とインフレの鍵を握るインドにとって、さらなるリスクとなり得るとも指摘した。

世銀はまた、中期的な成長の勢いを維持するため、各国に対しＡＩ（人工知能）の導入を強く促した。

報告書は「より多く、より質の高い雇用を創出するための有望な手段の一つは、ＡＩの広範な導入だ。南アジアにおけるＡＩの導入は、先進国に比べて依然として大きく遅れているが、急速に追い上げている」と述べている。

同地域の経済成長の大部分を占めるインドでは、企業の約２３％がＡＩを利用していると報告しているのに対し、米国では４３％の企業がＡＩを利用していると報告している。

items.title: フィジカルＡＩは「勝ち筋、うまくやれば独壇場に」＝赤沢経産相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ６日 ロイター] - 赤沢亮正経済産業相は６日、都内で講演し、フィジカルＡＩ（人工知能）は「間違いなくわが国の勝ち筋であり、うまくやれば独壇場になる。ＡＩロボットとフィジカルＡＩの開発にかなり賭けている」と強調した。
items.body:
[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 赤沢亮正経済産業相は６日、都内で講演し、フィジカルＡＩ（人工知能）は「間違いなくわが国の勝ち筋であり、うまくやれば独壇場になる。ＡＩロボットとフィジカルＡＩの開発にかなり賭けている」と強調した。 ＡＩ自体の開発では米国や中国に「今のところ歯が立たない」ものの、日本には「世界有数の製造現場と世界で唯一の（原発の）廃炉の現場がある」と述べ、こうした知見を活用することが日本の強みになるとの見方を示した。

赤沢氏は、中国がレアアースの「チョークポイント（急所）」を握って経済的威圧を行っている一方、「ＡＩや半導体を製造するにあたっての素材や製造装置は、日本がかなりチョーキングポイントを握っている」と指摘。「しっかり維持して日本の強みとして生かしていくのは当然だ」と語った。ＡＩ時代には「スタートアップの成功確率が劇的に高まる可能性がある」とも話し、「わが国のスタートアップ振興のための政策をもう一回、ゼロから抜本的に強力に見直したい」とした。

＜サハリン２の権益維持、かなり優先順位高い＞

経産省は同日、ウクライナ侵攻を続けるロシアに対する追加制裁として、ロシアの産業基盤強化に資する物品の輸出禁止措置を追加実施すると発表した。 赤沢氏は、ロシアの「侵略」は非難されるべきもので「われわれはウクライナサイドに立っている」とした上で、ロシア・サハリン州の石油・天然ガス開発事業「サハリン２」 については「日本の権益をきちっと維持することはかなり優先順位の高い課題」で、「そのことについて今ロシアとの間で何か問題を抱えているわけではない」と説明。同盟国も含めた了解を得た上で輸入されているとも述べた。

その上で、仮に日本が権益を手放せば「どこの国とは言わないが、他の国が入ってきて、われわれが開発に膨大な税金を費やしたものをただ持っていかれる。それが国益にかなうのかということも含めてやってきている」と語った。

＜ＡＩの開発速度巡る問題、米中の動向が鍵に＞

人工知能（ＡＩ）の開発速度を抑制すべきだとの主張については、危惧は理解するとした一方で「中国と米国両方が同意しない限りはあまり実効性がない」と指摘。一方が応じなければ「開発を続けた方が早く新しいものを開発することは目に見えている」と述べ、米中がルール作りに合意し、順守しなければ速度抑制の実現は難しいだろうと述べた。

items.title: Police fire teargas as French school protests cause 'heaviest toll in decades'
items.author: Tilman Blasshofer, Cecile Mantovani, Lucien Libert
items.creator: Tilman Blasshofer, Cecile Mantovani, Lucien Libert
items.summary: Police fired tear gas at protesters outside French high schools on Tuesday as students, teachers and parents took to the streets on the biggest day of what Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu described as the most violent school protests in decades.
items.body:
Police fired tear gas at protesters outside French high schools on Tuesday as students, teachers and parents took to the streets on the biggest day of what Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu described as the most violent school protests in decades.
The protests, in which a teenager lost a hand on Monday, were the latest manifestation of public anger in a country where the far right and far left are surging ahead of a presidential election in the spring.
The government is under pressure to tame public debt amid weak growth, and has struggled with basic tasks such as passing a budget since President Emmanuel Macron's allies lost their majority in a 2024 parliamentary vote.
Lecornu told lawmakers at least 215 teenagers and 85 school staff had so far been injured in clashes, "the heaviest toll in decades paid by the school system". His office said more than 700 police officers were also hurt.
Macron has convened Lecornu and other senior ministers at an emergency meeting on Tuesday, broadcaster BFM reported.
In Marseille and Nantes, protesters held up signs reading "The state has killed national education". In Toulouse, parents linked arms at the front of a march through the city.
In Strasbourg, Lyon, Rennes and Paris, the demonstrations at times turned violent, with police firing tear gas and protesters lighting fires in the streets and hurling projectiles.
The Paris police said the clashes there had come about when some 300 people attempted to face off against security forces, adding that the protest was generally unfolding well elsewhere.
By late afternoon they said they were still clashing with a small contingent of people. Three storefronts had been damaged.
The protests began in September in the deprived suburbs of Paris, before spreading nationwide.
"There is such a gap between the elites and us," said Hugo Vetzel, a recent high-school graduate in Strasbourg.
The High School Students Union said more than half of France's high schools were blockaded or would close for the day. Some local education authorities have tried to move classes online.
Students complain about schools facing basic maintenance problems, from water leaks to rat infestations.
THOUSANDS OF ARRESTS Rights groups, students and parent groups have accused authorities of using disproportionate force against minors. The government says the protest movement has been hijacked by outsiders and in some places deteriorated into urban violence.
France's interior ministry said 6,100 people have been arrested since the protests began, the overwhelming majority of them minors. More than 1,800 people are being prosecuted for unspecified crimes, including 1,483 minors, the justice ministry said.
A teenager's hand was blown off as high-school protesters clashed with riot police in northern France on Monday. The regional newspaper La Voix du Nord said the 15-year-old lost his hand and part of his lower arm after picking up a police grenade intended to be non-lethal.
"They want to divide the young people into good and bad protesters," said Omar Slaouti, a high-school teacher in Argenteuil, a northwestern suburb of Paris. "If there were no trash cans on fire, the government would not have stepped back and become aware of the issues at stake."
Six months before an election to replace Macron, his government and far-right leader Marine Le Pen's National Rally party have accused hard-left France Unbowed (LFI) lawmakers and mayors of stoking the unrest. LFI denies the accusation.
"All the young people are in the streets. Everywhere there aren't police, everything is going smoothly," said Jean-Luc Melenchon, LFI's presidential candidate.
PRIME MINISTER PROMISES A RESPONSE Lecornu has ordered his ministers to tackle the students' leading demands. Those include ensuring absent teachers are replaced, reviewing the length of the 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. school day and the need for longer lunch breaks.
The government will also look at repairs needed to ageing school buildings, said Lecornu, who demanded ministers send in their first proposals by the end of October.
Parent Emilie Lhomme said at a protest outside the Helene Boucher school in Paris that the government's words were not enough: "That's all fine and dandy, but that's not what's going to change the daily lives of our children," she said.
Finding spare cash to implement educational reforms will be difficult.
The government is under pressure to try to narrow a ballooning budget deficit as investor concerns about France's growing debt, weak growth and reluctance to rein in spending push the cost of borrowing higher. The yield on [USN:L8N45O0YO TEXT:"France's 10-year bonds"] briefly hit a 24-year high of over 5% last week.
The surge in French borrowing costs has started to spill into the broader euro area, with the [USN:L6N45S0D2 TEXT:"sliding euro currency"] the latest alarm bell for policy makers. Finance Minister Roland Lescure said on Tuesday there was no need for the [USN:S8N3XB0C2 TEXT:"European Central Bank"] to step in.
Le Pen, the far-right euro-sceptic populist leading the presidential race ahead of next spring's election, set out [USN:L1N45S0C4 TEXT:"plans to slash public spending if elected"], seeking to establish her fiscal credibility as the bond market crisis deepens.
French spending on education has lagged inflation and the country's students are trailing their OECD peers in overall performance, data from the[USN:L8N44Z0XI TEXT:" PISA 2025 assessment"] shows.

items.title: European shares gain as Genmab jumps, bond yields retreat
items.author: Sudeshna Ghoshal
items.creator: Sudeshna Ghoshal
items.summary: European shares rose towards one-week highs on Tuesday, buoyed by gains in healthcare stocks after Genmab's upbeat drug-trial results, while euro zone bond yields took a breather after rallying on fiscal and inflation concerns.
items.body:
European shares rose towards one-week highs on Tuesday, buoyed by gains in healthcare stocks after Genmab's upbeat drug-trial results, while euro zone bond yields took a breather after rallying on fiscal and inflation concerns.
The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) index was up 0.8% to 638.67 points by 0835 GMT, poised for a third straight session of gains.
[USN:L4N45R1GW TEXT:"Genmab"] (GMAB.CO) climbed 7.7% to a three-year high after the Danish biotech firm and US drugmaker AbbVie (ABBV.N) 's combination treatment for patients newly diagnosed with a type of lymphoma reduced the risk of disease progression or death in a late-stage study.
The broader healthcare index (.SXDP) was up 1.4%, leading sectoral gains in Europe.
Attention now turns to euro zone retail sales data due later, which could offer clues about the region's consumer spending.
Data also showed [USN:ZRN00EN1V TEXT:"UK construction activity fell"] in September, but the decline was the smallest since January.
The euro hovered near a 17-month low, weighed down by worries over France's high debt burden and a political gridlock. Political uncertainty in the region deepened after Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"called"] a snap election on Monday.
"A new 2027 budget now looks unlikely, meaning Spain may again roll over its previous budget, keeping fiscal policy broadly steady and debt-to-GDP on a declining path," Danske Bank analysts said in a note.
"We do not expect a near-term impact on growth or public finances, supported by strong employment and consumption, though tighter immigration policy could weigh on medium-term potential growth."
Euro zone bond yields [USN:L6N45S0EJ TEXT:"eased"], having touched multi-decade highs last week. The spread between French and German 10-year yields narrowed further from its peak of last Friday as investors assessed whether the recent surge in France's risk premium had gone too far, too quickly.
Persistently high rates raise borrowing costs for companies and mortgage holders, while increasing governments' interest burdens.
MARKETS SCALE BACK ECB TIGHTENING BETS The recent turmoil in bond markets have prompted investors to dial back their expectations for interest rate hikes from the European Central Bank.
Markets are now pricing in an 80% chance of another rate hike by the end of the year. They had been pricing in at least three more hikes by the March meeting but now are just fully pricing in one hike and around an 80% chance of a second.
Among other stocks, Italy's Technoprobe (TPRO.MI) gained 4.5% after J.P.Morgan initiated coverage on the stock with an "overweight" rating.
Spain's property developer Neinor Homes (HOME.MC) advanced 4.2% after raising its 2026-2027 outlook, unveiling 2028 targets and announcing a planned €200- €250 million ($225-$281 million) dividend for 2028.

FAST

HANOI, Oct 6 : Vietnam's Vingroup and France's Alstom have agreed to a deal for 200 metro trainsets and an associated technology transfer to support Hanoi's urban rail expansion, the companies said in a statement on Tuesday. 
• Under the agreement, the first 83 five-car, fully automated driverless trainsets will be designed and built at Alstom's facility in France.
• Vingroup will manufacture and assemble the remaining 117 trainsets in Vietnam, with Alstom providing engineering expertise, tooling support and key components.
• The statement did not give a time frame for the deliveries.
• Urban rail is one of the fastest-growing segments of Vietnam's railway market, with a dozen lines planned in the country's main cities of Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City.
• Hanoi's urban rail network is planned to cover 979 km across 18 lines by 2045.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 利上げの時期やペース、中心見通しの実現確度やリスク点検し検討＝植田日銀総裁
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Takahiko Wada

[東京 ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Takahiko Wada

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、全国証券大会であいさつし、基調的な物価上昇率が２％に近づいている中、金融環境が緩和的なことを踏まえれば「経済・物価・金融情勢に応じて、引き続き政策金利を引き上げ、金融緩和度合いを調整していくことになる」と述べた。その上で、政策調整のタイミングやペースは、経済・物価の中心的な見通しが実現する確度やリスクを点検しながら検討していくとした。

基調物価が２％を超えて上振れていくリスクが顕在化し、その後の経済に悪影響を及ぼすことがないよう「基調的な物価上昇率を２％程度の水準で安定させていくという観点が、これまでよりも重要になってきている」と述べた。

経済・物価は、展望リポートで示してきた「中心的な見通しにおおむね沿って推移している」とし、景気は「中東情勢の影響もあって一部に弱めの動きもみられるが、緩やかに回復している」と述べた。１日発表の９月短観について、企業の業況感は「良好な水準」だと評価した。一方、中長期の予想物価上昇率は引き続き上昇しており、「消費者物価の基調的な上昇率は２％に近づいている」と話した。

中心的見通しを巡るリスク要因としては、中東情勢や人工知能（ＡＩ）関連需要の拡大、為替変動を挙げた。

植田総裁は９月の利上げ後も「緩和的な金融環境は維持されるため、引き続き経済活動をしっかりとサポートしていく」とも述べた。

[ベルリン　６日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦統計庁が６日発表した８月の鉱工業受注は、季節・営業日調整済みで前月比１０．６％減少し、ロイターがまとめたアナリスト予想（１．０％減）よりもマイナス幅が大きくなった。航空機、船舶、鉄道車両、軍用車両への大規模な受注が減少した。

「その他の輸送用機器」が６１．５％減少。７月に同分野の受注は２倍以上に増加していた。

大型案件を除くと、８月の新規受注は０．１％減だった。

変動が平準化される３カ月間の比較では、６─８月の新規受注は、直前の３カ月間と比べて１．３％増加した。

７月の新規受注（改定値）は前月比３．２％増加。速報値（２．５％増）から上方改定された。

８月の海外受注は５．４％減。ユーロ圏からの受注は５．４％減、ユーロ圏以外からの受注は５．５％減となった。

国内受注は１７．３％減少した。

＜第３・四半期の成長に重しか＞

ドイツ商工会議所の経済専門家のユップ・ツェンツェ氏は「変動の激しい大口受注を除くと、製造業の受注は数カ月にわたって横ばいが続いている」と指摘。「景気回復に広がりは見られない」と述べた。

コメルツ銀行のシニアエコノミスト、ラルフ・ゾルフェーン氏は、これまでに公表された統計を見る限り、上半期とは対照的に、第３・四半期は鉱工業部門が独経済の成長を鈍らせた可能性が高いと述べた。

ただ、同氏は第４・四半期にはこの傾向が反転すると予想している。政府の発注が増える見込みで、長期的に売上高や生産にプラスの影響を及ぼすとみている。「ここ数カ月で企業景況感が大幅に改善していることも、この見通しを裏付けている」と述べた。

ドイツ銀行のエコノミスト、マルク・シャッテンベルク氏によると、７月の最新データでは、受注残は過去最高の９カ月分に達した。「８月の数字は期待外れの弱さだったが、既に受注残が非常に高水準にあることを踏まえて見るべきだ」と述べた。

FAST

TOKYO, Oct 6 : Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Tuesday it was becoming more important to anchor underlying inflation around the central bank's 2 per cent target, signalling readiness to keep raising interest rates to blunt the risk of too-high inflation.
The remarks come ahead of the central bank's two-day policy meeting ending on October 30, where new quarterly growth and inflation forecasts will be closely watched for clues on the timing of the next rate hike.
Ueda said economic and price developments were broadly in line with the BOJ's forecasts, with the economy recovering moderately and the central bank's "tankan" survey pointing to solid business sentiment.
Rising raw material costs are pushing up wholesale inflation with price pressures spreading to consumer inflation, Ueda said, adding that long-term inflation expectations continue to rise.

He also warned of the risk of underlying inflation overshooting the BOJ's target due to price pressures from the US-Israeli war on Iran, strong AI-related demand and the weak yen.
"Financial conditions remain accommodative and continue to underpin economic activity" even after last month's rate hike, Ueda said, adding that the central bank will continue to raise borrowing costs to adjust the level of monetary support.
"It has become more important than before to ensure underlying inflation becomes anchored around 2 per cent" so that the risk of an inflation overshoot does not materialise and damage the economy, he added.
In a statement announcing the September rate hike, the BOJ said only that it was "important" to anchor underlying inflation around the BOJ's target.
The BOJ raised its key rate to a 31-year high last month, with Ueda signalling the central bank had entered a phase focused on preventing underlying inflation from overshooting its target, raising the prospect of tighter policy.

items.title: China’s alleged expanding espionage network raises global security concerns
items.summary: The concerns follow an unprecedented alert issued by Britain’s domestic intelligence agency MI5 on September 30 regarding academic research allegedly linked to China’s Ministry of State Security (MSS) ...
items.body:
China’s alleged expanding espionage network raises global security concerns The concerns follow an unprecedented alert issued by Britain’s domestic intelligence agency MI5 on September 30 regarding academic research allegedly linked to China’s Ministry of State Security (MSS), according to The Epoch Times.
ANI | Updated: 06-10-2026 19:35 IST | Created: 06-10-2026 19:35 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

China’s expanding espionage and technology-gathering activities are raising concerns over national security, critical infrastructure and democratic societies, with analysts warning that stolen data and advanced technologies could be used for surveillance, cyber operations and political interference, The Epoch Times reported. The concerns follow an unprecedented alert issued by Britain’s domestic intelligence agency MI5 on September 30 regarding academic research allegedly linked to China’s Ministry of State Security (MSS), according to The Epoch Times.
The Epoch Times reported that more than 100 UK-linked academics had contributed to projects connected with China’s civilian intelligence agency. The newspaper said funding for some of the research was channelled through the China General Technology Research Institute (CGTRI) into areas including artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and other advanced technologies. According to The Epoch Times, MI5 said CGTRI’s primary purpose was to support academic research that could improve the technical capabilities of the MSS for espionage. British authorities have also warned that institutions or individuals continuing to participate in such projects could face legal consequences under the UK’s National Security Act, passed in 2023 to strengthen measures against foreign espionage and hostile state activity.
The Epoch Times also reported on a separate case in Germany, where police arrested a married couple in Munich in May over allegations of spying for China by establishing contacts with academics working in aerospace engineering, computer science and artificial intelligence. Lin Tzuli, director of the Center for China and Regional Development at Taiwan’s Tunghai University, told The Epoch Times that China’s alleged espionage, technology theft and cyber activities could create risks extending beyond individual countries.
Lin said compromised data could facilitate more sophisticated cross-border surveillance, allowing Chinese intelligence agencies to monitor the communications and movements of targeted individuals. He further warned that intelligence obtained through such activities could provide covert access points into critical infrastructure, potentially creating vulnerabilities that could be exploited during a crisis.
According to The Epoch Times, Lin also said Beijing could combine intelligence gathered through data collection with generative AI to make political influence operations more targeted. He suggested that harvested information could be used to identify social divisions before synthetic audio, video and coordinated online messaging are deployed to influence different groups. The developments have intensified debate in Western countries over the security implications of international academic collaboration, research funding and access to emerging technologies. (ANI)

items.title: 日経平均は続伸、原油安など支え　業績期待の買いも
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は続伸し、前営業日比１．０５％（７３７円１２銭）高の７万０６８３円９８銭で取引を終えた。前日上昇した反動でマイナスに沈む場面もあったが、原油安などを背景にしっかりの展開が続いた。企業決算シーズンを前に業績期待も意識され、一部の半導体関連株や電子部品関連株が買われた。

日経平均は前営業日比０．０１％高でスタートした後、一時小幅安に転じたが、その後はすぐに切り返しプラス圏で推移した。寄与度の高い一部の半導体関連や電子部品関連、主力株の一角が堅調で相場を押し上げた。個別材料を手掛かりにした物色も活発だった。

後場に入ると日経平均は一段高となり、終盤に一時１．２２％（８５１円）高の７万０７９８円６２銭まで上昇。プライム市場では８割近くの銘柄が上昇するなど、相場全体が底堅い地合いとなった。ＴＯＰＩＸもしっかりだった。

マネックス証券のチーフ・マーケット・アナリスト、吉野貴晶氏は「米雇用統計が弱い結果となり、米国の早期利上げ観測が後退したという材料でここまで株価が上昇するのは意外感もある」と指摘。「相場の底堅さは維持されているものの、さらに上方向を試すためには別の材料が必要になる」とみている。

ＴＯＰＩＸは０．９２％高の４１８３．５６ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比０．９２％高の２１５７．０９ポイント。プライム市場の売買代金は７兆３０４８億２７００万円だった。東証３３業種では、非鉄金属、精密機器、銀行など３０業種が値上がり。情報・通信、建設、空運は値下がりした。

新興株式市場では、東証グロース市場２５０指数が続伸し、１．４１％高の８２３．７１ポイントだった。

個別では、アドバンテストは連日の上場来高値。ＴＤＫ、太陽誘電、フジクラは大幅高だった。企業などへの不正アクセスが頻発する中、セグエグループ、ソリトンシステムズなどサイバーセキュリティ関連も上昇。キオクシアホールディングス、ソフトバンクグループは軟調だった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが１１５３銘柄（７４％）、値下がりは３４９銘柄（２２％）、変わらずは５０銘柄（３％）だった。

ＴＯＰＩＸは０．９２％高の４１８３．５６ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比０．９２％高の２１５７．０９ポイント。プライム市場の売買代金は７兆３０４８億２７００万円だった。東証３３業種では、非鉄金属、精密機器、銀行など３０業種が値上がり。情報・通信、建設、空運は値下がりした。

新興株式市場では、東証グロース市場２５０指数が続伸し、１．４１％高の８２３．７１ポイントだった。

個別では、アドバンテストは連日の上場来高値。ＴＤＫ、太陽誘電、フジクラは大幅高だった。企業などへの不正アクセスが頻発する中、セグエグループ、ソリトンシステムズなどサイバーセキュリティ関連も上昇。キオクシアホールディングス、ソフトバンクグループは軟調だった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが１１５３銘柄（７４％）、値下がりは３４９銘柄（２２％）、変わらずは５０銘柄（３％）だった。

items.title: Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece, Cyprus keen to join IMEC; ministerial meet likely later this year: France
items.summary: Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece and Cyprus have expressed interest in joining the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), French President’s Special Envoy for IMEC Gérard Mestrallet said on ...
items.body:
Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece, Cyprus keen to join IMEC; ministerial meet likely later this year: France  Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece and Cyprus have expressed interest in joining the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), French President’s Special Envoy for IMEC Gérard Mestrallet said on Tuesday, adding that an IMEC ministerial meeting is expected to be held later this year to consider expanding the corridor’s membership.
ANI | Updated: 06-10-2026 19:27 IST | Created: 06-10-2026 19:27 IST

French President’s Special Envoy for IMEC Gérard Mestrallet (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

By Vishu Adhana Egypt, Lebanon, Oman, Greece and Cyprus have expressed interest in joining the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), French President’s Special Envoy for IMEC Gérard Mestrallet said on Tuesday, adding that an IMEC ministerial meeting is expected to be held later this year to consider expanding the corridor’s membership.
Mestrallet, who is visiting India from October 5-7 to advance the IMEC project and France-India cooperation on connectivity, said any decision to expand the corridor would have to be taken by its eight existing signatory governments. “We have eight signatories and they are heads of state. Potential extension will only be decided by the eight governments. We hope that in the ministerial meeting we could decide to extend the perimeter of IMEC,” Mestrallet said at a press conference in New Delhi.
He specifically named Egypt, Lebanon and Oman among countries interested in working with or joining the corridor, while identifying Greece and Cyprus as two European countries that would be particularly keen to become full members. Mestrallet also clarified that Jordan and Israel, although not among the eight original signatories, were mentioned in the initial agreement.
“They have not signed because they were not present. It’s Jordan and Israel, although they were mentioned,” he said. The IMEC was announced in September 2023 by India, the United States, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, France, Germany, Italy and the European Union. The ambitious connectivity initiative envisages linking India with Europe through the Arabian Peninsula using a combination of shipping, rail and other connectivity infrastructure.
Mestrallet said that since the creation of IMEC, the participating countries have so far held meetings at the steering committee level, but there has not yet been a ministerial-level meeting. “We hope that by the end of this year there will be a ministerial meeting because in the meantime, since the creation of IMEC, there was only a steering committee, not a ministerial committee,” he said.
He stressed that only a ministerial meeting involving the existing governments could decide whether the corridor’s geographical and membership perimeter should be expanded. At the same time, Mestrallet said IMEC would have to work with countries and ports outside the original group irrespective of whether they eventually become full members.
“In any case, members or not members, we will have to work with them because they want to work positively, and so we have to work with them to find the best possible method — being a full member or associated member or something else,” he said. The remarks come amid renewed efforts by the participating countries to move ahead with the corridor, which seeks to establish a multimodal connectivity route linking India to the Middle East and Europe, including through ports, rail networks and associated clean-energy and digital infrastructure.
Mestrallet is also scheduled to participate in discussions on green shipping corridors and IMEC ports during his India visit. On Tuesday, he spoke at the IMEC Ports Club Working Day in New Delhi alongside Christophe Castaner, Chairman of the Supervisory Board of the Port of Marseille Fos. (ANI)

items.title: Drone sinks ship off Bulgaria, as fears grow about hybrid attacks by Russia
items.author: Alex Lefkowitz
items.creator: Alex Lefkowitz
items.summary: The crew of a merchant ship was missing on Tuesday after the vessel sank in the Black Sea off NATO member Bulgaria following a drone strike that Prime Minister Rumen Radev described as a gross violation of international law.
items.body:
The crew of a merchant ship was missing on Tuesday after the vessel sank in the Black Sea off NATO member Bulgaria following a drone strike that Prime Minister Rumen Radev described as a gross violation of international law.
It was not immediately clear who carried out the attack by air and sea drones about 70 miles (112 km) off the coastal town of Byala in eastern Bulgaria, but there are growing concerns about [USN:L8N45R0NV TEXT:"hybrid attacks"] by Russia as it wages war in Ukraine .
Shipping sources said it appeared to be the first such attack in the waters of Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone.
Bulgaria's Prime Minister Rumen Radev said it was unclear whether the drones came from Russia or from Ukraine, the BTA news agency reported. Bulgaria does not border either country but it holds a strategic position in the Black Sea, where both Ukraine and Russia have major ports.
Two ships were hit in the attack, Radev said in a televised statement. The crew of one, which was carrying grain, was rescued, with two injured. The other, which sank, was a Togo-flagged ship whose cargo was not disclosed. It is unclear how many people were on board.
The incident occurred some 140 nautical miles away from the Ukrainian coast.
A search has been launched for the missing crew and for any signs of an environmental threat.
A maritime security source said initial assessments of the strike suggested it had probably been a Russian attack.
Radev did not say who was behind the attack but made a reference to Russia's war in Ukraine.
"If this war is not brought to an end in time, it will continue to expand its geographical scope and increase the risk of even a global conflict," he said.
"We are seeing the war intensify, with all the rules of international law now being violated, and civilian vessels being attacked at sea. This is absolutely unacceptable."
Russia did not immediately comment on the incident.
European Commission President [USN:B5N443025 TEXT:"Ursula von der"] Leyen said that attacks on civilian shipping are unacceptable.
"Commercial ships – and innocent crews – are being targeted, with lives already lost at sea," she said.
"Hungary stands in full solidarity with Bulgaria," Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on X.
DISTRESS SIGNALS REPORTED British maritime risk management group Vanguard said the attacks on Tuesday were on the Togo-flagged general cargo vessel ALFA WATAN and the Palau-flagged general cargo vessel ABLE, within Bulgaria’s economic zone.
The drone attack follows an incident in which Romanian authorities said on Monday [USN:L1N45R0CZ TEXT:"two people had died"] in a fire on a ship in the Black Sea outside Romania's territorial waters.
"The attacks represent a significant escalation in the threat to commercial shipping in the western Black Sea," maritime security firm MARISKS said in an advisory in which it advised captains and operators to watch out for drone activity in the area.
"Of particular concern is the apparent geographic expansion of incidents beyond waters immediately adjacent to Ukraine and into the EEZs of NATO members Romania and Bulgaria."
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy blamed Russian drones for the Romania incident. Russian authorities issued no immediate comment on it.
Since Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, European countries have reported Russian drones breaching their airspace multiple times and mines floating in the Black Sea across trade and energy routes.

items.title: アングル：米政府、借り入れコスト抑制へ選択肢狭まる　歳出削減以外ならインフレ加速も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Karen Brettell

[５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Karen Brettell

[５日 ロイター] - 米長期国債の利回りが約２０年ぶりの高水準に近づく中、米政府は借り入れコストの抑制策に手詰まり感を強めている。今後、より強い政策対応に踏み込む可能性があるが、そうした対応はインフレをあおり、債券保有者に損失をもたらす恐れもある。

長期国債利回りの上昇要因は、一時的なものとは言い難い。米政府は財政赤字を賄うために大量の国債を発行しているが、赤字は縮小していない。インフレ沈静化のペースも鈍い。さらに、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資ブームによって景気が堅調を維持しているため、住宅・自動車市場が弱含んでいるにもかかわらず、金利は低下していない。

その結果、政府債務は４０兆ドルを超え、年間の利払い費は約１兆ドル（約１５８兆１０００億円）に上る。

借り入れコストを抑えるには、短期借り入れへの依存を高めることから、最も踏み込んだケースでは米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が長期金利に上限を設けることまで、さまざまな手段がある。ただ、政策当局がこうした手段に深入りするほど、インフレをあおるリスクが高まり、債券保有者の受ける打撃が大きくなる恐れがある。

アポロ・グローバル・マネジメントのチーフエコノミスト、トルステン・スロック氏によると、政府税収５ドルに対して１ドルが国債の利払いに充てられている。同氏は「これは極めて高い水準で、今後も増加し続けるだろう」と述べた。

トランプ大統領は９月２８日、米誌タイムのインタビューで、債務は経済成長やインフレなどを通じて返済できると述べた。

しかし、それで問題が解決しなければ、米財務省には穏健なものから抜本的なものまで、ほかにも選択肢がある。同省はすでに短期国債への依存を強めており、国債市場の流動性を支えるために国債の小規模な買い入れ消却（バイバック）も実施している。

さらに状況が悪化した場合、次の段階ではＦＲＢの対応が必要になる。１つは、１９６１年の「オペレーション・ツイスト」に似た形で長期国債を大規模に買い入れること。もう１つは長期金利に明確な上限を設定することで、米国は第二次世界大戦以来こうした措置を採ったことがない。政策当局がこうした選択肢に踏み込んでいくほど、金利抑制の効果は高まるが、同時にインフレを悪化させるリスクも高まる。

ダブルライン・キャピタルのジェフリー・ガンドラック最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は最近のイベントで、「政府が目に見えて金利水準を懸念する段階に来た」と述べた。

＜オペレーション・ツイスト＞

過去に実施された政策を踏まえると、次の段階の政策対応はオペレーション・ツイストの本格的な復活になる公算が大きい。これは１９６１年に実施された政策で、短期債を売却する一方、長期債を購入することでイールドカーブ（利回り曲線）をフラット化することを狙った。

本格的なオペレーション・ツイストにはＦＲＢの協力が不可欠とみられる。ただ、明確な金融危機が発生しない限り、ＦＲＢは動かないかもしれない。スロック氏は、ＦＲＢのバランスシートを使わない限り、財務省は「金利を引き下げるための手段が限られる」と指摘する。

しかしＦＲＢのウォーシュ議長は、ＦＲＢが保有する米国債など証券の残高が膨らんでいることを批判してきた。大規模な国債買い入れは、金融政策と政府の債務管理との境界を曖昧にしかねないと主張。財務省とＦＲＢが新たな合意（アコード）を結び、ＦＲＢ議長と財務長官がＦＲＢのバランスシートと財務省の国債発行について、目標を公に説明する仕組みを提唱している。

＜イールドカーブ・コントロール＞

オペレーション・ツイスト型国債買い入れでも十分な効果が得られなければ、次の手段は明示的な「イールドカーブ・コントロール（ＹＣＣ）」となるだろう。ＹＣＣでは中銀が長期金利を一定の上限以下に抑えるため、国債を無制限に買い入れると約束する。ＦＲＢは第二次世界大戦の戦費調達と戦後復興を支えるため、１９４２年から５１年の財務省・ＦＲＢ合意まで米長期国債の利回りを２．５％に抑えていた。日銀は２０１６年から２４年にかけてＹＣＣを実施した。

ＹＣＣは金利を人為的に低く抑えることで、財政赤字拡大に伴う政治的な痛みを和らげる。しかし、この政策が機能するのは、投資家が政府から「インフレによって価値が目減りしたドル」での返済を懸念しないことが条件になる。この信認が崩れれば、金利を押し下げるために行う国債買い入れが、かえってインフレを加速させる可能性がある。

ジョージ・メイソン大学マーケタス・センターのシニア・リサーチフェロー、ベロニク・ド・ルジー氏は、債務問題を根本的に解決する唯一の方法は歳出削減だと指摘。「議会は財政調整を行う必要がある。つまり、緊縮財政だ。これはＦＲＢだけでは対応できない」と述べた。

＜２つの道筋＞

キャピタル・エコノミクスのチーフ経済顧問、ジョン・ヒギンズ氏によると、米国が第二次世界大戦後に政府債務残高の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比を大幅に引き下げたのは２回だけで、国債保有者が受けた影響はそれぞれ大きく異なった。

戦後には、政府債務のＧＤＰ比率が１９４６年の約１０６パーセントから７４年には２３％まで低下した一方、１０年国債利回りは２．２％から７．５％へ上昇した。これに対して、１９９０年代には債務のＧＤＰ比率が４８％から３２％へ低下し、国債利回りもこれに伴って低下した。

何が違いを生んだのか。戦後は、借入コストに上限が設けられ、比較的高いインフレ率によって、名目成長率が米国債利回りを上回った。その結果、大幅な財政規律を伴わなくても債務比率を低下させることができた。一方、１９９０年代には、金利が経済成長率をやや上回っていたため、歳出抑制と歳入増加が債務比率の低下をもたらした。

現在の選択肢も、この２つの道筋に沿う。金利低下を伴う緊縮財政か、人為的な金利抑制とインフレによって債務比率を改善させる道だ。後者では、債務比率が改善しても利回りは上昇し得る。

現在は１９９０年代と比べて、予算に占める義務的経費の割合が大きい。また、議会は増税や歳出削減を望んでいない。このためヒギンズ氏は、リスクは「債券保有者に打撃を与えるインフレ経路に傾いている」とみている。

items.title: フジＨＤ不動産事業売却、ブラックストーンやベインなど最終入札へ＝関係者
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kane Wu　Makiko Yamazaki

［東京　６日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Kane Wu　Makiko Yamazaki

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - フジ・メディア・ホールディングス（フジＨＤ）が進める中核不動産子会社サンケイビルの売却を巡り、米国のブラックストーン、ベイン・キャピタル、ウォーバーグ・ピンカスなどが最終入札の準備を進めていることが分かった。事情に詳しい複数の関係者がロイターに明らかにした。負債を含めた取引額は１兆円規模に達する可能性があり、実現すれば不動産業界における国内最大級の買収案件となる。

３社のほか、カナダの保険大手サンライフ傘下の不動産投資ファンドであるＢＧＯが準備を進めている。１０月末までに拘束力のある最終提案を提出する方向という。関係者らは、情報が非公開であることを理由に匿名を条件に語った。

フジＨＤは提案内容を精査し、優先交渉先を選定。提案内容について株主の承認を求める見通しだという。

フジＨＤはロイターに対し、外部資本導入の方法などに関する詳細は「企業価値および株主共同の利益の最大化の観点から検討中」とし、「公表する必要のある事項が決定され次第、適時適切に開示する」と回答した。ブラックストーンとウォーバーグ・ピンカス、ベイン・キャピタルはコメントを控えた。ＢＧＯからは現時点で回答を得られていない。

一方、フジＨＤの一部株主からは取引プロセスの透明性向上を求める声も上がっている。

ロイターが確認した９月３０日付の書簡によると、シンガポールの投資ファンド、ヴァサンタ・マスターファンドは、清水賢治社長宛てに、サンケイビル資産の評価額や取引スキーム、一部売却やスピンオフ、資産ごとの段階的売却といった代替案の検討や、売却資金の使途などについて、より詳細な情報開示を求めた。

同ファンドはまた、不動産ポートフォリオの規模が大きく資産内容も多岐にわたるため、買収候補者が一部の大手プライベートエクイティ（ＰＥ）ファンドに限定される恐れがあると指摘。フジＨＤの既存株主へ還元される価値が十分確保されない可能性があると主張した。ヴァサンタの保有比率は１％未満。

＜日本の不動産、世界から注目＞

世界の投資家の間で日本の不動産市場への関心は高まっている。物件調査会社などによると、オフィス需要の底堅さや訪日観光客の増加、海外資本への開放性、円安などを背景に、日本は世界で最も注目される不動産投資市場の一つとなっている。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、日本の不動産資産を対象としたＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収） 取引額は１０月５日時点で１５５億ドル（約２兆４５００億円）となり、前年同期比４５％増加。２０１３年以来の高水準となっている。

フジＨＤは、米アクティビストファンドのダルトン・インベストメンツや、旧村上ファンド系の投資家らから、不動産資産の売却や政策保有株の解消を通じた資本効率改善を要求されていた。

また、著名タレントを巡る不祥事をきっかけに広告主の離反が相次ぎ、複数の経営幹部が退任。取締役会の刷新も迫られるなど、経営陣への圧力は一段と強まった。

フジＨＤは今年２月、発行済み株式のおよそ３０％に当たる約２３５０億円規模の自社株買いを実施。アクティビスト投資家などから株式を取得した。併せて、サンケイビルを含む不動産事業の見直しに着手すると発表。不動産事業への外部資本導入や売却を通じて、メディア・コンテンツ事業への投資を拡大し、資本効率の向上を目指している。

items.body:
Pakistan’s power crisis deepens as electricity shortfall crosses 4,000 MW According to ARY News, sources stated that the worsening shortfall has forced power distribution companies (DISCOs) to increase load-shedding across the country. Consumers in both urban and rural areas are reportedly facing three to four hours of power cuts, with the duration of outages increasing suddenly in several areas.
ANI | Updated: 06-10-2026 18:43 IST | Created: 06-10-2026 18:43 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Lahore [Pakistan], October 6 (ANI) Pakistan’s electricity crisis has intensified, with the country’s overall power deficit reportedly surpassing 4,000 megawatts as several generation units remain offline and hydropower production declines, as reported by ARY News. According to ARY News, sources stated that the worsening shortfall has forced power distribution companies (DISCOs) to increase load-shedding across the country. Consumers in both urban and rural areas are reportedly facing three to four hours of power cuts, with the duration of outages increasing suddenly in several areas.
The situation is particularly difficult in Lahore, where electricity demand has reportedly climbed to around 4,000 megawatts, against an available supply of approximately 3,000 megawatts. This has created a significant gap between demand and supply, adding to pressure on the already strained power distribution system. The latest deterioration has also raised questions over repeated government claims that Pakistan’s electricity shortages had been brought under control. The sources said the promised improvement has failed to materialise as the supply deficit continues to widen. Lahore is also reportedly experiencing a shortage of diesel following disruptions in gas availability, further complicating the city’s energy situation, sources said.
Meanwhile, the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority (NEPRA) has taken action against K-Electric (KE) over its practice of carrying out load-shedding on feeders based on aggregate technical and commercial (ATC) losses. NEPRA has declared such load-shedding illegal and directed K-Electric to immediately stop unannounced power outages carried out on the basis of feeder losses. The regulator maintained that consumers who regularly pay their electricity bills should not have their supply suspended simply because they are connected to feeders with high losses, as cited by ARY News.
NEPRA stressed that paying consumers should not be penalised for electricity theft or other failures by other users. The authority instructed K-Electric to take targeted action against individual consumers involved in electricity theft rather than cutting power to entire feeders, as reported by ARY News. (ANI)

(This story has not been edited by Devdiscourse staff and is auto-generated from a syndicated feed.)
