Home / World News / Paramount completes Warner Bros merger to form Hollywood giant Skydance

Paramount completes Warner Bros merger to form Hollywood giant Skydance The combined company will carry about $80 billion in debt, while co-CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz face a target of delivering $6 billion in planned cost savings

In just 16 years, Skydance has gone from an independent studio to the centre of one of Hollywood's biggest power plays | Image: Bloomberg

Reuters 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 06 2026 | 6:33 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Paramount Skydance on Tuesday completed its blockbuster $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros Discovery, creating a Hollywood heavyweight called Skydance and handing CEO David Ellison control of one of the world's largest entertainment companies.
  The deal brings together the studios behind "Mission: Impossible," "Harry Potter" and DC Studios alongside major television and streaming networks such as CBS, CNN, Paramount+ and HBO Max — forming an expansive entertainment company spanning film, TV and news.
  Shares of the combined company moved to the New York Stock Exchange from Nasdaq on Tuesday to trade under the ticker "SKYD."
  Settlements with a coalition of US states and a Hollywood writers union removed the main legal barriers to the merger, one of the largest in media history. It comes as Hollywood faces declining cable-TV subscriptions, the high cost of competing for streaming audiences and persistent pressure from unions over jobs and creative workers' rights.
 

  Ellison said last week the Skydance name was chosen to retain the individual identities of Paramount and Warner Bros studios, rather than combining them under a new brand.

Paramount settlement talks include plan to keep company in California

  Analysts, however, said the name reinforces the extent of Ellison's control, highlighting how some of Hollywood's most iconic brands now answer to him and how he has a platform to impose his strategy and culture.
  In just 16 years, Skydance has gone from an independent studio to the centre of one of Hollywood's biggest power plays.
  Founded in 2010 by the son of Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, it built its reputation as a financial backer and producer of Paramount's blockbuster "Top Gun: Maverick." After merging with Paramount last year, Skydance set its sights on Warner Bros, entering a heated bidding contest with Netflix while drawing interest from other potential suitors, including Comcast.

  Broader hollywood bet
  Ellison named Mattel's former CEO Ynon Kreiz as Skydance co-CEO to run day-to-day operations and lead the integration, while Ellison oversees creative direction and overall strategy.
  The duo faces the task of combining two large companies while delivering $6 billion in planned cost savings, a big part of which Paramount said would come from "non-labour sources" — by combining streaming technologies and cloud providers of the two companies. However, the scale of the cuts is expected to affect jobs across Hollywood.
  The combined company is also expected to carry about $80 billion in debt, putting pressure on Ellison to grow streaming, preserve cash flow from cable networks and improve theatrical film performance.

  CNN chief Mark Thompson and CBS News Editor-in-Chief Bari Weiss would continue in their respective leadership roles at Skydance.

items.title: アラスカは共和党の「防波堤」、中間選挙控えバンス氏が支持訴え
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Jacob Bogage

[フェアバンクス（米アラスカ州） ５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Jacob Bogage

[フェアバンクス（米アラスカ州） ５日 ロイター] - バンス米副大統領は５日、アラスカ州で再選に向けて接戦を繰り広げる共和党のダン・サリバン上院議員の選挙集会に参加し、同州は共和党が中間選挙で議会の多数派を維持するための「防波堤」だと訴えた。 

保守陣営は投票に向けて民主党の勢いを食い止めたい考えで、トランプ大統領とバンス氏は１１月３日の投票日まで全米各地を遊説する。

遊説先の多くは保守色が強いにもかかわらず、民主党が異例の善戦を見せている地域で、アラスカ州もその一つだ。２期目のサリバン氏は州内で知名度が高く、トランプ氏の盟友でもある。２０２４年の大統領選では、トランプ氏が同州で１３ポイント差をつけて勝利した。

サリバン氏の対立候補である民主党のメアリー・ペルトラ氏は、同時に行われた下院選で再選を逃した。

バンス氏はフェアバンクス国際空港での集会で「民主党は今回の選挙でこの州に執着している」と指摘。「彼らは『最後の開拓地』（アラスカ州の愛称）を、米国を極左の方向に進め、トランプ氏を弾劾し、われわれが州内全域で進めるエネルギー事業を止め、この州と米国の目覚ましい発展を阻むための、最後に残された最良の望みとみている」と語った。

しかし、生活費を巡る有権者の不満により、同州は接戦の舞台となっている。アラスカ州は米本土と比べても総じて生活費が高い。

ニューヨーク・タイムズ紙が９月２４日から１０月１日に実施した世論調査では、ペルトラ氏が７ポイントのリードを示した。ただ、農村部が広がる同州では世論調査の実施が難しい。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター

[５日 ロイター] - 貴金属コンサルティング会社メタルズ・フォーカスは年次報告書で、金価格が２０２７年に過去最高値を更新するとの見通しを示した。根強いインフレや米財政赤字の拡大、政策の不透明感を背景に、従来のドル建て資産に代わる投資先を求める投資家の動きが上昇を後押しするという。

• ２７年の金の平均価格は、現在の水準を約２２％上回る１オンス＝５３３０ドルになる見通し。ただ、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が目標を上回るインフレに対処するため、金融引き締めをさらに進める可能性があり、短期的には逆風となり得るとした。

• 金現物価格は２６年１月下旬に５５９４．８２ドルの過去最高値を付けたが、その後はエネルギー価格の高騰やＦＲＢの金融引き締めを受け、２５％下落した。足元では４１５２．２７ドル付近で取引されている。[GOL/]

items.title: ＧＰＩＦ、9月経営委で基本ポートフォリオ見直しの議題なし
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ６日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 年金積立金管理運用独立行政法人（ＧＰＩＦ）は６日、９月２８日に開催した経営委員会の議事次第を公表した。同委の異例の８月開催を契機に市場では基本ポートフォリオ見直しに関する思惑が浮上していたが、関連する報告は今回の議題に盛り込まれなかった。

ＧＰＩＦは、経営委を８月としては７年ぶりに開催し、議事次第には「基本ポートフォリオ検証等ＰＴ（プロジェクトチーム）における議論について」との報告事項が記載されていた。

経営委で仮に各種計数の再確認が必要と判断され、見直し検討の必要性が決議されれば、基本ポートフォリオの正式な改定作業へと移行することになる。検証に進んだ場合、９月以降の経営委では基本ポートフォリオ検証等ＰＴのメンバーから各種計数の確認結果が報告されることになるとの指摘が出ていた。

items.title: マクドナルド、ＡＩで価格操作か　米顧客が集団訴訟求め提訴
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mike Scarcella

[ワシントン ５日 ロイター] - 米ファストフードチェーン大手マクドナルドが人工知能（...
items.body:
マクドナルド、ＡＩで価格操作か　米顧客が集団訴訟求め提訴
10/6 13:50 配信

米ニューヨークにあるマクドナルドのドライブスルーの看板。７月撮影。 REUTERS/Jordan Tovin

Mike Scarcella

[ワシントン ５日 ロイター] - 米ファストフードチェーン大手マクドナルドが人工知能（ＡＩ）を活用した価格設定システムを通じて、加盟店と直営店のメニュー価格を違法に調整しているとして、シカゴの連邦裁判所に提訴された。原告は全米の顧客を対象とする集団訴訟の認定を求めている。

２日に提出された訴状は、マクドナルドが独立した加盟店と共謀し、非公開データで学習させたアルゴリズムを使って価格を操作することで、米国の反トラスト法（独占禁止法）に違反したと主張している。

ロイターは先週、マクドナルドの価格設定システムが機械学習アルゴリズムを使い、約１万４０００店舗で日々行われる数百万件の取引データを継続的に分析していると報じた。

訴状は「独立した事業者は、独自に価格を設定しなければならない」としている。 

マクドナルドは５日の声明で、原告の主張は憶測に基づき、実態を理解していないと反論した。

同社は「ビッグマックやその他のメニュー商品の価格を決めているのはＡＩではない」と表明。加盟店は独自に価格を決定しており、価格推奨ツールやデータ分析の活用は幅広い業界に浸透していると説明した。 

原告側の弁護士ラーク・ターナー氏は声明で、マクドナルドが「膨大なデータとフランチャイズ網を利用し、フライドポテトの最後の１本に至るまで、消費者から小銭を搾り取っている」と述べた。

訴状によると、原告はイリノイ州の住民で、数百万人に上る可能性があるマクドナルドの顧客を代表することを求めている。

items.title: 川崎重工、防衛事業の売上収益上振れへ　半導体用ロボットの生産能力倍増
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ６日 ロイター] - 川崎重工業は６日、最大７０００億円を計画していた２０３０年度の防衛事業の売上収益が８０００...
items.body:
川崎重工、防衛事業の売上収益上振れへ　半導体用ロボットの生産能力倍増
10/6 13:46 配信

都内の川崎重工業のオフィスで９月撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 川崎重工業は６日、最大７０００億円を計画していた２０３０年度の防衛事業の売上収益が８０００億円に上振れる見込みだと発表した。政府の防衛費増額が追い風になるとしている。半導体用ロボットの生産能力を２倍に引き上げることも公表した。

同社はこの日、３０年度を最終年度とする経営計画の進捗説明会を開いた。事業別に説明していく中で、防衛を最初に取り上げた。

橋本康彦社長は「防衛費が増大したということと、防衛に関して国民の全体の理解が進んだ中で、そこに注力していくことを皆さんにお知らせするタイミングが来た」と語った。

３０年度に５０００億━７０００億円と見通していた防衛事業の売上収益は７０００─８０００億円に増えそうだという。事業利益率は防衛省との契約制度改正により、２７年度以降１０％を超える見込みだとした。

また、無人装備や人工知能（ＡＩ）の普及など戦い方の変化に対応し、２０３０年代中ごろに防衛事業の売上収益を１兆円超へ引き上げるとした。

半導体の製造現場で使うロボットの生産能力を、２９年度までに倍増することも発表した。既存の建屋を活用して７５億円を投資する。新工場の建設も視野に入れる。拡大する半導体製造装置の需要を取り込み、３５年に売り上げを１６００億円規模へ増やす。

連結では３０年度までの４年間で約５５００億円を成長投資に振り向ける。売上収益は従来目標の３兆円規模から３兆３０００億円超へ引き上げた。同社は７月、公募増資などで２０００億円を調達した。

items.title: オープンＡＩとアンソロピック、豪州のデータ侵害報告義務化を歓迎
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Byron Kaye

[シドニー ６日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックは６日、オ...
items.body:
オープンＡＩとアンソロピック、豪州のデータ侵害報告義務化を歓迎
10/6 13:43 配信

アンソロピックのロゴ。6月5日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Byron Kaye

[シドニー ６日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）企業のオープンＡＩとアンソロピックは６日、オーストラリア議会に対し、自社のＡＩエージェントによるデータ侵害を報告することを義務付ける法律を歓迎すると述べた。両社は、当局への通知が現在は各社の裁量に委ねられていることを認めた。

オープンＡＩは数週間前、自社のＡＩエージェントが豪州の主要な医療ポータルサイトに不正侵入したと公表。豪政府は、不正侵入の通知が発生から約３カ月後となったことについて、オープンＡＩを批判している。

アンソロピックとオープンＡＩはそれぞれ、クイーンズランド州とシドニーで計画する大規模データセンターの承認を待っている。また、豪州のコンテンツをモデルの学習に利用できるよう、著作権法の緩和も求めている。

豪州は現在、ＡＩに特化した法律の準備を進めており、２０２７年の施行を目指している。

オープンＡＩのジェイソン・クォン最高戦略責任者（ＣＳＯ）は公聴会で「われわれは情報開示の義務化に関する枠組みを支持する」と表明。不正侵入について知った際、「われわれはプロセスを整理し、適用すべき基準を策定しようとしていた」と説明した上で、「それは法的措置によって提供できる機能だ。社会を代表する人々が、より多くの決定を下す必要がある。そうすればわれわれがこれら全ての決定を下す必要はなくなる」と語った。

アンソロピックでも、同社のエージェントがハッキングを犯したという事例が複数発生しており、オーストラリア・ニュージーランド担当ポリシー責任者デービッド・マスターズ氏も公聴会で、ＡＩ企業にデータ侵害の開示を義務付けるオーストラリアの法律については、同社として喜んで受け入れる意向だと述べた。

また、同社の安全対策責任者、デービッド・オア氏は公聴会で、オープンＡＩのエージェントによるハギング・フェイスへの侵入事件以来、「長期にわたる詳細な調査」を実施してきたが、豪政府のシステムへの不正侵入は確認されなかったと説明した。

９日まで公聴会が予定されており、最終報告書は１１月３０日に提出される予定となっている。

items.title: 日銀、10月会合で基調物価2％到達と判断の可能性＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Takahiko Wada　Leika Kihara

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - 日銀が金融政策運営で重視する基調的...
items.body:
日銀、10月会合で基調物価2％到達と判断の可能性＝関係筋
10/6 13:32 配信

日本銀行本店の前で６月１５日撮影　REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Takahiko Wada　Leika Kihara

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - 日銀が金融政策運営で重視する基調的な物価上昇率について、２％に到達したとの認識を示す方向で検討に入ることが分かった。早ければ今月の金融政策決定会合で判断する。金融環境は依然として緩和的で、基調物価２％程度での定着へ、日銀は引き続き短い間隔での利上げを進める方針だが、物価指標は想定通りに推移しており、現時点で１０月会合での利上げには慎重な見方が多い。複数の関係筋が明らかにした。

日銀は基調的な物価上昇率について、政策要因を除いた消費者物価のコア指標や中長期の予想物価上昇率などから総合的に判断している。９月会合の声明文では「２０２６年度後半から２０２７年度にかけて」２％と整合的な水準に達するとの見方を維持した。

政策委員の間では、すでに高田創委員や田村直樹委員が２％に到達していると主張している。植田和男総裁は９月会合後の会見で、２％に「だいたいヒットしつつある」と述べており、他の委員の見方にも変化が出てきている。９月会合の主な意見では、基調物価は２％に「かなり近づいている」、「ほどなく２％に達することが見込まれる」との意見が見られた。

１日公表の日銀短観では、企業の中長期の予想物価上昇率が高止まりしていることが確認された。日銀では、原油市況が一時的に調整しても、企業の値上げ姿勢が積極的な中で予想物価が下振れすることは考えづらいとの声が出ている。毎月勤労統計では前年比３％付近の賃金上昇が続いており、基調物価の２％到達を示唆しているとの指摘もある。

このため、１０月会合で議論する「経済・物価情勢の展望（展望リポート）」で２％到達の認識を示す可能性が高い。

日銀は９月利上げに当たり、物価の上振れリスクが根強い中で基調物価を２％程度で定着させていくことが重要だと強調した。基調物価が２％に到達した際には政策金利が中立金利に到達している姿を理想としているが、累次の利上げにもかかわらず金融環境はなお緩和的で、政策金利は中立金利にはまだ距離がある状況だ。このため、基調物価が２％に到達したと判断した上で、２％程度での定着に向け、引き続き短い間隔で利上げを進めていく方針だ。

ただ、関係筋によると、９月に続いて１０月会合でも利上げすることに対しては日銀内で慎重な声が出ている。これまでの利上げの経済への影響を見極める必要があるとの見方のほか、短観の企業の物価見通しでは物価予想がさらに上振れていることまでは示されておらず、月次の物価指標も日銀の想定通りに推移しているという。日銀は決定会合までの市場動向なども見極めた上で、利上げの是非を最終判断する。

items.title: PepsiCo, Monster, Reliance win partial reprieve on 'energy drink' label ban in India
items.author: Arpan Chaturvedi, Munsif Vengattil
items.creator: Arpan Chaturvedi, Munsif Vengattil
items.summary: PepsiCo, Monster Beverage and Reliance's beverage unit can keep the "energy drink" label on existing stocks in India, a court ruled on Tuesday as it reviewed a ban on the label by the food regulator.
items.body:
PepsiCo, Monster Beverage and Reliance's beverage unit can keep the "energy drink" label on existing stocks in India, a court ruled on Tuesday as it reviewed a ban on the label by the food regulator.
The ruling provides a breather for the companies after a months-long dispute they say disrupted operations.
The regulator in June ordered makers of high-caffeine beverages sold as "energy drinks" to stop using the description, rejecting the industry's efforts to stall the move in a market expected to be worth $1.6 billion by 2028.
On Tuesday, the Delhi High Court made the allowances for PepsiCo (PEP.O) and Monster (MNST.O) in a hearing that followed their pleas last week, according to court orders released.
The decision permits the companies to only sell existing stocks of drinks with the label. Any stocks manufactured after Tuesday must not carry the "energy drink" label, the order added.
The order follows reprieves the court granted to Reliance Consumer, the beverage arm of Reliance (RELI.NS) , earlier on Tuesday and to [USN:L1N45L070 TEXT:"Austria's Red Bull"] last week.
The legal showdown is being closely watched as the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has embarked on a broader India-wide [USN:L1N45K079 TEXT:"food safety push"] this year. Its crackdown has ranged from raids and shutdowns to new ingredient warning-label requirements, driven by growing concern over the health risks posed by junk food and beyond.
As it heard Reliance's arguments, the court asked FSSAI's lawyer why the regulator had not allowed the company enough time before passing the order, telling the agency it was "never too late" to correct its mistake.
The court will continue to hear the cases in the coming weeks.
FSSAI did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
STOCK SEIZURES AND FINANCIAL LOSSES The label ban has threatened the ambitions of PepsiCo, Monster Beverage and Reliance in India's fast-growing energy drinks market, where retail sales are expanding 12.6% a year, outstripping growth in the US and China, according to Euromonitor.
Reliance and PepsiCo have said that hundreds of millions of their beverage products labelled "energy drink" have been abruptly taken out of circulation since the ban.
State authorities have seized their stock, causing financial losses and impacting investment plans, the companies have said.
Such moves "are causing substantial disruption" to business operations, the beverages' arm of Reliance said in a court filing dated October 1, a copy of which was reviewed by Reuters.
Reliance revived the Campa brand in 2023 and has since used its retail network and low prices to challenge Coca-Cola and PepsiCo.
items.raw_description: PepsiCo, Monster Beverage and Reliance's beverage unit can keep the "energy drink" label on existing stocks in India, a court ruled on Tuesday as it reviewed a ban on the label by the food regulator.

items.title: マテル、大株主が身売り検討要求　業績改善「停滞」・株価過小評価と主張
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Juveria Tabassum　Angela Christy M

[５日 ロイター] - 米玩具大手マテルの大株主で...
items.body:
マテル、大株主が身売り検討要求　業績改善「停滞」・株価過小評価と主張
10/6 12:14 配信

ニューヨークで開催されたトイフェアで展示されたマテル社の看板。2026年2月17日撮影　 REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

Juveria Tabassum　Angela Christy M

[５日 ロイター] - 米玩具大手マテルの大株主である資産運用会社アリエル・インベストメンツは５日、業績や収益性の改善が停滞しているとして、マテルに会社売却を含む戦略的選択肢を検討するよう求めた。ロイターがアリエルの書簡を確認した。

マテル株の５．４％を保有するアリエルは、マテル株が依然として大幅に過小評価されていると指摘。アリエルのジョン・ロジャース共同最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）はマテル取締役会に宛てた書簡で「われわれの試算では、戦略的買い手は現在の株価に大幅なプレミアムを上乗せした価格を支払うだろう」と述べた。

アリエルは選択肢として大規模な資産売却や他社との合併、会社全体の売却などを挙げ、マテルが保有するブランド群は同業の玩具メーカーに加え、エンターテインメント企業や従来型のプライベートエクイティー（ＰＥ）投資会社にとっても魅力的だとの見方を示した。

マテルは、映画「バービー」のヒットによる大幅な業績押し上げ効果が一巡したことで過去２年ほど販売の不安定さや投入コストの上昇に直面。営業利益は過去６四半期にわたり減少している。

マテルはロイターへの電子メールで「取締役会と経営陣は全株主の利益を最優先して行動することに尽力しており、アリエル・インベストメンツの書簡で示された見解を、他の株主の意見とともに検討する」とコメントした。

マテルに戦略的選択肢の検討を求める投資家が現れたのは今年２度目。５月には株主のサウスイースタン・アセット・マネジメントが、非公開化のほか競合のハズブロや、マテルの資産を株式市場より高く評価する可能性がある大手メディア企業による買収などを検討するよう求めていた。

マテルには先週、オーセンティック・ブランズ・グループから買収の打診があり、企業価値を約６０億ドル以上と評価する可能性があると、事情に詳しい関係者がロイターに明らかにしていた。ただ、マテルが提案に応じる保証はなく、正式な売却手続きも始まっていないという。

この報道を受けてマテル株は急伸したものの、年初からはなお約２０％下落している。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、今後１２カ月の予想株価収益率（ＰＥＲ）は９．９９倍で、業界平均の１４．０３倍を下回る。

モーニングスターのアナリスト、ジェイミー・カッツ氏は「（主要株主の間には）事業がやや停滞していることへの不満があるのだろう。現在のバリュエーションを踏まえれば、投資家の目が届かない非公開企業として事業を立て直すには良いタイミングかもしれない」と述べた。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [６日 ロイター] - 香港の不動産開発大手、新世界発展は６日、２０２７年および２０２８年満期の社債の一部を２０３２年...
items.body:
香港不動産大手の新世界発展、返済圧力軽減に債務交換オファーを開始
10/6 12:11 配信

香港にある新世界発展の本社ビルで2024年9月27日撮影　 REUTERS/Tyrone Siu

[６日 ロイター] - 香港の不動産開発大手、新世界発展は６日、２０２７年および２０２８年満期の社債の一部を２０３２年満期の新しい担保付き社債と交換できるデット・エクスチェンジ・オファー（債務交換オファー）を開始した。

短期的な返済圧力を軽減し、流動性を強化することが狙いだ。

詳細は以下の通り。

• 新設した子会社ニューＶＤボンドコは、既発債と交換するため、２０３２年満期の優先担保付き社債（表面利率７．３７５％）を最大６億ドル発行する計画。

• 新世界発展は香港で最も多額の負債を抱える不動産開発会社の一つで、負債削減、資産売却、流動性の強化に取り組んできた。

• オファーは元本計約９億９１００万ドル相当の米ドル建て社債３シリーズが対象で、２０２７年１月満期、２０２７年６月満期、２０２８年２月満期の社債が含まれる。オファーは今年１０月２０日に終了する予定。

• 同社はオファーについて、債務の満期構成を最適化し、バランスシートの柔軟性を高め、全体的な財務状況を改善することが目的だと説明した。

• 同社は先週、負債削減に向けた広範な取り組みの一環として、融資枠を約１０億香港ドル（約１億２７４４万ドル）拡大したほか、香港国際空港に隣接する商業施設の運営権を終了した。

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は小幅に続伸し、前営業日比０...
items.body:
午前の日経平均は小幅続伸、原油安で物色に広がり　金利高警戒で伸び悩みも
10/6 12:04 配信

東京の証券会社の前で2026年6月16撮影。REUTERS/Manami Yamada

Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は小幅に続伸し、前営業日比０．１９％（１３４円６７銭）高の７万００８１円５３銭となった。米国市場でのハイテク株高を受けて人工知能（ＡＩ）・半導体関連株の一角が上昇して指数を押し上げたほか、原油価格の下落を手掛かりに物色に広がりもみられた。一方、世界的な金利上昇基調への警戒感がくすぶり、買い一巡後は伸び悩んだ。

・日経平均は前日高の反動で朝方に一時小幅マイナスの場面も。

・短時間で切り返し、一時３カ月ぶり高値となる０．６７％（４６９円９２銭）高の７万０４１６円７８銭に上げを拡大。

・アドバンテストが一銘柄で日経平均を１００円超押し上げ。

・ＡＩ株はまちまち。東京エレクトロンやキオクシアホールディングスはマイナス。

・買い一巡後は伸び悩み。金利高が警戒され、１０年債入札結果の発表や日銀総裁の発言機会を前に様子見も。

・ＷＴＩ先物は８９ドル台。中東からの原油輸出が堅調との報道や、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）による戦略備蓄の協調放出が上値抑制。

・東証プライム市場の７割超が値上がりし、物色に広がりも。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは０．４４％高の４１６３．６１ポイントで午前の取引を終了。値上がり率が日経平均を上回りＮＴ倍率は上昇一服。

・東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆３９２７億８２００万円。

・東証３３業種で上昇したのは、鉄鋼、非鉄金属、保険など２６業種、下落は情報・通信、機械、電気・ガスなど７業種。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが１０６８銘柄（６８％）、値下がりは４０９銘柄（２６％）、変わらずは７４銘柄（４％）。

＜ＵＢＳ　ＳｕＭｉトラスト・ウェルス・マネジメント　日本株ストラテジスト　小林千紗氏＞

「米雇用統計後の利上げ観測低下を素直に好感して前日に大きく上昇したが、その割に利益確定売りは強まらず底堅さも」

「金利高が警戒される中、株価の急ピッチな上昇は見込みにくいが買い意欲はみられる。緩やかな上昇を期待」

「金利高環境ではバリュエーションの伸びは見込みにくく、業績が堅調な銘柄を物色する動きが強まりそう」

items.author: CNA
items.summary: South Korea's police have launched a full-scale investigation into the hacking attacks against commercial banks that led to a breach of customers' personal information.
items.body:

South Korea's Lee says AI appears to have been used in bank hacks

South Korea's police have launched a full-scale investigation into the hacking attacks against commercial banks that led to a breach of customers' personal information. 

South Korean President Lee Jae Myung delivers a speech during the 78th Armed Forces Day at a military base in Gyeryong-City, South Korea, on Oct 1, 2026. (Photo: Jeon Heon-Kyun/Pool via Reuters)

FAST

SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung said on Tuesday (Oct 6) that AI models are believed to have been used in some recent hacking incidents against banks and called for the country to develop cybersecurity methods suited to the AI era.
"In some hacking incidents, signs have emerged of AI being used, causing considerable public concern and anxiety," Lee said during a Cabinet meeting. "Please establish the circumstances swiftly and clearly, and concentrate personnel and resources on minimising the damage."
South Korea's police have launched a full-scale investigation into the hacking attacks against commercial banks that led to a breach of customers' personal information, the Yonhap news agency reported on Tuesday.
Shinhan Bank, KB Kookmin Bank and others had reported cyberattacks, the Financial Services Commission (FSC) said on Friday, while Yonhap reported that Hana Bank and Woori Bank had also suffered breaches.

Authorities have not yet disclosed details on what kind of AI tools were used in the hacking incidents or the full scale of the breaches.
On Sunday, FSC Chairman Lee Eog-weon convened an emergency meeting with financial industry associations, regulators and executives from affected institutions, warning that the sector must respond with the highest level of vigilance.
In September, Australia said an OpenAI agent breached a government health data portal in June, gaining unauthorised access to files, in what could be the first known instance of an AI agent hacking a government website.
An artificial intelligence research firm said last week that AI agents tried to hack into a Canadian government website , casting the effort as a failed hacking attempt, while Canada said there were no indications its systems were compromised.

items.body:
ミスターマックス、不正アクセスで最大173万人の会員情報流出
10/6 11:57 配信

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - ディスカウントストアを展開するミスターマックス・ホールディングスは６日、グループ傘下の会社が運営するＭｒＭａｘアプリとオンラインストアのサーバーが第三者による不正アクセスを受け、最大１７３万５１５４人の会員情報が外部に流出したことを確認したと発表した。

流出した可能性がある情報はアプリ会員とオンラインストア会員のＩＤ、氏名、メールアドレス、電話番号。住所、生年月日、クレジットカード情報、パスワード、購入履歴は流出していないという。

同社は１０月３日にＭｒＭａｘのサーバーに対する不審なアクセスを確認、サービスを一時停止して外部からのアクセスを遮断する措置を講じた。その後の調査で第三者がサーバーに侵入し、会員の個人情報の一部が流出したことが判明したという。

Kentaro Sugiyama

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 片山さつき財務相兼金融担当相は６日の閣議後会見で、大...
items.body:
顧客情報の適正な管理は極めて重要＝大和証の情報漏洩の可能性で金融相
10/6 11:52 配信

写真は片山さつき財務相兼金融担当相。9月17日、都内で撮影。 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Kentaro Sugiyama

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 片山さつき財務相兼金融担当相は６日の閣議後会見で、大和証券の顧客情報が漏洩した可能性があることに関連し、「顧客情報の適正な管理は個人情報保護や金融機関の信頼性の確保の観点から極めて重要」との認識を示した。その上で、同社の対応をしっかりモニタリングし、「信用が失われないようにしていただかなければ困る」と語った。

大和証券グループ本社傘下の大和証券は５日、外部委託先のサーバーへの不正アクセスにより、約１１万人分の顧客情報が漏洩した可能性があると発表した。漏洩の可能性がある情報は氏名、メールアドレス、口座番号などで、個人を特定できない問い合わせなどの情報を含めると約２２万件に上るという。

items.body:
三陽商会、中間期の最終赤字が予想より拡大　6月までの不振挽回できず
10/6 11:49 配信

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 三陽商会は６日、２０２６年度中間期（３━８月期）連結決算が５億５５００万円の最終赤字（前年同期は２億９９００万円の赤字）になったと発表した。赤字幅は従来予想の４億８０００万円より拡大した。

・春夏商戦終盤の６月に天候不順が続いた影響で市場全体が低迷。正規価格商品の販売不振で同社の６月売上高も前年比９割にとどまった。

・７月以降は正規価格での販売を強化し、セール販売を抑制したものの、６月までの不振を挽回できなかった。

・８月に中間期の最終損益予想を４億円の黒字から４億８０００万円の赤字に下方修正していた。

・２７年２月期通期の連結業績予想は据え置いた。

items.title: Gold edges up as dollar, Treasury yields slip
items.author: Pablo Sinha
items.creator: Pablo Sinha
items.summary: Gold ticked up on Tuesday, supported by a pause in the US Treasury yield's rally and a weaker dollar, while investors awaited the minutes of the Federal Reserve's September meeting for fresh clues on its monetary policy outlook.
items.body:
Gold ticked up on Tuesday, supported by a pause in the US Treasury yield's rally and a weaker dollar, while investors awaited the minutes of the Federal Reserve's September meeting for fresh clues on its monetary policy outlook.
Spot gold rose 0.4% to $4,155.34 per ounce by 10:09 a.m. EDT (1409 GMT). US gold futures for December delivery added 0.6% to $4,182.30.
"We're seeing some safe haven demand (in gold) because of the turmoil in the French bond market and growing concerns about the US Treasury markets," said Jim Wyckoff, a market analyst at American Gold Exchange.
US 10-year Treasury yields edged lower after climbing to a more than two-decade high on Monday, while the dollar eased from a one-year high, making greenback-priced bullion more affordable for holders of other currencies.
Investors remain on edge about rising government debt levels and widening [USN:L6N45S0EJ TEXT:"budget deficits"] across parts of the euro zone, particularly in France, pushing sovereign bond yields higher.
Investors are now looking out for minutes of the September Federal Open Market Committee meeting, due on Wednesday, to gauge the possibility of further interest rate hikes this year.
Markets have pared bets for a Fed rate hike this month after softer-than-expected [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"job growth"] in September.
Traders now see only a 22% chance of the Fed raising rates this month but are still pricing in an 84% probability of an increase in December, according to CME's FedWatch Tool.
Gold tends to lose its appeal to yield-bearing assets in a high-interest-rate environment.
Meanwhile, oil prices fell as resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns.
"Despite near-term headwinds, ongoing ETF buying and demand from discretionary investors continues to provide support for gold. We maintain our view that the yellow metal will move above $5,000 per ounce in 2027," analysts at TD Securities said in a note.
Among other metals, silver was little changed at $61.01, while platinum slid 2% to $1,687.70 and palladium fell 1.1% to $1,160.38.

items.title: 焦点：仏国債下落がユーロ安に波及、選挙年控えＥＣＢの対応に注目
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Dhara Ranasinghe　Alun John

[ロンドン ５日 ロイター] - フランスの国債利回りが上昇（価...
items.body:
焦点：仏国債下落がユーロ安に波及、選挙年控えＥＣＢの対応に注目
10/6 10:55 配信

ユーロ紙幣。３月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Dhara Ranasinghe　Alun John

[ロンドン ５日 ロイター] - フランスの国債利回りが上昇（価格が下落）し、ユーロ圏全体に波及し始めたことに身構えている政策当局者の耳に、ユーロの下落という新たな警鐘が鳴っている。

ユーロ／ドルは５日に１．１２ドルを下回って１７カ月ぶりの安値を付け、ユーロは英ポンド、スイスフラン、円に対しても急落した。

欧州市場の懸念の中心にあるのがフランスだ。

フランス政府は、赤字を削減して記録的水準の債務を抑えるために、不人気な２０２７年予算を成立させようとしている。しかし議会は来年の大統領選挙に向けて各会派が主張を強めるなどして深く分断されており、通過は容易ではない状況だ。

投資家はリスクを避けてフランス国債を売り叩き、安全なドイツ国債を買っている。

ドイツ国債に対するフランス国債の上乗せ利回り（スプレッド）は１０―１２年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の最高水準に達し、為替市場は波及を恐れている。

この動向は、政治的不確実性に揺れるユーロ圏の弱い経済成長を脅かしている。ドイツでは先月、メルツ首相の与党が州議会選挙で戦後最悪の敗北を喫した。そして今週５日には、スペインのサンチェス首相が電撃的な解散総選挙を発表。イタリアも来年選挙を控えている。

ユーロ圏ではエネルギーコストの高騰により既にインフレ率が上昇し、利回り上昇は家計や企業の借入コストを押し上げている。ユーロ安が進めば、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）はインフレ抑制と国債市場鎮静化の間で板挟みになりかねない。

フランスとドイツの１０年国債利回りスプレッドは先週、過去数十年で最大の週間拡大幅を記録し、イタリアとドイツの同スプレッドもコロナ禍以来で最大幅拡大して約１３０ベースポイント（ｂｐ）に達した。

ソシエテ・ジェネラルのチーフＦＸストラテジスト、キット・ジャックス氏は「何らかの形でより脆弱だと見なされた債券がより大きく売り込まれ、それがユーロ売りを誘発してその勢いが増している」と説明。「夏の間、ユーロ／ドルを支えて重要な節目の上に維持していた要因は消えたと思う」と語り、エネルギーショックは一過性だ、あるいは米国はドル安を推し進める、といった想定が崩れたと指摘した。

＜ユーロ安の新局面＞

ユーロは、ロシアのウクライナ侵攻がエネルギー危機を引き起こした２２年に付けた２０年ぶりの安値は大きく上回っている。しかし債券市場の動きによってユーロ安に新たな側面が加わった。

ＢｏｆＡのＦＸストラテジストの試算によると、ドイツ国債に対するフランス国債のスプレッドが１０ｂｐ拡大するごとに、ユーロ／ドルは０．４％下落しそうだ。

ゴールドマン・サックスのアナリストチームはノートで「通常、（スプレッド拡大に対する為替の）反応はゼロに近いが、深刻なストレス時には大幅に高まる可能性がある」と指摘。「スプレッドが唯一の重要な要因になる瞬間が来るまで、スプレッドは通貨に影響を与えないものだ」とし、リスクイベントによってドイツ国債利回りが下がる一方、他のユーロ圏国債利回りが上昇する時にユーロへの影響が強まると説明した。

先週はまさにこのケースで、ドイツ１０年国債利回りは約１７ｂｐ低下と、２４年以来で最大の週間低下幅を記録した。

アムンディ・アセット・マネジメントのグローバルＦＸ責任者アンドレアス・コーニグ氏は「ユーロ／ドルは通常ドル側の影響をより強く受けるが、今回は欧州からの影響もある」と語る。「欧州のニュースが最後にユーロを動かした時までさかのぼるには、少し時間を巻き戻す必要がある」という。

コーニグ氏は中期的にユーロ安の反転は見込めないと考え、米国の成長・金利見通しを踏まえてドルをオーバーウエートとするポジションを維持している。

米商品先物取引委員会（ＣＦＴＣ）のデータによると、トレーダーはユーロ下落に賭けるポジションを組んでおり、この見方はオプション市場にも反映されている。

ユーロを買うオプションと売るオプションのコストの差を表す３カ月のユーロ・リスクリバーサルは２日、２４年以来で最もユーロに弱気な水準まで低下した。

アナリストらはユーロが１．１０ドルを試す可能性があると指摘している。ソシエテ・ジェネラルのジャックス氏も円やスイスフランなどに対するユーロの脆弱性を強調した。ユーロは９月、円に対して約４％下落した。

債務市場のストレスと並行してユーロが下がったことで、政策当局者がどのように市場を安定させられるかに焦点は移った。特に来年のフランス大統領選により、さらに緊張が高まった場合が問題だ。

ＥＣＢは「トランスミッション保護ツール（ＴＰＩ）」により、「正当化されない、無秩序な」金融環境のタイト化に直面した国の国債を無制限に買い入れることができる。

今のところ、ユーロ圏の成長は弱いながらも改善している。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルのデータによると、９月のユーロ圏の企業活動は過去３年半で最も速いペースで拡大した。

ユーリゾンＳＬＪアセット・マネジメントのスティーブン・ジェン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）兼共同最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）は「ユーロは既にわずかに過小評価されていると考えているが、欧州における財政波及リスクを抑え込めない場合、ユーロ／ドルはさらに下がる可能性がある」と述べた。

items.title: World shares advance as oil falls, bond yields retreat
items.author: Lawrence Delevingne, Medha Singh, Stella Qiu
items.creator: Lawrence Delevingne, Medha Singh, Stella Qiu
items.summary: World stocks scaled two-week highs on Tuesday as easing oil prices and bond yields helped steady sentiment, while investors looked ahead to an earnings season expected to be powered by continued AI-driven growth.
items.body:
World stocks scaled two-week highs on Tuesday as easing oil prices and bond yields helped steady sentiment, while investors looked ahead to an earnings season expected to be powered by continued AI-driven growth.
The S&P 500 (.SPX) touched a [USN:L6N45S0W1 TEXT:"record high"] for the first time since mid-August, up 0.88% on the day, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq (.IXIC) , at 0.85% higher, was on track for a third consecutive all-time high. The Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 0.76%.
The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) firmed 0.4%, and MSCI's gauge of stocks across the globe (.MIWD00000PUS) rose 0.8%.
Bond markets found some respite on Tuesday after France's unpopular [USN:L1N45N0A3 TEXT:"budget"] triggered a French debt rout and fuelled fears of broader stress across the euro zone.
The euro rose 0.35% to 1.126, stabilising after hitting a 17-month low in the previous session due to [USN:L6N45S0D2 TEXT:"concerns"] about the euro zone's fiscal outlook. Political uncertainty also deepened after Spain called a [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"snap election"] on Monday.
France's 10-year bond yield fell about 10 basis points to 4.75% after surging to its highest since the 2000s last week. Far-right leader Marine Le Pen, the frontrunner in next spring's presidential election, [USN:L1N45S0C4 TEXT:"increased"] her plans to slash spending if elected in 2027.
"On the one hand, you've got quite material pressure being felt on the government bond side. But elsewhere the corporate side of things actually don't look too bad. You've got companies whose earnings remain very robust. We're getting into the earnings season fairly soon, expectations for that are pretty high," said James Klempster, deputy head of multi-asset at Liontrust in London.
With few major catalysts on this week's calendar, investors are increasingly focused on third-quarter earnings, which begin in earnest next week. Goldman Sachs estimates consensus forecasts imply 27% growth in S&P 500 earnings, with more than half that coming from companies benefiting from AI infrastructure spending.
Nvidia (NVDA.O) , the world's most valuable company and a bellwether for the AI trade, rose 1.3%, putting it on track for a market value of nearly $6 trillion.
Brent crude fell about 2% to $98.31 a barrel as resilient Middle East [USN:L1N45S05E TEXT:"crude exports"] and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns, though ongoing security risks in the region limited losses.
Strategists at PIMCO said in a new outlook that they expect stable global growth to continue while inflation moderates as the energy price shock fades and AI-related demand continues to grow.
"The global economy has remained resilient," they wrote.
BOND WORRIES LINGER The dollar weakened broadly against most major currencies, reversing some recent advances as investors pared back their bets on US interest rate hikes following a soft US jobs report and policymakers' calls for more [USN:S0N44V01O TEXT:"evidence"] before further tightening.
The dollar index fell 0.34% after rising 3% over the past month.
Traders scaled back expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase this month to 22% from about 50% a week earlier.
Long-dated US Treasury yields also eased after touching fresh 24-year highs on Monday amid a persistent selloff since late August on inflation and debt concerns. The 10-year yield fell 4.4 bps to 5.26%, while the 30-year yield dropped 5.6 bps to 5.66%.
Attention remained fixed on France's fiscal outlook.
The premium investors demand to hold 10-year French bonds, known as OATs, over safer German debt, known as Bunds, narrowed after widening last week to 158.67 bps, its highest level since the euro zone debt crisis in 2011. France's Finance Minister Roland Lescure [USN:S8N3XB0C2 TEXT:"said "]market turbulence had not reached a level warranting ECB intervention.
German 10-year bond yields , the euro zone benchmark, dipped slightly to 3.47%.
Spot gold [USN:L1N45S0G9 TEXT:"rose"] 0.5% to $4,162 an ounce.

The incident occurred at the Mount Bundey Training Area on Oct 5, the department said in a media statement on its website.
Five other Australian Army soldiers were injured, it added. No further details of the incident were available.

items.title: Middle East war sharpens focus on ASEAN energy security plans
items.author: CNA
items.summary: Southeast Asian energy ministers meeting in Manila are expected to review regional fuel-security measures as the US-Israeli war against Iran drags on.

Middle East war sharpens focus on ASEAN energy security plans

Southeast Asian energy ministers meeting in Manila are expected to review regional fuel-security measures as the US-Israeli war against Iran drags on.

A "not available" sign is posted on a fuel dispenser at a gas station amid fuel shortages in Quezon City, Philippines, on Mar 26, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Eloisa Lopez)

FAST

MANILA: Southeast Asian energy ministers meeting in Manila this week face the prospect of a prolonged Middle East war that has exposed the region's vulnerabilities to imported energy.
As the US-Israeli war against Iran drags on, there is increased urgency for ASEAN to implement its proposed energy security plans and reduce its exposure to price shocks caused by attacks on infrastructure and shipping routes in the Middle East. 
ASEAN imports more than half of the crude for its refineries from the Middle East at a time when global benchmark prices are around US$100 a barrel . The conflict has also sharpened concerns about broader energy security risks as Chinese refiners have suspended oil product exports for October.
Against that backdrop, energy ministers meeting in Manila are expected to review regional fuel-security measures launched after emergency talks earlier this year, including efforts to put into effect coordinated emergency responses under the ASEAN Framework Agreement on Petroleum Security (APSA).

Long-term initiatives, including the ASEAN Power Grid and renewable-energy deployment, are also on the agenda.
“What the crisis brought was a sharper focus on resiliency,” Philippine Energy Undersecretary Felix Fuentebella told Reuters on Oct 1, saying energy security had moved from a technical issue to a priority for ASEAN ministers and leaders. 
LOWER EARNINGS The higher prices are raising the costs for the region's households and eating into the earnings of transport workers. 
“We hardly take anything home anymore,” said Antonio Bandin, a Manila jeepney driver who joined a protest last week over rising fuel prices. His working fuel bill has more than doubled to about 2,400 pesos (US$38) per day.

Jeepney drivers and operators march during a protest against the jeepney modernisation program in Manila on Jan 16, 2024. (Photo: AFP/Jam Sta Rosa)

The ASEAN Centre for Energy warned in a policy paper that a severe disruption to Middle East supplies could place oil volumes equivalent to nearly 28 per cent of ASEAN's final oil consumption at risk, underscoring the need for stronger regional petroleum-security arrangements.
But the region's insufficient storage capacity and inventories remain obstacles to implementing APSA, Alloysius Joko Purwanto, senior energy economist at the Economic Research Institute for ASEAN and East Asia, warned on Friday during a webinar hosted by the Center for Strategic and International Studies.
Energy Secretary Sharon Garin has said the Philippines, which remains under a national energy emergency, is exploring regional fuel-stockpiling arrangements and could host future storage projects.

But analysts cautioned that such measures are unlikely to affect the present crisis.
“This is more about preparing for the next crisis. A reserve is a buffer. It is not a strategy,” Christopher Len, a senior fellow at the ISEAS-Yusof Ishak Institute, said in the same webinar, referring to regional stockpiling initiatives. 
Ministers are also expected to discuss ways to reduce long-term dependence on imported fuels. Renewable energy, electric vehicles, and energy efficiency are expected to feature prominently.
The International Energy Agency estimates Southeast Asia's energy import bill could rise from more than US$80 billion in 2024 to about US$245 billion by 2035 without structural change. 
The IEA said wider electrification, including electric vehicles and biofuels, would help curb oil demand and reduce exposure to volatile fuel imports, while cross-border links under the ASEAN Power Grid that would integrate the region's electrical network will require about US$27 billion in investment by 2040.
“We should actually use this shock as a lesson to reduce exposure, not only to cushion it,” Len said.

Source: Reuters/ec

items.title: Euro bounces as falling French bond yields temper debt concerns
items.author: Chuck Mikolajczak
items.creator: Chuck Mikolajczak
items.summary: The euro rebounded on Tuesday and was on pace for its strongest move higher in a month after falling to its lowest in 17 months in the prior day, as a pullback in French government bond yields cooled fears about strain in euro zone debt markets.
items.body:
The euro rebounded on Tuesday and was on pace for its strongest move higher in a month after falling to its lowest in 17 months in the prior day, as a pullback in French government bond yields cooled fears about strain in euro zone debt markets.
The euro zone's currency climbed 0.28%, on track for its biggest daily gain since September 3, at $1.1252. the currency had slid to its lowest since May 2025 on Monday at $1.116, following a drop of more than 1% in the prior week, its fourth straight weekly decline.
The dollar index , which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, fell 0.26% to 101.89 and was on pace for its biggest daily drop since September 25.
Bond markets around the world have seen yields rise due to expectations of sharp central bank rate hikes as energy prices have jumped due to the US-Israeli war with Iran and fanned inflation, as well as concerns about government finances.
French debt [USN:L6N45O0HP TEXT:"has seen pressure mount"] as politicians struggle to curb the budget deficit ahead of a divisive election in 2027. The calling of a [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"snap election in Spain"] added to the recent pressure on the euro.
ENERGY PRICES EASE BOND PRESSURE [USN:L1N45S05E TEXT:"A drop in energy prices"] helped French bonds rally on Tuesday, with key 10-year yield down 8 basis points on Tuesday at 4.7824%.
Crude prices fell as rising Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concern as Saudi-backed Yemeni [USN:L1N45R06H TEXT:"government forces staged"] a lightning advance on Monday to retake the coast around the Bab el-Mandeb Strait up to the city of Mocha, the government said.
'Saudi-backed Yemen forces have recaptured some strategic territory from the Houthis, this has seen oil prices drop sharply," said Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets in New York.
"In turn, this has helped drag yields down, including in France, and in Italy, where the spreads had really widened lately and so this is giving the euro a bit of a bounce."
Far-right French presidential candidate Marine Le Pen, who leads the polls, on Tuesday[USN:L1N45S0C4 TEXT:" increased her plans to reduce spending to €140 billion"] ($158 billion) from €125 billion in savings originally planned if she wins power in 2027.
The fall in the dollar offered helped buoy other currencies, with sterling up 0.39% to $1.327 after climbing to a one-week high of $1.3283.
JAPAN SIGNALS RATE RISE READINESS The yen was an exception however, with the dollar up 0.05% to 157.98 against the Japanese currency.
[USN:L4N45S011 TEXT:"The Bank of Japan may signal this month"] that underlying inflation has roughly hit its 2% target, three people familiar with its thinking said, highlighting its readiness to raise interest rates again in the coming months.
Bank of Japan Governor [USN:L1N45S06F TEXT:"Kazuo Ueda said"] it was becoming more important to anchor underlying inflation around the central bank's 2% target, signaling a preparedness to keep raising interest rates to blunt the risk of too-high inflation.
The US dollar's recent strength has come even as expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike at the central bank's policy meeting later this month have retreated n the wake of [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"weaker-than-expected US jobs data"] and comments from some Fed officials, However, markets are still anticipating more rate hikes later in the year and next year.
The chance of a hike of at least 25 basis points in October stands at about 22%, from about 51% a week ago, according to CME FedWatch , but markets are pricing in an 86% chance for a hike at the December meeting.

items.title: Oil prices fall nearly 2% as Middle East supply concerns ease
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Oil prices fell nearly 2% on Tuesday as supply concerns eased due to increased Middle Eastern crude exports and an agreement by the Group of Seven countries to release emergency diesel and crude stockpiles.
items.body:
Oil prices fell nearly 2% on Tuesday as supply concerns eased due to increased Middle Eastern crude exports and an agreement by the Group of Seven countries to release emergency diesel and crude stockpiles.
Brent futures were down $1.84, or 1.8%, at $98.48 a barrel at 10:30 a.m. EDT (1430 GMT), while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude fell $1.42, or 1.6%, to $88.01.
Those moves put Brent on track for its lowest close since September 8 and WTI on track for its lowest close since August 31.
"The price of the global crude benchmark, Brent, is once again toiling around $100/barrel, as its reasons for trading much beyond the psychological 3-digit mark are being eroded ... for now the assumption of more crude getting through has dampened price fervour," said John Evans, an analyst at oil broker PVM.
Around 12 million barrels per day of crude oil and 2 million bpd of refined products — volumes needed to dampen price pressure — have left the Middle East on tankers in the last 7 to 10 days, the [USN:L6N45S0MD TEXT:"CEO of commodity trading giant Vitol"] said on Tuesday.
[USN:L1N45S0DH TEXT:"Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman"] said on Tuesday that oil pumped through the East-West Pipeline, which runs to the kingdom's Red Sea export hub of Yanbu, had reached 5.8 million barrels as of Tuesday morning.
Oil price declines, however, have been limited by the possibility of further Middle East supply disruptions.
[USN:L1N45S0BG TEXT:"Saudi Arabia's airports"] in Jazan and Najran were targeted in two attacks on Monday evening, injuring three people and causing limited damage, the Saudi aviation authority said, as hostilities between the kingdom and Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis escalated.
The attacks occurred as Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces pressed a major offensive to retake territory from the Houthis after weeks of rebel advances, with Riyadh stepping up airstrikes in support of the campaign.
OIL STOCKS AROUND THE WORLD The [USN:L6N45S0US TEXT:"International Energy Agency"] will meet next week to work out the details of a diesel stock release as market confusion grows over how many barrels Europe and the US plan to make available to address shortages and record-high prices, sources said.
Under pressure from US President Donald Trump, the [USN:L8N45S0QH TEXT:"Group of Seven"] major economies agreed on Friday to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil from emergency reserves and pledged to refrain from imposing energy export restrictions.
The G7, however, did not provide a breakdown of the volumes of crude, diesel and other products to be released, or say which countries would participate.
In the US, meanwhile, the oil market was watching for weekly storage reports from the American Petroleum Institute trade group on Tuesday and the US Energy Information Administration on Wednesday.
Analysts estimated energy firms added 1.8 million barrels of crude to US storage during the week ended October 2.
If correct, it would mark the first time since August that crude stocks increased for three weeks in a row and compare with an increase of 3.7 million barrels in the same week last year and an average increase of 1.7 million barrels over the past five years (2021 to 2025). ,

items.title: Trent emerges Nifty superstar with 12% gain after strong Q2 update
items.summary: Trent shares jumped 12.4 per cent after Q2FY27 standalone revenue rose 22.5 per cent, beating estimates, while analysts remained largely bullish on the Tata group retailer ...
items.body:
Home / Markets / News / Trent emerges Nifty superstar with 12% gain after strong Q2 update

Trent emerges Nifty superstar with 12% gain after strong Q2 update Trent shares jumped 12.4 per cent after Q2FY27 standalone revenue rose 22.5 per cent, beating estimates, while analysts remained largely bullish on the Tata group retailer

Analysts and brokers have mixed views on whether growth will be back for the company

Shilpa Rangarajan Mumbai 4 min read Last Updated : Oct 06 2026 | 9:32 PM IST

Listen to This Article

Shares of Tata group retailer Trent surged 12.4 per cent on Tuesday, taking centre stage as the benchmark indices extended their rebound to a second straight session after eight consecutive weeks of heavy selling.
  The stock closed at ₹2,900 after the company's business update for the second quarter (July-September) of financial year 2026-27 (Q2FY27) showed standalone revenue rising 22.5 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) to ₹5,788 crore. According to Bernstein, that was its fastest growth in six quarters, ahead of the 18.5 per cent consensus estimate. Bernstein said that Trent added 30 net stores in the quarter — including 17 Zudio and 10 Westside outlets — taking its fashion store count to 1,342.
 

  In a world of online buyers, retail is one segment still valued by the number of physical stores a company adds every year. Trent has always been ahead at this game. Until December 2024, each new store added about ₹630 crore to the company’s market cap. Investors were paying for future growth, not just the stores already open. Since December 2024, the relationship has flipped. Every additional store has come with about ₹240 crore less market cap. Store openings didn't destroy value but the market has cut the price it pays for each store as sales per store weakened.
  Trent's market value per Zudio and Westside store fell from a peak of ₹290 crore in December 2024 to ₹104.2 crore by September 2026, even as their combined count rose to 1,342 from 873, showed Bloomberg data, the company’s reports, and exchange filings.

  Motilal Oswal, which gives the stock a "Buy" rating, said that Q1FY27 revenue per store fell just 1 per cent Y-o-Y compared to a 5 per cent decline previously, indicating that the impact of cannibalisation is easing.

  “I think if the stock manages to sustain above 2,900-2,925 levels on closing basis, then there are brighter chances that it may further scale up to 3,100-3,300 levels,” said Gaurav Sharma, head of research, Globe Capital.
  Trent, however, still trades at a price-to-earnings (P/E) multiple of 76, up from 68 a year ago. Over the past five years, the stock has given a 31 per cent annualised return, vastly outperforming the Nifty 50's 5 per cent.

  Analysts and brokers have mixed views on whether growth will be back for the company.
  Vincent K Andrews, senior research analyst at Geojit Investments, said: "The improvement in the revenue growth supported the current premium valuation, but still it is at premium.” He expects growth to improve further if store additions stay strong.
  Brokerages remain largely bullish. Of the 29 analysts tracking the stock on Bloomberg, 22 rate it “Buy”, five “Hold”, and two “Sell”. Their average target price of ₹3,417.57 implies an upside of about 18 per cent.
  Citi is the only brokerage with an outright “Sell” rating and a target below ₹3,000, at ₹2,950. "We remain cautious on Trent given a still-weak revenue per square foot (sq ft) trend, increasing competition, impact of cannibalisation, and risk to margins from input cost inflation," it said. Kotak Institutional Equities, the other bear, rates the stock “Reduce”, with a target of ₹3,150.

  Morgan Stanley, which has an “Overweight” rating and a target of ₹3,406, said: "Better-than-expected revenue growth, especially in the context of the shift in the festive calendar, should be viewed positively."
  Bernstein retained its “Outperform” rating and ₹3,500 target. It noted that the growth surprise came in a quarter when other value-apparel retailers struggled because the festive season shifted from the second to the third quarter.

MOSCOW: A laboratory worker at a plague research institute in Siberia fell ill and died in undisclosed circumstances, prompting authorities to quarantine dozens of people and the head of Russia's health watchdog to fly to the Irkutsk region.
The death has sparked public health fears on social media, but the authorities said on Monday (Oct 5) the situation was under control.
The World Health Organization said that based on available information, "the public health risk to the general population appears to be low". New risk assessments would be conducted once further information became known, it said.
US President Donald Trump said the death was a "big problem for Russia" and offered to help Moscow deal with it.

"We'll help," Trump said. "Anybody that has that kind of a problem, we're always willing to help."
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Washington was closely monitoring the situation.
Plague is endemic to Siberia - the location of the first known prehistoric human outbreak - as the bacterium that causes it, Yersinia pestis, is present among the small wild mammals in its vast wilderness and their fleas. 
However, it is rare for Russians to fall ill with plague, though cases occur every year in other parts of the world - notably Africa.
Plague comes in three forms affecting different parts of the body. Pneumonic plague, an infection of the lungs, prompts the patient to cough out infectious airborne droplets.
If identified quickly, it can be treated with antibiotics. But if left untreated, it can be fatal in one to six days.
Local media have named the laboratory worker who died as Darya Shipilova, a 28-year-old employee at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East.
There were conflicting reports about how and where she fell ill, but the authorities said she had died of pneumonia of as-yet unestablished origin.

AUTHORITIES SAY NO NEW CASES REPORTED, ALL CONTACTS TRACED Russia's health watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor, told state media the institute had not found evidence of any accidents involving the handling of pathogens after rumours spread on social media that the woman had dropped a test tube containing live bacteria.
Nevertheless, Anna Popova, the head of Rospotrebnadzor, flew to Siberia for an emergency meeting over the weekend.
According to Russian media reports, about 200 people who had been in contact with the dead woman were quarantined, parts of the hospital in the town of Shelekhov where she died were cordoned off and an aluminium plant told its workers to wear masks.
Rospotrebnadzor, in a later statement quoted by the TASS news agency, said officials in Irkutsk Region had found two cases of COVID and two cases of rhinoviruses among people who had been in contact with her. No other cases of infectious diseases were noted.
Authorities urged people to remain calm and said there was no evidence that the woman's death was linked to her work.
Igor Kobzev, the governor of the Irkutsk region, said in a statement that she had died of "pneumonia of unknown aetiology", adding: "Importantly, over the past few days, no new cases of staff from the Anti-Plague Institute seeking medical attention have been identified."
He said the situation was under control and that all known contacts of the dead woman had been identified, examined and placed under medical supervision.

items.title: Jeffrey Archer, UK novelist and scandal-plagued politician, dies on eve of final book
items.author: Sam Tobin
items.creator: Sam Tobin
items.summary: Jeffrey Archer, the bestselling British novelist and former politician who was jailed for lying in a high-profile libel case, died aged 86 on Monday, just one day before his final novel "Adam and Eve" was due to be published.
items.body:
Jeffrey Archer, the bestselling British novelist and former politician who was jailed for lying in a high-profile libel case, died aged 86 on Monday, just one day before his final novel "Adam and Eve" was due to be published.
The confidant of former prime minister Margaret Thatcher lived a life that swung from the heights of luxury and fame to the lows of a two-year stint in prison for perjury over paying a woman for sex.
He sold more than 300 million copies of his books, spent a total of five and a half years on the New York Times bestseller lists and found fans around the world with his pacy thrillers, among them the 1976 debut "Not a Penny More, Not a Penny Less" and 1979's mass-selling "Kane & Abel".
Publisher HarperCollins said Archer, who had met and signed books for fans in London's Leicester Square Theatre on Sunday and had been scheduled to speak at events this week, died "suddenly and peacefully at home ... between writing sessions".
"We're all devastated to have lost a writer who has brought joy to generations of readers — and a true friend," said Kate Elton, HarperCollins' UK CEO and Archer's editor.
"When he set out to write 'Adam and Eve', he told me from the very beginning that it would be his final novel".
HEAVY DEBTS CURTAILED HIS LIFE AS A LAWMAKER Archer first made headlines when he entered parliament in 1969, aged 29, before he became a casualty of a fraudulent investment scheme which meant he did not stand for re-election in 1974 but went into writing to try to clear his debts.
"When I was three, I wanted to be four; when I was four, I wanted to be prime minister," he was quoted as saying in 2001.
Despite only a short stint in parliament, he remained a central figure within the Conservative Party, spent more than 30 years sitting in the upper House of Lords chamber in parliament and raised millions of pounds for charity.
Cabinet ministers and celebrities flocked to his "champagne and shepherd's pie" parties, with guests recalling how anyone looking for the bathroom at his London apartment was told to "Go past the Picasso and turn left at the Matisse".
Some of that interest waned with his very public downfall.
In 1987, Archer sued the Daily Star tabloid for saying he had paid a woman for sex, winning a then-record £500,000 ($660,450) in damages.
The case returned to the public eye when he was selected as the Conservative candidate to become London's first elected mayor in 1999. A former friend accused him of lying and Archer was eventually charged with perjury and perverting the course of justice, convicted and sentenced to four years' imprisonment. He served two years, during which time he wrote "A Prison Diary".
ARCHER TRIAL NOTORIOUS FOR JUDGE'S SUMMING UP The trial became notorious for the judge's summing up of evidence given by Archer's wife Mary.
"Remember Mary Archer in the witness box," the judge, Bernard Caulfield, told the jury. "Your vision of her will probably never disappear. Has she elegance? Has she fragrance? Would she have, without the strain of this trial, radiance?"
And, of Archer, he added: "Is he in need of cold, unloving, rubber-insulated sex in a seedy hotel?"
The fall from grace did no harm to his literary career. HarperCollins said Archer's books were sold in 119 countries and he was due to speak at an event in London on Wednesday and the Cheltenham Literature Festival this weekend.
Kemi Badenoch, the leader of the Conservatives, said she was shocked by the news, having received a message from Archer as she attended her annual party conference on Monday morning saying: "great outfit, great speech, no need to reply".
Asked recently by the BBC why he wanted "Adam and Eve" to be his last book, Archer said: "It's been 50 very happy years. But there is always a time. I think the clever thing in life is when to get out."
($1 = 0.7571 pounds)

items.title: Conservation group calls for moratorium on AI data centers on US public lands
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Conservation group The Wilderness Society on Monday called for a moratorium on artificial intelligence data centers on federal lands, citing concerns over water use, electricity demand, wildlife habitat and public access.
items.body:
Conservation group The Wilderness Society on Monday called for a moratorium on artificial intelligence data centers on federal lands, citing concerns over water use, electricity demand, wildlife habitat and public access.
The call comes as the Trump administration is considering permits for several data center developments on lands managed by the Bureau of Land Management, according to federal land records. US President Donald Trump has sought to expand a range of industries on public lands, including mining and oil and gas
Trump has championed rapid expansion of AI infrastructure and data centers, describing them as critical to economic growth and technological competitiveness. But the industry has increasingly faced local opposition
The Wilderness Society said public lands should remain focused on recreation, conservation and public access, and called for a pause before large-scale industrial development tied to AI is allowed on federally managed lands
BLM officials did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The agency manages about a tenth of America's land base, primarily in Western states

McDonald's hit with class action alleging AI-powered menu price-fixing

WASHINGTON: McDonald's has been sued in federal court in Chicago in a proposed nationwide class action alleging the fast-food company illegally coordinates menu prices across its franchises and company-owned restaurants through an AI-powered pricing system.
The lawsuit, filed on Friday (Oct 9), said McDonald’s violated US antitrust law by conspiring with independent franchisees to fix prices using algorithms trained on nonpublic data. 
Reuters reported last week that McDonald’s pricing engine uses machine-learning algorithms to continually analyse data from millions of daily transactions across its nearly 14,000 restaurants.
The lawsuit cited the Reuters article, which said other fast-food companies are also turning to AI to help with pricing and other operations.

"Independent businesses must set their prices independently," the lawsuit said. 
McDonald’s, in a statement on Monday, called the allegations speculative and uninformed.
"AI does not set the price of a Big Mac or any other menu item," the company said. It said franchisees make their own pricing decisions, and that the use of pricing recommendation tools and analytics is widespread across industries. 
US plaintiffs have filed a wave of class actions in recent years alleging that companies used algorithms or AI to illegally coordinate prices for hotel rooms, apartment rentals and other purchases.
Lark Turner, a lawyer for the plaintiff, said in a statement, that McDonald's is "leveraging its troves of data and its franchised system to nickel-and-dime consumers down to the last French fry".
The plaintiff, an Illinois resident, is seeking to represent a class of potentially millions of McDonald's customers, the lawsuit said.

items.title: Barrick secures 15-year North Mara mining licences in Tanzania
items.author: Northern Miner Staff
items.creator: Northern Miner Staff
items.summary: The latest approval removes tenure risk, leaving Barrick to reverse a sharp first-half production decline.
items.body:
Barrick secures 15-year North Mara mining licences in Tanzania

Henry Lazenby | October 5, 2026 | 12:10 pm
Top Companies   Africa   Canada   Gold  

( Image by Twiga Partnership, Facebook. )

Tanzania has renewed Barrick Mining’s (TSX: ABX; NYSE: B) licences for the North Mara gold mine for 15 years, securing its operating tenure as the company weighs an expansion.

North Mara is a combined open-pit and underground operation about 540 km northwest of Dodoma and 20 km south of the Kenyan border. Barrick owns 84% and Tanzania holds the remaining 16%. The mine produced 249,000 attributable oz. last year.

“Relations at North Mara mine have strengthened since Barrick took over,” Tarime district commissioner Maj. Edward Gowele said in Barrick’s Monday release. “Residents now really view the mine as a community partner.”

North Mara’s two special mining licences were last renewed for 15 years in 2012. The latest approval removes that separate tenure risk, leaving Barrick to reverse a sharp first-half production decline, meet North Mara’s attributable 2026 guidance of 200,000 to 230,000 oz. and decide whether to expand the North Mara-Bulyanhulu complex.

Barrick’s Toronto-traded shares were down 1% at $56.84 (US$39.87) apiece by mid-Monday, after tracking 20% higher over the past 12 months. Bids have tested $42.62 and $74.00 over the same period.

Production test

Attributable output fell 47% to 68,000 oz. in the first half from 129,000 oz. a year earlier. All-in sustaining costs rose 79% to US$2,283 per oz. from US$1,272 per ounce. Barrick cited lower grades at North Mara among the factors raising company-wide second-quarter costs.

Barrick maintained North Mara’s guidance at 200,000 to 230,000 oz. and all-in sustaining costs of US$1,520-US$1,680 per oz. The mine must produce 132,000 to 162,000 oz. in the second half to reach that range.

North Mara output is expected to rise next year. Barrick is studying upgrades to remove processing bottlenecks and expand the North Mara-Bulyanhulu complex.

North Mara held attributable proven and probable reserves of 43 million tonnes grading 2.32 grams gold per tonne for 3.2 million oz. at the end of 2025, Barrick reported.

State reset

Barrick bought the 36% of Acacia Mining it didn’t already own in September 2019 and took direct control of North Mara. Under then-CEO Mark Bristow, it reached a settlement with Tanzania the following month and formalized it in January 2020, agreeing to pay $300 million, give the state a 16% free-carried interest in the mines and split their economic benefits equally.

The accord created Twiga Minerals to manage North Mara and Bulyanhulu. Since 2019, Barrick says its Tanzanian operations have contributed about $5.3 billion to the country, including $1.2 billion last year.

LBMA trial

The renewal comes as the London Bullion Market Association prepares for a six-week High Court trial beginning Wednesday over the deaths of two 23-year-old artisanal miners at North Mara in 2019. Their families allege Tanzanian police, private guards or both killed the men in separate incidents that July and December.

Barrick took operational control in September, between the incidents. It isn’t a defendant in the London case and declined to comment to Reuters , the news outlet reported Monday.

The claim alleges the LBMA negligently kept India-based refiner MMTC-PAMP that processed North Mara gold on its ‘good delivery list’ despite reports of abuses at the mine. The list determines which refiners’ bars are accepted in London’s wholesale bullion market.

The LBMA denies liability, saying it certifies refiners rather than mines and had no control over North Mara or Tanzanian police.

The association held about £1.4 million ($1.8 million) in reserves at the end of 2025 and could face £3 million in claimants’ legal costs before damages if it loses, Bloomberg reported on Monday.

A ruling holding the LBMA responsible could set a precedent for compensation over abuses at supplying mines and threaten its role in global gold trading, John Meyer, a mining analyst at SP Angel, said in a note on Monday. The court has stayed another 26 claims and five potential claims until after the trial, according to the LBMA.

items.title: French bond contagion fears are rattling the euro
items.author: Dhara Ranasinghe, Alun John
items.creator: Dhara Ranasinghe, Alun John
items.summary: A sliding euro is the latest alarm bell for policymakers facing a surge in French borrowing costs that has started to spill over into the broader euro area.
items.body:
A sliding euro is the latest alarm bell for policymakers facing a surge in French borrowing costs that has started to spill over into the broader euro area.
The euro hit [USN:L1N45R03D TEXT:"17-month lows below $1.12"] on Monday and tumbled against sterling , the Swiss franc and Japan's yen .
France is at the heart of the European market concerns.
The French government is seeking to enact an unpopular [USN:L1N45N0A3 TEXT:"2027 budget"] to lower its deficit and contain its record-high debt load, a tall order in a deeply divided parliament as political factions position ahead of next year's presidential election.
Investors, unwilling to take chances, are [USN:L8N45O0S7 TEXT:"dumping French bonds"] while buying safe German debt.
With the premium investors demand to hold French over German government bonds now at its [USN:L8N45O0YO TEXT:"highest since"] the 2010-2012 euro zone debt crisis, currency markets fear contagion.
At stake is feeble economic expansion in a bloc rocked by political uncertainty. Chancellor Friedrich Merz's party last month suffered the worst regional election defeat in postwar Germany. And on Monday, Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez called a [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"snap election"]. Italy also holds elections next year.
With inflation already rising on soaring energy costs and higher yields increasing household and corporate borrowing costs, further euro weakening could leave the European Central Bank caught between fighting inflation and calming bond markets.
The French/German 10-year bond yield gap last week saw its biggest weekly jump in decades, while the gap between Italian and German yields hit almost 130 basis points (bps), posting its biggest weekly rise since the COVID-19 crisis.
"The bond sell-off is seeing bigger moves in anything that is perceived in any way, shape, or form as more vulnerable, and that has seen an outbreak of euro selling that's gathered momentum," said Societe Generale's chief FX strategist Kit Juckes.
"The factors that held euro/dollar above key levels through the summer... I think that's gone," he said, pointing to earlier assumptions of a short-lived energy shock and a US push to weaken the dollar.
NEW DIMENSION TO EURO WEAKNESS While the euro is comfortably above 20-year lows hit in 2022 when Russia's invasion of Ukraine sparked an energy crisis, the bond market moves add a new dimension to euro weakness.
Every further 10 bps widening in the French spread against Germany would be associated with a 0.4% fall in euro/dollar, BofA FX strategists estimate.
"The typical response is closer to zero most of the time, but (the spread impact) can rise significantly in times of acute stress," Goldman Sachs analysts said in a note.
"Spreads do not matter for the currency until they are the only thing that matters," they said, adding that the impact on the euro rises when a risk event pushes German yields down, but those elsewhere in the bloc higher.
This was the case last week when Germany's Bund yield fell almost 17 bps, its biggest weekly drop since 2024 .
"Euro/dollar is usually influenced more from the dollar side, but this time there is an impact from Europe too," said Amundi Asset Management's head of global FX Andreas König.
"You have to go back a bit in time to when European headlines last made the euro move," he said.
König did not see a turnaround in the medium term and was sticking with a dollar overweight position given the US growth and rate outlook.
CFTC positioning data show traders positioned for a fall in the euro, a view also reflected in currency options.
Three-month euro risk reversals , which reflect the difference between the cost of an option to buy the euro against the cost of one to sell it, fell on Friday to their most bearish since 2024.
Analysts said the euro could test $1.10, while SocGen's Juckes also highlighted euro vulnerability against the likes of the yen and Swiss franc. The euro fell almost 4% against the yen in September.
A falling currency alongside bond market stress means talk has turned to how policymakers could stabilise markets, especially if 2027's French election causes more strain.
The ECB's Transmission Protection Instrument allows it to buy an unlimited number of bonds from a country experiencing an "unwarranted, disorderly" tightening of financing conditions.
For now, growth, though weak, has strengthened.
Euro zone business activity expanded at its fastest pace in nearly 3-1/2 years in September, S&P Global data showed. The degree to which banks, the main financiers of companies in the region, can keep lending to their economies is also in focus.
"If the fiscal contagion risk in Europe is not contained, I can see euro/dollar trading lower, despite the fact that it was already slightly undervalued," said Stephen Jen, CEO and co-CIO of Eurizon SLJ Asset Management.

items.title: Aboard the USS George Washington, young sailors adjust to war with Iran
items.author: Ed Ou
items.creator: Ed Ou
items.summary: An emergency alert blares from a loudspeaker, and Damon Dennard and other sailors on the deck of the aircraft carrier USS George Washington are scrambling. Dennard, 23, is readying bombs for loading onto aircraft as his crewmates race to their positions.
items.body:
(This Oct 3 story has been corrected to remove erroneous timeline, in paragraph 5.)
An emergency alert blares from a loudspeaker, and Damon Dennard and other sailors on the deck of the aircraft carrier USS George Washington are scrambling. Dennard, 23, is readying bombs for loading onto aircraft as his crewmates race to their positions.
"It has been eventful," says Dennard, an aviation ordnanceman airman apprentice. Once the alert ends, he takes a breath, sits on one of the bombs and jokes that he probably expected an easier deployment.
"It's crazy, but at the end of the day, it's work. That's all."
Dennard was one of dozens of sailors Reuters spoke with in September on a rare visit to a US warship that is central to the Iran war. The visit began at a particularly tense moment, just three days after the US military blew up five Iranian [USN:L6N451042 TEXT:"oil tankers"] in retaliation for Iran targeting a US Navy warship.
There is no end-date for the deployment, and the mission itself came as a surprise to the crew of the Japan-based carrier.
The aircraft carrier is effectively a floating city of around 5,000 personnel, each with their own mission, from Majesta Ochoa, who operates a cash register, to Lieutenant Commander Brody Samaha, a "shooter" who helps oversee the launch of aircraft from the carrier's catapults.
But there is a sense of synchronization as the sailors go about their jobs, crew say.
"It's a dance, with lots of people checking each other," Samaha says, before adding that the flight deck is also a "very dangerous place to be. It's very unforgiving."
BOARD STRATEGY Breana Royston, a night aircraft handling officer, or 'NACHO,' has a unique perspective over the dangerous maneuvering on the flight deck. Her job is to supervise aircraft movement, including bringing fighter jets up to the flight deck and back down to the hangar bay via massive elevators. To do that, she uses what's known in Navy parlance as a "ouija board" — a real-time model of the deck, with miniature aircraft all lined up in their current positions. It looks a little like a strategy board game.
"We've been on our toes the last week, maneuvering and everything — with everything that's going on," Royston says, adding it's been "kind of crazy, really busy."
"It's nerve-wracking, but it's fun."
The Iranian government has repeatedly condemned US military actions in the Strait of Hormuz. On September 25, the Iranian foreign minister said the insecurity prevailing in the strait was the "direct result of the aggressive actions of the United States and the Israeli regime."
The war began in February with joint strikes on Iranian targets by the US and Israel. US President Donald Trump has said many times the conflict would soon be over, but as it persisted for longer than initially expected, the Navy turned to the George Washington to relieve another carrier, the USS Abraham Lincoln.
In August, in response to reports of deteriorating conditions, low morale and suicide attempts on the Lincoln, at sea since November 2025, US Secretary of Defense Pete [USN:S0N43A054 TEXT:"Hegseth"] said the accounts "misrepresented" the reality, praising sailors who endure austere conditions.
Still, extended deployments can pose enormous strain on crews’ mental health, particularly in wartime, and are a challenge for any navy. Sailors must maintain a state of alert and readiness, heightened in the case of the George Washington due to the threat of drone and missile attack from Iran.
"Morale is really important to us," said Rear Admiral Jeffrey Heames, the commander of Carrier Strike Group 5. Heames talked about ensuring the ability of the crew to contact home and receive mail.
"Some of those things affect how sailors hold up out in this kind of environment," Heames said. "They are huge focus areas for me."
Reuters spoke with Seaman Deandre Cook as he checked in with his wife back home on a video call. She was holding one of their young daughters on her hip. It was hard being away from his family, Cook said, but added: "The distance makes the relationship stronger."
Reuters was given access to the USS George Washington under the condition that no operational details would be disclosed, including the exact location of the aircraft carrier.
GROWING UP As jets thundered off the carrier's deck above them, hundreds of members of the George Washington's crew gathered for a ceremony to mark the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001 attacks — an event many of them were too young to remember.
Al Qaeda's attacks on New York and Washington propelled the US into two decades of war that sent troops to Afghanistan, Iraq, Syria and elsewhere. Many supporters of Trump had hoped Middle East wars were a thing of the past.
After a sailor sang the national anthem, the chaplain on board, Ben Garrett, delivered a prayer as the assembled crew bowed their heads.
"Help us honor those who have gone before us," Garrett said.
Garrett later told Reuters that many of the crew members are still learning the basics of growing up, including skills like patience, managing relationships and career expectations.
"A huge percentage of this ship are between the ages of 19 and 24 years old," said Garrett, a Roman Catholic priest. "So they're trying to figure out being an adult while they're out here."
Sometimes sailors enlist to get away from a small town or a situation back home, Garrett added.
"But then they come here and they realize that some of the things they might have been trying to get away from, they brought it with them," Garrett said.
Lieutenant Commander Brian Lasley said there were more people on the George Washington than back in his hometown of Fredericktown, Missouri, whose population was 4,429 in the 2020 census.
Camren Pollard, 24, an interior communications electrician third class, said he joined the Navy on a spur-of-the-moment decision after seeing older coworkers unhappy in his previous job. "I wanted to change things in my life," he said.
"My mom freaked out more than anything. My little brother thought it was kind of cool." For Pollard, however, "I don't think about it a whole lot. It's work for me."

items.title: Brazil court order shuts Sigma Lithium mine
items.author: Northern Miner Staff
items.creator: Northern Miner Staff
items.summary: A federal judge suspended Grota do Cirilo’s environmental licences and mining operations on Sept. 4.
items.body:
Brazil court order shuts Sigma Lithium mine

Northern Miner Staff | October 1, 2026 | 10:28 am
News   Regulatory Issues   Latin America   Lithium  

Grota do Cirilo is said to be among the world’s largest and highest-grade hard rock lithium deposits. ( Image courtesy of Sigma Lithium. )

Sigma Lithium (TSXV, Nasdaq: SGML; ASX: SAU) has halted all mining and processing at its Grota do Cirilo complex in Brazil, two days after dismissing reports that a court had suspended the operation’s environmental licences.

The shutdown began Wednesday after Sigma received an electronic notice from Minas Gerais state environmental regulator FEAM late the previous day, the company said. Grota do Cirilo, about 450 km northeast of state capital Belo Horizonte, is Sigma’s only producing asset and has annual lithium concentrate capacity of 330,000 tonnes. Its first stage reached commercial production in October 2023 after a C$188-million ($131.9-million) build.

“We lower our rating to ‘market perform (speculative)’ and our target price to $10 as we move to the sidelines pending greater clarity on a number of legal, safety and environmental challenges facing the company,” BMO Capital Markets analyst Joel Jackson said in a note Thursday. “While we recognize the political backdrop in Brazil remains complex, the timing of a return to normalized operations remains uncertain.”

Court ruling

The halt reverses Sigma’s position on Monday, when it said operations were continuing normally and called reports that its licences had been suspended “categorically incorrect.” The restart now depends on a federal appeals court ruling. Sigma kept its 2027 output target but delayed its rolling 12-month guidance by three months.

Sigma’s Toronto shares fell 19% to C$11.16 by mid-Thursday, leaving them about 40% lower this year. They have traded between C$6.51 and C$33.28 over the past 12 months.

A federal judge suspended Grota do Cirilo’s environmental licences and mining operations on Sept. 4 in a civil suit filed by the Federation of Quilombola Communities of Minas Gerais, known as N’Golo. The order also barred state authorities from issuing new licences.

Consultation issue

The dispute centres on whether FEAM should have consulted Baú, a protected Afro-Brazilian community, before licensing the mine. N’Golo says federal mapping places the community’s territory 2.7 km from the operation, inside an 8-km zone that requires prior consultation. The court ordered independent mapping to determine the distance.

The community’s homes are 8 km to 11 km from its pits and the licences predate a November 2023 federal report defining the territory’s proposed boundaries, Sigma maintains. The company denies that its operations have harmed the community.

Sigma said its emergency request to suspend the injunction had awaited a ruling for 15 days. It acknowledged FEAM’s notice on Tuesday evening and halted production the next day. The company didn’t provide an expected date for the appeals court decision.

Sigma kept its 2027 guidance at 330,000 tonnes but delayed its 240,000-tonne 12-month production target. It didn’t say whether the latest postponement comes on top of a three-month deferral announced in August after an earlier shutdown.

Sales of lithium-bearing material recovered from stored tailings will continue, which Sigma says should generate enough cash to fund the company during the halt.

Safety order

Brazil’s National Mining Agency separately ordered Sigma this week to stop work in part of Grota do Cirilo because of an unspecified “imminent risk,” Reuters reported Wednesday.

The regulator ordered immediate repairs to the east wall of the north pit, where it identified a damaged section. The area will remain closed until the work is finished. Sigma’s Thursday release didn’t address that order or provide a repair schedule.

The latest halt follows a five-week shutdown that ended Aug. 21 after Sigma signed an environmental compliance agreement with Minas Gerais. The agreement included up to US$540,000 in fines and about $1 million of environmental work.

Sigma produced 35,400 tonnes in the second quarter and sold 24,400 tonnes for $55 million in revenue. It reported $17 million in cash and $125 million in net debt at June 30.

BMO’s Jackson cut his 2027 production estimate to 207,000 tonnes from 278,000 tonnes and his earnings forecast to $103 million from $194 million. He also delayed his assumed start of Sigma’s second processing plant to mid-2028 from late 2027.
